To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

</details>


### [177] [RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16480)
*Yanbo Jiang,Haotian Zheng,Jiahao Wang,Hanxiao Ren,Yitao Xu,Yining Xing,Zehong Ke,Hao Cheng,Yiqian Tu,Jinhao Li,Zhiyuan Xuan,Fang Zhang,Jianqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RISE是一个覆盖路侧序列度量3D跟踪与结构化视觉语言推理的框架。其图像-only跟踪方法结合SAM3视频身份与标定引导的掩码一致性实现多视角身份关联，无需LiDAR或任务特定3D训练，即可在6个交叉口的20个人工审核片段中达到66.9 MOTA。此外，RISE-VQA数据集包含33,910个QA对，覆盖16个交叉口61个路侧视角，并通过RISE-Bench基准评估语义选择、坐标、未来框和交互集合等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧智能基础设施中的感知与推理需要跨相机多视角的长期一致3D跟踪，同时需要具备结构化视觉语言推理能力以支持高价值场景理解。现有方法依赖LiDAR或任务特定3D训练，且缺乏针对路侧场景的预测性QA基准。

Method: 1) 度量3D跟踪：采用图像-only方法，结合SAM3视频身份与标定引导的掩码一致性进行多视角身份关联，通过标定条件几何实现无重训的跨场景泛化。2) 结构化VLM推理：使用人工审核的MLLM流水线挖掘高价值片段，利用受限全上下文Oracle构建bbox锚定的预测性QA，防止未来证据泄露。3) RISE-VQA数据集与RISE-Bench基准：涵盖语义、坐标、未来框与交互集合四类任务的确定性指标评估。

Result: 跟踪任务在20个人工审核片段上达到66.9 MOTA；RISE-VQA包含33,910个QA对，来自557个片段、16个交叉口和61个路侧视角。实验表明领域自适应和时序上下文带来一致收益，同时揭示了空间定位、未来定位和交互推理方面的持续挑战。

Conclusion: RISE展示了无需LiDAR即可实现跨交叉口泛化的多视角度量3D跟踪能力，并为路侧视觉语言推理提供了大规模、可评估的数据集与基准。但空间grounding、未来位置预测与交互推理仍是开放难题，需要进一步研究。

Abstract: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.

</details>


### [178] [Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16484)
*Zigan Zhou,Kai Li,Yupeng Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Code-as-City框架，将单张俯视遥感图像中的城市布局提取建模为受约束的代码生成任务。系统利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行三次有序推理，结合五类语义先验恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及建筑，并通过确定性归一化将记录转换为城市图和受限布局程序，最终执行程序生成可渲染的3D城市布局及正交语义投影，支持像素级比较与同步再生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感系统输出检测框、语义掩码或矢量边界，虽能定位类别并支持图像平面评分，但无法构成保留对象身份、类型化关系、拓扑及再生成规则的可执行布局。作者希望弥补视觉观测与可编辑、可检查的城市代码之间的鸿沟。

Method: 首先由图像模型生成对齐的五类语义布局先验；随后三次有序MLLM推理分别恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及其关系、建筑；通过确定性归一化将累积记录转化为城市图与受限布局程序；执行程序生成可渲染3D城市布局，并在共享几何上生成正交语义投影，实现与遥感掩码的像素级比较及视图间同步再生成。

Result: 在CityLayout-100数据集的100个场景上，完整框架获得41.1%的平均交并比（mean IoU）和48.3%的全局交并比（global IoU），为视觉观测可转化为可检查、可编辑的城市代码提供了定量证据。

Conclusion: 研究表明通过约束代码生成范式，视觉观测可以转化为兼具平面与3D耦合输出的可检查、可编辑城市代码，实现了布局提取从语义定位到可执行程序化表达的重要跨越。

Abstract: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.

</details>


### [179] [HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16485)
*Junhao Hou,Chenqi Luo,Pufan Wang,Jiaying Lu,Yusheng Liu,Feiwei Qin,Meie Fang,Kun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiFi-BRep是一个新颖的B-Rep生成框架，通过拓扑感知编码器（消除填充噪声和特征污染）和单阶段解码器（并行联合预测几何与拓扑，并将流形约束嵌入为可微学习目标）来解决现有深度生成方法在表示和生成两方面的脆弱性，显著提升结构有效性和几何保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B-Rep生成是CAD中的基础任务，但直接合成高保真且结构有效的B-Reps仍是重大挑战。现有深度生成方法存在两类脆弱性：表示脆弱性（潜在空间中填充噪声和特征污染）和生成脆弱性（顺序误差传播以及因不可微的有效性约束导致的训练-推理不匹配）。

Method: HiFi-BRep通过两个协同贡献解决上述问题：(1) 拓扑感知编码器：利用可学习查询消除填充，并通过拓扑引导的注意力防止特征污染，构建高保真潜在表示；(2) 单阶段解码器：并行联合预测几何与拓扑，将核心流形约束嵌入为可微学习目标，实现几何与拓扑的相互引导，避免级联误差。

Result: 大量实验表明，HiFi-BRep在结构有效性和几何保真度两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法，提供了稳健的高质量B-Rep合成解决方案。

Conclusion: HiFi-BRep通过同时解决表示脆弱性和生成脆弱性，展示了可靠的B-Rep合成能力，并公开了代码和模型以供复现与后续研究。

Abstract: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge. Existing deep generative methods suffer from two forms of brittleness: representation brittleness, caused by padding noise and feature contamination in the latent space, and generation brittleness, stemming from sequential error propagation and a train-inference mismatch due to non-differentiable validity enforcement. We propose HiFi-BRep, a novel framework that addresses these limitations through two synergistic contributions. First, a topology-aware encoder constructs a high-fidelity latent representation by eliminating padding via learnable queries and preventing feature contamination with topology-guided attention. Second, a single-stage decoder jointly predicts geometry and topology in parallel, embedding core manifold constraints as a differentiable learning objective. This design ensures mutual guidance between geometry and topology while avoiding cascaded errors. Extensive experiments show that HiFi-BRep significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both structural validity and geometric fidelity, providing a robust solution for high-quality B-Rep synthesis. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep.

</details>


### [180] [Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16490)
*Azhar Hussian,Martin Vossiek,Vasileios Belagiannis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RapidLiDAR 是一种实时 LiDAR 场景补全方法，通过将初始化本身作为可学习的数据驱动组件（自适应初始化模块），并采用多尺度重建模块（结合 3D 体素与 2D BEV 特征）替代传统点邻域算子（FPS、k-NN），在 SemanticKITTI 和 KITTI-360 上达到与最先进方法相当的补全性能，同时仅需 0.1 秒完成整个场景补全，比最快现有方法快 2.3 倍，匹配 10 Hz 车载 LiDAR 采集频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 场景补全方法遵循"初始化-细化"范式，但存在明显不足：生成式方法通过迭代细化随机高斯噪声而速度慢；非生成式方法使用固定噪声尺度扰动部分场景，对大间隙和遮挡区域的覆盖有限，且需要针对每种传感器配置手动重新校准。作者旨在解决实时性与泛化性之间的矛盾，提出无需手动噪声调参的快速场景补全方法。

Method: RapidLiDAR 包含两个核心模块：(1) 自适应初始化模块——为每个部分输入点预测空间变化的位移，将部分观测扩展为适应局部几何的粗略场景初始化，无需手动噪声调优；(2) 多尺度重建模块——通过查询从输入扫描构建的多尺度 3D 体素和 2D BEV 特征图来进一步细化点位置。架构用体素和 BEV 特征提取替代 FPS 和 k-NN 等点邻域算子，加快速度并天然适应不同输入分辨率。

Result: 在 SemanticKITTI 和 KITTI-360 基准上，RapidLiDAR 的补全性能与最先进方法相当，同时整个场景补全仅需 0.1 秒，比最快的现有方法快 2.3 倍，与典型车载 LiDAR 传感器 10 Hz 的采集速率匹配。

Conclusion: RapidLiDAR 通过将初始化设计为可学习组件并采用体素/BEV 特征提取替代昂贵点邻域算子，在保持最先进补全精度的同时实现了实时推理速度，向实时 LiDAR 场景补全迈出了实质性一步。

Abstract: LiDAR scene completion is a key component of 3D perception in autonomous driving, where the scene must be completed in real time to be usable in downstream tasks. Existing approaches typically follow an initialize-and-refine paradigm, in which a coarse initialization of the scene is first constructed, then refined into complete 3D geometry. Generative models are slower because they iteratively refine random Gaussian noise into the scene, while non-generative methods perturb the partial scene with a fixed noise scale, which limits coverage of large gaps and occluded regions and requires manual recalibration for each new sensor configuration. We present RapidLiDAR, a LiDAR scene completion method that treats the initialization itself as a learned, data-driven component. We propose an adaptive initialization module that predicts a spatially varying displacement for each partial input point, expanding the partial observations into a coarse scene initialization adapted to the local geometry, without requiring manual noise tuning. To refine this coarse initialization into a complete and coherent scene, we additionally propose a multi-scale reconstruction module that further refines point positions by querying multi-scale 3D voxel and 2D BEV feature maps constructed from the input scan. By replacing point-neighborhood operators such as farthest point sampling and $k$-nearest neighbor search with voxel- and BEV-based feature extraction, our architecture is faster and can handle different input resolutions by design. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 show that our method achieves completion performance on par with the state of the art while completing a full scene in 0.1 seconds, which is 2.3 times faster than the fastest prior method. This matches the 10 Hz acquisition rate of typical automotive LiDAR sensors, taking a step toward real-time LiDAR scene completion.

</details>


### [181] [MLLM-Guided Semantic Correction for Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16513)
*Junhao Chen,Zheqi Lv,Keting Yin,Shengyu Zhang,Zhou Zhao,Feiyang Chen,Xinyu Duan,Baoxing Huai,Fei Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的可解释中期生成纠正框架，通过将多模态大语言模型反馈注入扩散采样循环，在视频合成过程中持续自我反思以纠正语义偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到视频生成模型常出现缺失对象、错误属性或动作不匹配等语义错误。已有的语义纠正方法要么在采样前优化、要么在采样后细化，缺乏在生成过程中实时检测和纠正语义偏差的机制。

Method: 提出训练无关的生成中期纠正框架，包含两个核心模块：(1)语义评估监督器，生成中间预览帧用于语义评估和偏差诊断；(2)语义修改助手，通过可控的潜在轨迹干预在推理期间纠正语义漂移。该方法将MLLM反馈直接注入扩散采样循环，实现扩散轨迹纠正。

Result: 在多个基准上的广泛实验验证了该方法在语义对齐、视觉保真度和时间一致性方面的有效性，且无需修改模型参数。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了视频生成中期语义纠正的空白，证明了在扩散采样过程中引入持续自我反思机制可以有效提升文本到视频生成的质量。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models and Transformer architectures have led to significant progress in text-to-video generation. However, these models often suffer from semantic errors such as missing objects, incorrect attributes, or mismatched actions. Although some semantic correction methods perform optimization before sampling or refinement after sampling, how to detect and correct semantic deviations during the video generation process remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a training-free, interpretable mid-generation correction framework that integrates multimodal large language model (MLLM) feedback directly into the diffusion sampling loop. Our framework achieves diffusion trajectory correction by injecting semantic evaluation signals during video synthesis, enabling the model to optimize the generated content through continuous self-reflection. We propose two key modules: a Semantic Assessment Supervisor that generates intermediate preview frames for semantic evaluations and deviation diagnostics, and a Semantic Modification Assistant that corrects semantic drift during inference via a controllable latent trajectory intervention. Our method improves semantic alignment, visual fidelity, and temporal consistency without modifying model parameters. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks.

</details>


### [182] [Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16514)
*Mohamed Amine Kerkouri,Marouane Tliba,Aladine Chetouani,Ulas Bagci,Alessandro Bruno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文比较了三种通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）与人类在目标导向视觉搜索（COCO-Search18）中的眼球运动扫描路径，采用逐注视点驱动、人类匹配的中央凹视觉输入。结果发现模型在目标存在判断和获取效率上达到或超过人类水平，但其注视过程具有低熵、大幅度、高度自洽的签名，与人类的序列化搜索过程存在本质差异，即便是视网膜输入匹配也无法恢复人类式的时间搜索行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉搜索是序列化的：中央凹必须落在候选目标上以确认，这些落点形成扫描路径。作者希望探究给定相同的中央凹输入时，多模态大语言模型是否以类似人类的方式搜索，这关系到MLLM作为人类视觉模型的适用性以及注意力对齐分数的有效性。

Method: 使用COCO-Search18数据集，将三种通用MLLM与人类眼动扫描路径进行比较。方法上以逐注视点（fixation by fixation）的方式驱动每个模型通过一个与人类匹配的中央凹视图，并沿三个维度评估：目标存在性决策、到达目标的效率、注视过程本身。

Result: 三个维度发生分离。在决策和目标获取上模型达到或超过人类——目标存在检测接近天花板水平，且比人类更常在首次扫视即到达目标。但注视过程不像人类：所有三种模型共享低熵、大幅度、自洽的扫描路径签名，模型自身的一致性远高于两个人之间的一致性。视网膜输入匹配虽能复制人类看的地方，但无法复制看的时序展开方式，且没有任何退化机制能同时恢复人类式搜索和人类式成功率。

Conclusion: 模型与人类的差距位于过程轴上，而这一维度是答案对齐和显著性指标无法衡量的。由于这些指标忽略了过程轴，它们不能证明类人视觉能力；零样本模型适用于结果级和空间级问题，但不适用于时间级、过程级问题。

Abstract: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

</details>


### [183] [FLEET: Token-Based Feature Extraction for Event Camera-based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16523)
*Tristan Gottwald,Maximilian Schier,Melanie Schaller,Bodo Rosenhahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FLEET（Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization），一种直接处理事件相机异步稀疏数据流的特征提取器，利用随机傅里叶特征和交叉注意力将可变长度的事件序列压缩为固定尺寸的潜在表示，将推理成本与传感器分辨率解耦，实现无辅助损失的端到端强化学习，并在新基准上超越SOTA且对观测频率变化具有更强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有异步、高频、稀疏信息与低延迟等理想特性，但现有强化学习方法未能充分利用这些优势：CNN方法将事件聚合为稀疏网格，既使计算成本耦合于传感器分辨率，又模糊了时间信息；现有生成式基线则依赖轨迹数据预训练，限制了端到端学习。

Method: 提出FLEET特征提取器，直接处理事件序列而非聚合为网格。采用随机傅里叶特征和交叉注意力机制，将可变长度的事件流压缩为固定大小的潜在表示，从而将骨干网络的推理成本与传感器分辨率解耦，支持无需辅助损失的端到端学习。

Result: 在一个新的高通量基准上验证了FLEET，结果表明基于序列的方法超越了当前SOTA性能，且在观测频率变化下展现出更优越的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FLEET证明了直接序列级处理事件数据在强化学习中的有效性和优越性，克服了传统网格聚合方法的计算效率缺陷和时间信息丢失问题，为事件相机驱动的控制策略设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Event cameras generate asynchronous, high-frequency data streams offering spatially sparse information at lower latency than traditional cameras.In principle, these properties should be ideal for the design of control policies.However, reinforcement learning research in this field remains limited as existing approaches fail to fully exploit the sensor's properties.CNN-based methods negate the sensors benefits by aggregating events into sparse grids. This couples compute cost to sensor resolution and blurs the temporal information. Meanwhile, existing generative baselines rely on the availability of trajectory data to pretrain the model. We propose FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization), a feature extractor that processes event sequences directly. Leveraging random Fourier features and cross-attention, our architecture compresses variable streams into fixed-size latent representations. This decouples inference cost of the feature extractor's backbone from the sensor's resolution, enabling end-to-end learning without auxiliary losses. We validate FLEET on a new, high-throughput benchmark. The results demonstrate that our sequence-based approach surpasses SOTA performance and exhibits superior robustness to variations in observation frequencies.

</details>


### [184] [Automatic Cephalometric Landmark Localization on CBCT-Derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs for Skeletal Malocclusion Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16535)
*Benjamin Hou,Konstantinia Almpani,Janice S. Lee,Zhiyong Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CephViT，一种基于Vision Transformer的模型，用于自动化2D侧位头颅X光片的标志点定位。在公开数据集上达到1.28mm的平均径向误差和92.0%的3mm内检测成功率。在3D CBCT扫描生成的DRR图像上同样有效，骨骼错颌分类准确率达70.0%，与人工标注的68.3%相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统头颅测量标志点的人工标注工作量大、难以规模化，需要自动化解决方案以提高效率并支持下游临床应用。<ivy<invoke name="Structure">

Method: 采用Vision Transformer架构CephViT进行2D头颅侧位片标志点定位；对于3D CBCT数据，通过生成侧位片样式的DRR图像作为2D输入；将标志点坐标归一化到统一坐标框架，并利用参考管道与DRR管道共享的标志点进行骨骼错颌分类。

Result: 在公开数据集上CephViT平均径向误差为1.28±1.42mm，3.0mm内成功检测率92.0%；使用DRR定位标志点的分类准确率为70.0%，与人工标注参考标志点的68.3%相当。

Conclusion: 自动化的头颅测量分析在CBCT衍生的DRR图像上具有可行性，可用于骨骼错颌评估。

Abstract: Manual cephalometric landmark annotation is important for craniofacial assessment but is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce CephViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for automated 2D lateral cephalometric landmark localization, and evaluate its use in downstream skeletal malocclusion classification. CephViT was trained and benchmarked on a public lateral cephalogram dataset, achieving a mean radial error of 1.28 +/- 1.42 mm and a successful detection rate of 92.0% at 3.0 mm. Because the private evaluation cohort consisted of 3D CBCT scans, lateral cephalogram-like digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated from each volume and used as 2D inputs to the landmark localization model. Landmark coordinates were normalized into a common coordinate frame, and skeletal malocclusion classification was performed using landmarks shared between the reference and DRR-based pipelines. Classification performance using DRR-localized landmarks was comparable to that obtained using manually annotated reference landmarks, with accuracies of 70.0% and 68.3%, respectively. These results support the feasibility of automated cephalometric analysis on CBCT-derived DRRs for skeletal malocclusion assessment.

</details>


### [185] [Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16546)
*Zikang Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GalerkinFlow 是一个与方程无关的超分辨率框架，通过在粗-细重建路径上对中间状态进行监督，将每个粗-细配对转化为整条重建路径的训练信号，并在纳维-斯托克斯、达西流和 DIV2K 数据集上取得了优异的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数超分辨率模型仅监督最终高分辨率输出，缺乏对预测从下采样观测到精细目标之间演化过程的控制，导致中间重建路径缺乏有效监督。

Method: GalerkinFlow 在重建路径上随机采样中间状态，让模型预测粗到细的残差速度，并利用粗锚点定义伪端点。中间状态的伪端点重建损失与中间速度损失通过已知时间相关权重精确关联，使每个中间状态都面向同一精细目标监督。此外还监督一步推理中使用的粗端点，并用有限差分目标约束局部空间变化。模型结合卷积特征与尺度条件化的 Galerkin 算子混合，无需控制方程或物理元数据。

Result: 在纳维-斯托克斯和达西流数据集上，GalerkinFlow 在所评估的与方程无关基线上实现了最低的原始空间误差，并在 DIV2K 上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过在重建路径上提供密集监督，GalerkinFlow 展示了无需物理方程即可有效提升超分辨率性能的潜力，在科学数据集上优于方程无关基线并具备跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target. We introduce GalerkinFlow, an equation-agnostic framework that turns each coarse--fine pair into supervision along an entire reconstruction path. At a random sample of intermediate states on the reconstruction path, the model predicts the coarse-to-fine residual velocity and uses coarse-anchor point to define a pseudo-endpoint. We show that the reconstruction loss of this pseudo-endpoint is exactly related to the intermediate velocity loss through a known time-dependent weight. Consequently, every intermediate state contributes supervision toward the same fine target, rather than serving only as an internal step toward an endpoint loss. Because intermediate states already reveal part of the missing fine-scale structure, we additionally supervise the coarse endpoint used during one-step inference. A finite-difference objective further constrains local spatial variation. GalerkinFlow combines convolutional features with scale-conditioned Galerkin operator mixing and requires no governing equation or physical metadata. It achieves the lowest raw-space errors among the evaluated equation-agnostic baselines on Navier--Stokes and Darcy Flow, while remaining competitive on DIV2K.

</details>


### [186] [SQuad: Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation for Efficient Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16585)
*Animesh Karnewar,Denis Korzhenkov,Amirhossein Habibian,Mohsen Ghafoorian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SQuad是一个用于视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的子二次注意力蒸馏框架，将计算复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n√n)，通过对预训练的全softmax自注意力教师进行两阶段蒸馏（Flow-Matching SFT + DMD2），在Wan 2.2 5B模型上匹配教师性能（VBench 83.20 vs 83.08），同时将注意力FLOPs减少67倍、注意力延迟减少11倍、端到端DiT延迟减少2倍，并仅用6个NFEs生成视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频DiT中自注意力计算的O(n²)复杂度随token数n增长，严重限制生成分辨率和时长。现存的线性O(n)和低秩O(nk)自注意力替代方案虽降低了计算成本，但难以恢复原始softmax注意力的表达能力，存在顽固的质量差距。

Method: 提出SQuad框架，将注意力复杂度控制在O(n√n)，在效率与表达力之间取得平衡。通过两阶段蒸馏将预训练的全softmax自注意力DiT适配到SQuad-Attention架构：第一阶段为Flow-Matching监督微调（SFT），第二阶段为改进的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD2），同时提升采样效率。

Result: 在Wan 2.2 5B文本到视频模型上，SQuad匹配二次复杂度教师模型的VBench得分（83.20 vs 83.08），同时将每步每块注意力FLOPs减少约67倍、注意力延迟减少约11倍、端到端DiT延迟减少2倍，并将生成所需NFEs从默认100步降至仅6步。

Conclusion: SQuad证明了通过有效的蒸馏策略，亚二次复杂度的注意力架构能够在不牺牲生成质量的前提下，大幅削减视频DiT的计算和推理成本，同时显著加速采样过程。

Abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) spend most of their compute inside the Self-Attention operation, whose cost grows quadratically, $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$, with the number of latent tokens $n$. For the task of video generation, the token count is large, so this term dominates runtime and memory, and thereby caps the resolution and duration we can generate. Linear $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and low-rank $\mathcal{O}(nk)$ surrogates of Self-Attention trade the full softmax $QK^T$ for cheaper kernels, but rarely recover the original's expressivity, leaving a stubborn quality gap. Motivated by this, we propose SQuad, a Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation framework that achieves a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n\sqrt{n})$ in the resulting distilled Attention, naturally balancing the efficiency v/s expressivity trade-off. Instead of training our own Video DiT from scratch, which is prohibitively expensive, we fit a pretrained full softmax Self-Attention DiT into our proposed SQuad-Attention one by distilling the former in two stages: Flow-Matching Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by improved Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) which additionally makes the sampling more efficient. On the Wan~2.2 5B text-to-video model, SQuAD matches the quadratic teacher on VBench ($83.20$ v/s $83.08$) while cutting the per-step per-block attention FLOPs by $\sim$$67\times$ and attention latency by $\sim$$11\times$, and end-to-end DiT latency by 2$\times$, all while also generating a video in only $6$ Neural Functional Evaluations (NFEs) instead of the default $100$.

</details>


### [187] [Ultra: Unsupervised Cross-Task Optimization for Reliable Restoration Segmentation Collaboration under Adverse Weather](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16589)
*Shiqin Wang,Zhiqian Li,Haoyuan Du,Junming Chen,Jiayuan Li,Tianrun Xu,Haoyang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Ultra框架，将无监督域自适应中的恢复-分割跨任务交互重新定义为不确定性下的方向选择与因果效应估计问题，通过CTDN生成候选优化方向并进行协作方向选择，通过CMIL将跨任务信息传递从相关性传播转变为因果效应评估以抑制幻觉传播，在三个UDA-ASS基准上取得最先进的分割性能，同时提升无监督恢复效果并泛化到其他协作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督域自适应（UDA-ASS）方法隐式假设恢复和分割提供相互有益的信息，但在严重退化且缺乏目标域监督的情况下，跨任务优化方向的有效性从根本上无法识别，导致由幻觉驱动的错误传播。

Method: 提出Ultra（Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework）框架，包含两个核心模块：CTDN利用互补的视觉结构和语义信息生成候选优化方向，并在恢复与分割间进行协作方向选择；CMIL将跨任务信息传递从相关性传播重构为因果效应评估，以抑制幻觉传播。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的UDA-ASS基准上取得最先进的分割性能；相比现有UDA-ASS恢复方法取得了更好的无监督恢复结果；该框架还泛化到无监督恢复与目标检测的协作任务。

Conclusion: 通过将跨任务交互建模为方向选择与因果效应估计，能够实现可靠的无监督恢复-分割协作，有效抑制幻觉驱动的错误传播，并在分割、恢复及多种下游协作任务中均展现出优越性能。

Abstract: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Adverse Weather Semantic Segmentation (UDA-ASS) aims to transfer semantic knowledge from labeled normal-weather images to unlabeled adverse environments. Existing approaches implicitly assume that restoration and segmentation provide mutually beneficial guidance. However, under severe degradation and without target-domain supervision, the validity of cross-task optimization directions becomes fundamentally unidentifiable, leading to hallucination-driven error propagation. In this work, we propose a novel Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework (Ultra), which reframes cross-task interaction as direction selection under uncertainty and causal effect estimation, enabling reliable collaboration through candidate direction generation and intervention-based filtering. In detail, we propose CTDN and CMIL. The former exploits complementary visual structures and semantic information to generate candidate optimization directions and performs cooperative direction selection between restoration and segmentation. The latter reformulates cross-task information transfer from correlation-based propagation into causal effect assessment, suppressing hallucination propagation. Extensive experiments on three widely used UDA-ASS benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Beyond segmentation, our framework achieves better unsupervised restoration results than existing UDA-ASS restoration methods and generalizes to unsupervised restoration and object detection collaboration tasks. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra.

</details>


### [188] [Towards Zero-Shot Domain Generalization for ID Cards Presentation Attack Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16591)
*Mario Nieto-Hidalgo,Juan M. Espin,Juan E. Tapia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原型网络（Prototypical Network）的演示攻击检测（PAD）方法，使用EfficientNet-V2-b0骨干网络，每类仅需4张真实样本即可建立可靠原型，并通过情景训练（episodic training）分离PAD类别与卡片域，实现在多国数据集和DLC-2021基准上平均约9%的等错误率（EER），优于softmax和CLIP零样本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 国家身份证件的演示攻击检测受限于缺乏公开的真实样本，导致系统难以在不同国家之间泛化。现有方法需要大量真实数据进行训练，而获取跨国家的身份证件真实样本存在隐私和收集成本方面的困难。

Method: 提出两项核心创新：(1) 基于EfficientNet-V2-b0骨干网络的原型网络头部，每类仅需4个真实样本即可构建可靠类别原型；(2) 情景训练机制，保持PAD类别固定而变换卡片域，使网络学习通用的攻击线索（universal attack cues），而非特定国家或卡片类型的特征。

Result: 在大型多国数据集及公开DLC-2021基准上，该方法实现了平均约9%的等错误率（EER），在仅使用单一来源国家数据的情况下，性能仍优于传统softmax和CLIP零样本基线。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持准确性的同时实现隐私保护的PAD，且大幅减少了数据收集需求，有助于实现可扩展的跨司法管辖区远程入职（remote onboarding）场景。

Abstract: Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) for national ID cards is limited by the lack of publicly available genuine samples, making it difficult for systems to generalize across countries. This paper introduces two main innovations: (1) a Prototypical Network head using an EfficientNet-V2-b0 backbone that requires only four genuine samples per class to create reliable prototypes; and (2) an episodic training regime that keeps PAD classes fixed while varying the card domain, allowing the network to learn universal attack cues.
  Evaluated on a large multi-country dataset and the public DLC-2021 benchmark, this method achieves an average Equal Error Rate of around 9\%, outperforming conventional softmax and CLIP zero-shot baselines even with data from a single source country. This approach provides accurate, privacy-preserving PAD while minimizing data collection, facilitating scalable cross-jurisdictional remote onboarding.

</details>


### [189] [GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16600)
*Rudolf L. M. van Herten,Robert Graf,Paula Feldman,Johannes C. Paetzold*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoPose是一种基于人群训练的框架，用于将术中美式双平面DSA图像与术前CTA进行3D到2D的快速精准配准。它通过学习到的规范坐标系估计C臂姿态，并通过投影空间校准和变换组合将其迁移到未见CTA的原生坐标系中，无需患者特异性训练或显式的体间预配准。在20名留出患者的80个DSA观测上，免优化模式下mPCD达到5.8 mm、clDice为0.45（仅需0.15秒），经25次优化迭代后进一步达到4.6 mm和0.58（约2秒），大幅优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术中双平面DSA与术前CTA的3D到2D配准需要兼顾速度和精度。现有基于优化的方法对初始化敏感且需大量迭代，而基于学习的方法通常依赖患者特异性训练，无法泛化到未见患者。作者旨在提出一种无需患者适配、无需显式体间预配准的群体级训练框架，实现快速稳健的原生坐标系配准。

Method: GeoPose包含三个核心组件：(1) 在学习的规范坐标系中估计C臂姿态；(2) 通过投影空间校准和变换组合，将规范坐标系下的姿态迁移到未见CTA的原生坐标系；(3) 采用人群训练的残差网络优化姿态，并可选地在低预算下进行图像驱动优化微调。该方法无需患者特异性适应，也不要求显式的体间预配准。

Result: 在20名留出患者的80个DSA观测上，免优化的GeoPose达到颈动脉平均投影中心线距离(mPCD)为5.8 mm、clDice为0.45（仅0.15秒），优于最佳基线（14.5 mm和0.28）。经25次优化迭代后，GeoPose达到mPCD 4.6 mm和clDice 0.58（约2秒）；相同预算下原生初始化优化仅达14.6 mm和0.15。

Conclusion: GeoPose实现了固定人群级权重下快速的原生坐标系配准，提供了下游双平面3D血管重建所需的几何对应关系，在速度和精度上均显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.

</details>


### [190] [Interactive Whole Slide Images for RL-based Tumour Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16607)
*Mohamad Mohamad,Francesco Ponzio,Maxime Gassier,Nicolas Pote,Xavier Descombes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于强化学习的端到端框架，直接在整张全切片图像上进行序贯性肿瘤分割，通过agent在分层多分辨率环境中导航（移动、缩放、选择肿瘤），在肺腺癌WSI上达到与patch方法相当的粗分割质量，同时将推理时间缩短至每张数秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSI分析因图像分辨率极高且肿瘤区域稀疏分布而计算开销巨大。现有方法通常将WSI预处理为候选patch集合进行处理，忽略了全片上下文且引入大量冗余计算。需要一个能够直接在全尺寸WSI上进行高效、全局感知的分割方法。

Method: 将WSI建模为分层多分辨率环境，设计端到端强化学习agent，采用actor-critic架构（基于PPO算法训练）。agent可在环境中执行移动（navigation）、缩放（zooming）和肿瘤选择（tumour selection）三类动作，同时处理局部观察与全局缩略图表示，实现序贯式肿瘤分割。

Result: 在肺腺癌WSI上的实验表明：该方法能直接在完整WSI上实现序贯肿瘤分割，其粗分割质量与同放大倍数下的patch方法相当，但推理时间降至每张幻灯片仅数秒。此外分析了环境设计与动作空间粒度对性能的影响。

Conclusion: 将WSI建模为交互式环境为基于强化学习的计算病理学提供了有前景的方向，表明RLagent能够在全尺寸WSI上直接实现高效的分割，而非依赖预定义patch集合。

Abstract: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis remains computationally challenging due to the extremely large spatial resolution of slides and the sparse distribution of tumour regions. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for sequential tumour segmentation directly on WSIs. Instead of treating the slide as a predefined collection of candidate patches, we formulate the WSI itself as a hierarchical multi-resolution environment through which an agent navigates using movement, zooming, and tumour selection actions. The agent jointly processes local observations and a global thumbnail representation within an actor-critic architecture trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO). Experiments on pulmonary adenocarcinoma WSIs demonstrate the feasibility of direct sequential tumour segmentation on full slides, achieving comparable coarse segmentation quality relative to patch-based approaches operating at similar magnification levels, while reducing inference time to a few seconds per slide. We further analyse the impact of environment design and action-space granularity. Our results suggest that modelling WSIs as interactive environments provides a promising direction for RL-based computational pathology

</details>


### [191] [Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16614)
*Nils Lehmann,Jakob Gawlikowski,Burak Ekim,Isaac Corley,Xiao Xiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统性地批判了当前地理空间基础模型（GeoFMs）仅以平均精度排名作为评估标准的做法，指出该协议过于狭隘。通过对16个冻结编码器、4个分类和5个分割数据集的广泛实验，作者发现EO预训练和ImageNet预训练模型在干净精度和校准上无显著差异，但在分布偏移下EO模型表现出更严重的过度自信问题。CKA分析揭示EO预训练嵌入的表征刚性是这一问题的根源。温度缩放和深度集成无法缓解退化，高斯过程探针虽能大幅降低严重云遮挡下的ECE却同时使干净数据上的ECE翻三倍。作者最终主张评估应跨越多种条件和指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前GeoFMs的评估主要依赖标准基准条件下的平均精度排名，但这种单一指标的评估无法反映模型在真实地球观测（EO）任务部署中的可靠性。模型在干净数据上的高精度并不能保证其在面对分布偏移（如云遮挡、传感器变化）时保持可靠的置信度输出。校准（模型置信度与正确率的一致性）作为评估的重要维度长期被忽视，这导致模型在关键任务中的"过度自信"问题未被充分暴露。

Method: 作者设计了多维度的系统性评估框架：(1) 在16个冻结编码器上，跨越4个分类和5个分割数据集的综合实验；(2) 从两个正交压力轴（corruption强度与类型）评估模型退化；(3) 比较干净精度与干净校准，以及分布偏移下的稳定性；(4) 使用中心核对齐（CKA）分析表征变化，将校准问题与表征刚性联系起来；(5) 应用三种不确定性量化方法（温度缩放、深度集成、高斯过程探针）并评估其在缓解过度自信方面的效果；(6) 进行选择性预测实验，检验基于置信度的弃权机制的有效性。

Result: 实验发现：(1) 所有编码器随corruption加剧均发生退化，且排名发生变化；(2) EO预训练与ImageNet预训练在干净精度和干净校准上不可区分，偏移下EO预训练也未见更多稳定性；(3) 在偏移下GeoFMs比ImageNet预训练编码器在所有等级和所有corruption族中都更加过度自信；(4) CKA表明EO预训练嵌入在corruption下移动更少（表征刚性），但损失相同任务信息且保持过度自信；(5) 温度缩放和深度集成无法对抗退化，高斯过程探针在严重云遮挡下将ECE减半但干净数据上ECE翻三倍；(6) 基于置信度的弃权无法延迟围绕错误预测的置信，即无法可靠识别"自信地错误"的样本。

Conclusion: 仅以干净数据精度排名作为GeoFMs的评估标准是不充分的，无法反映真实部署场景下的可靠性问题。基准评估应跨越多种条件和指标，综合考量精度、校准、稳定性、表征变化及不确定性量化的有效性，才能更全面地衡量模型发展并缩小与实际部署场景的差距。EO预训练带来的收益在标准基准上被高估，需要更严格的评估标准引导GeoFMs的健康发展。

Abstract: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.

</details>


### [192] [HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16622)
*Yujia Li,Yiqun Zhang,Zihan Cheng,Yijie Huang,Tenglong Ye,Zihan Wang,Xiaocui Yang,Shi Feng,Yifei Zhang,Daling Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多模态有害表情包检测的细粒度目标识别任务，引入 Meme3W 数据集（统一多个公开有害表情包数据集并提供人工标注）和 Joint Record Accuracy (JRA) 严格评估指标。提出了 HarmTrace 框架，通过实体感知监督微调和条件目标识别策略优化 (CTPO) 解耦危害性与目标识别优化，在多个骨干模型上显著提升 JRA 和危害性准确率（Qwen3-VL-8B 上 JRA 从 17.58% 提升至 52.51%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态有害表情包检测仅做图像-文本二分类危害性判断，模型可能正确预测危害性却错误识别攻击目标或支持证据，缺乏细粒度的目标识别能力，无法实现真正可靠的有害内容检测。

Method: 1) 构建 Meme3W 数据集，统一多个公开数据集并提供人工验证的细粒度标注；2) 提出 Joint Record Accuracy (JRA) 作为严格记录级评估指标；3) 提出 HarmTrace 框架，包含实体感知监督微调 (entity-aware SFT) 和条件目标识别策略优化 (CTPO)，CTPO 解耦危害性与目标识别优势，仅对危害性标签正确的有害样本进行目标识别优化，并使用虚拟正锚点 (VPA) 作为完全正确的参考进行优势归一化。

Result: 实验表明代表性多模态大语言模型在危害性准确率与 JRA 之间存在显著差距；HarmTrace 在多个骨干模型上同时提升 JRA 和危害性准确率，其中 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干的 JRA 从 17.58% 提升至 52.51%。

Conclusion: 细粒度目标识别是多模态有害表情包检测的关键补充任务，HarmTrace 通过解耦危害性与目标识别优化能够有效缩小两者之间的性能差距，为有害内容检测提供了更严格、更可解释的评估范式。

Abstract: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.

</details>


### [193] [DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16632)
*Divine Yao Agbobli,Geoffery Eyram Agorku,Israel Afriyie,Kwadwo Amankwah-Nkyi,Marvin Osei-Kuffour,Richmond Owusu Duah,Bright Seglah,Kelvin Asamoah Terkper,Kwabena Amoako Adjei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出域鲁棒非对称融合集成框架（DRAFE），该框架结合两个独立训练的检测器（LW-DETR和RF-DETR）实现跨城市细粒度交通目标检测。通过两阶段训练策略（先在多源公开数据集上预训练，再在目标任务上微调），以及推理阶段的多重融合策略（锚定条件匹配、可靠性加权融合等），在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上取得0.4022 mAP，排名第6。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的交通目标检测器在智能交通系统中至关重要，但同时在细粒度车辆识别和跨城市域泛化方面取得良好表现仍具挑战性，因此需要一种能在不同城市场景下保持鲁棒性的检测方案。

Method: DRAFE采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段在多样公开交通数据集上利用伪标签扩展和人机协作标注精修，构建包含6,049张图像和203,619个标注的精选数据集来预训练互补检测器；第二阶段在Project Hafnia Track 6数据集上进行符合竞赛要求的微调。推理时采用锚定条件的类别一致性匹配、可靠性加权坐标融合、一致性感知置信度重校准和互补假设恢复四种策略来融合两个检测器的输出。

Result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6上，DRAFE取得0.4022 mAP，在25支参赛队伍中排名第6，相比初步集成方案提升了0.0553 mAP。

Conclusion: DRAFE通过将独立训练的互补检测器与多策略推理融合相结合，有效解决了细粒度车辆识别与跨城市域泛化之间的平衡问题，验证了非对称集成在域鲁棒交通目标检测中的有效性。

Abstract: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.

</details>


### [194] [Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16646)
*Roman Demchenko,Jonas Ricker,Asja Fischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两种针对基于自编码器重建误差的AI生成图像检测器的对抗攻击方法，发现通过构造不易察觉的对抗样本可以人为增大原图与重建图之间的距离，导致伪造图像被错误分类为真实图像。实验表明攻击能显著降低检测性能，且攻击样本可跨检测器迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重建式检测器作为一种透明且无需训练的合成图像检测方法被广泛使用，但其与传统分类器的运作方式根本不同，其对抗鲁棒性尚不明确。作者希望探究这类检测器在对抗攻击下的脆弱性。

Method: 提出两种针对利用自编码器重建误差的检测器的攻击方法：通过构造人眼不可察觉的对抗扰动，人为增大原始图像与重建图像之间的距离，使伪造图像被误判为真实图像。实验涉及三个SOTA生成器和三个检测器。

Result: 攻击能显著降低重建式检测器的检测性能，即使被攻击图像额外经过真实世界退化处理仍有效。对抗样本天然地跨检测器迁移，因为所有此类检测器共享相同的检测原理。

Conclusion: 重建式检测器存在固有的安全漏洞，这种漏洞源于其共享的统一检测范式，而非特定实现。这一发现表明重建式检测器在实际部署场景中面临严重的安全挑战。

Abstract: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.

</details>


### [195] [Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16681)
*Shanwen Wang,Xin Sun,Danfeng Hong,Junyu Dong,Patrick Le Callet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UFFM方法，通过统一流（UF）结合外部视觉基础模型与遥感域教师生成更少偏差的伪标签，并引入特征记忆库（FMB）动态更新类特征以缩小有标签与无标签数据间的特征差异，在遥感半监督语义分割任务上超越现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半监督语义分割虽利用大量无标签数据减少人工标注负担，但独立训练有标签和无标签数据会导致有标签数据主导训练过程，严重降低伪标签质量，这是当前方法面临的核心挑战。

Method: UFFM包含两大创新：1）统一流（UF）——一种新的训练流程，结合外部视觉基础模型与遥感域教师生成偏差更小的伪标签，并在统一的训练目标下联合优化标记和伪标记数据；2）特征记忆库（FMB）——一种新颖的内存模块，在训练过程中动态更新类别特定特征，并通过类别特征对齐缩小有标签与无标签数据间的特征差异。

Result: 在遥感数据集上的大量实验表明，UFFM方法优于现有SOTA半监督语义分割方法，同时验证了该方法在弥合有标签与无标签数据之间的优化鸿沟和特征表示鸿沟方面的有效性。

Conclusion: UFFM通过统一训练流程和特征记忆库两个关键设计，有效解决了半监督语义分割中有标签数据主导导致伪标签质量下降的问题，并为遥感领域提供了更优的解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

</details>


### [196] [AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16690)
*Yan Ma,Lizhuo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了AnchorScore（基于每类零样本CLIP准确率的全帧计算形式）作为先验诊断指标，用于预测多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在自动标注任务中各类别标注难度。在SCB5（13类、6个MLLM）上，AnchorScore与每类MLLM准确率显著相关（Spearman rho=0.769），在Stanford40 Actions上复现了类似效果（rho=0.817），并催生了混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略（可节省约44%的MLLM开销），但AnchorScore不精确估计MLLM准确率，仅提供低成本的类别难度排序信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在自动标注中各类别准确率差异悬殊（如13类中准确率从12%到98%不等），但评估MLLM逐类准确率成本极高——评估一个27B MLLM在5416张验证图像上需约14小时，而冻结CLIP推理仅需约3分钟。因此需要一种低成本的先验信号来预先排序各类的MLLM标注难度，将昂贵的评估资源集中于最可能出错的类别。

Method: 基于companion study提出的AnchorProxy概念（每类零样本CLIP准确率），本文将其全帧形式定义为AnchorScore，作为先验诊断指标。在SCB5数据集（13类、6个MLLM）上与每类MLLM准确率计算Spearman相关；与DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP及MLLM自述不确定性等替代难度预测器对比；通过跨模型共识控制验证AnchorScore主要捕捉共享的类别难度因子而非CLIP特有信号；并在Stanford40 Actions等独立数据集上复制验证；最后开发了混合CLIP/MLLM路由策略等三种实际应用。

Result: AnchorScore与每类MLLM准确率的Spearman相关为0.769（p=0.002, n=13），显著优于所有替代难度预测器（DINOv2、ResNet-50、SigLIP、MLLM自述不确定性均未达到显著水平）。跨模型共识控制表明AnchorScore捕捉的是共享类别难度因子。Stanford40 Actions独立复现的rho=0.817（p<0.001），但该关联在动作识别数据上最强，在医学及卫星图像上减弱。实际应用中，预测类路由策略相比纯CLIP最高提升+23个百分点，同时节省约44%的MLLM成本。

Conclusion: AnchorScore作为一种低成本先验信号，能够有效排序MLLM各类别标注难度，指导昂贵的MLLM评估资源配置到信息量最大的类别上。它不替代精确的MLLM准确率估计，而是为有监督的多模态标注流水线提供高效的难度预判和路由决策依据。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably.
  On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery.
  Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.

</details>


### [197] [MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16709)
*Vignesh Nagarajan,Sriram Venkatapathy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIRROR是一个研究原型，将多标签分类器、Grad-CAM定位器和报告生成器链式连接，其中语言模块无法看到图像像素，从而确保报告中的发现可追溯、可审计，同时展示了在类别不平衡下聚合指标对无作为模型的过高评估问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射科医生在阅读模型输出时面临两个问题：模型只返回数字而不给出理由；将数字转换为可读文本的系统可能悄悄添加模型从未做出的断言。MIRROR旨在分离这两类故障，使报告的可信度可审计。

Method: MIRROR链式组合三个模块：多标签分类器、Grad-CAM定位器（将每个阳性发现转换为命名解剖区域）、以及报告生成器（仅接收标签、概率和区域，从不见图像）。语言层无法看到像素，因此不能断言分类器未曾做出的发现。一个注册表统一管理胸片、脑MRI和头CT的分类学、解剖学和措辞，添加模态只需数据修改。

Result: 在ChestMNIST上，分类器达到macro AUROC 0.729，14个标签全部优于随机排序，精度为随机排序的1.6至6.8倍。然而在默认0.5阈值下，11个标签无阳性预测；其Brier分数0.045与忽略图像的预测器的0.047几乎相同。

Conclusion: 模型区分能力真实但决策不可靠。在放射学常见的类别不平衡下，聚合指标会美化不做任何事的模型，应在与无作为基线的对比下报告。

Abstract: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.

</details>


### [198] [PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16717)
*Yuji Wang,Yuheng Chen,Teng Hu,Ran Yi,Yijia Hong,Han Feng,Weijian Cao,Chengjie Wang,Lizhuang Ma,Jiangning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PersonaShot，这是首个面向多镜头视频生成中叙事连续性的以人物为中心的基准，包含约1000个多镜头片段和16项指标，跨越物理连续性、情感动态和电影语法三个维度，并设计了与专家人类判断对齐的轻量级专用评估器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估角色外观或单镜头质量，未测量跨镜头切割时物理与情感状态的一致性；同时缺乏针对不同指标（物理连续性、面部动态、电影关系需要不同的视觉、时间与关系证据）的准则化评估方法。

Method: 构建约1000个多镜头片段的PersonaShot基准，设计16项指标覆盖物理连续性、情感动态与电影语法；从大型多模态教师模型中蒸馏推理能力到轻量级准则专用评估器，每个评估器基于对应指标所需的视觉、时间或关系证据，并与人类专家评判对齐；从三个时间层面（镜头内状态、跨镜头转换、序列级轨迹）评估角色一致性。

Result: 系统评估揭示不同最先进模型具有不同的能力轮廓，并显示出感知质量与跨镜头叙事连续性之间存在明显差距：即使视觉上吸引人的视频也频繁出现物理状态重置、突发情感转变和跨镜头的电影关系断裂；人类研究表明评估器与专家判断高度一致。

Conclusion: PersonaShot 填补了多镜头叙事视频生成中人物叙事连续性评估的空白，证明了轻量级专用评估器能够以与人类专家一致的方式有效衡量叙事连续性，并指出当前模型在跨镜头叙事连贯性方面仍有显著提升空间。

Abstract: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.

</details>


### [199] [CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16718)
*Jialu Yao,Songhao Li,Alina Yu,Zhi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CytoFormer，一种细胞基础模型。它通过将成像型空间转录组学（Xenium）与H&E组织学配对（同一物理细胞同时获得分子身份与形态），利用15.4百万个细胞、23种细胞类型的数据进行监督训练，实现了细胞类型的直接识别。在空间留出组织上达到0.85准确率，且表征可迁移：冻结编码器后线性头在4个专家标注基准上优于6个病理基础模型。在主动学习场景中显著更节省标注，F1比最强基线高0.13。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从常规H&E组织学中识别细胞类型可以实现大规模单细胞分析，但此前训练此类模型依赖病理学家的手动标注，这些标注缓慢、昂贵且对许多细胞类型并不可靠。作者希望用分子监督取代人工监督，即以分子身份作为金标准来监督形态学特征，从而构建可扩展、可复用的细胞识别模型。

Method: 作者收集了81对Xenium空间转录组切片（横跨16个器官），通过聚类、标记基因注释、器官级人工审核与质控生成逐细胞标签，映射到各器官常见细胞类型，得到1540万细胞，每个细胞配有H&E图像块和23种细胞类型之一。在此基础上训练CytoFormer——一个带多任务、按器官分类头的基础模型。同时设计了主动学习交互式验证设置评估其嵌入的标注效率。

Result: 在空间留出组织上，CytoFormer达到0.85准确率和0.78 macro-F1（跨16个器官），预测能再现完整留出切片的组织架构。冻结编码器下，线性分类头在4个专家标注基准上胜过6个病理基础模型，包括预训练未覆盖的器官和细胞类型。在主动学习设置中，从极少标注即可检测正常上皮与相似肿瘤之间的差异，F1达0.82，比最强基线高出0.13。

Conclusion: CytoFormer将配对的H&E与空间转录组数据转化为可复用、标注高效的表征，用于常规组织学的细胞级分析，证明了"以分子监督形态"这一范式能够以大规模方式替代昂贵的人工病理标注，并具备跨器官、跨细胞类型的强大泛化能力。

Abstract: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.

</details>


### [200] [GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16721)
*Harold Haodong Chen,Zhiyu Hou,Wen-Jie Shu,Weilin Ruan,Yingjie Xu,Litao Guo,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenRouter是首个面向智能体图像生成的统一工作流路由框架，通过标准化不同智能体管道为通用原语（GenCanvas），并基于需求画像、经验匹配和Pareto过滤自适应地将异构提示路由到最优工作流，在保持视觉对齐的同时将执行成本降低95%以上、延迟降低65%，并支持自我进化实现零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体图像生成工作流虽然通过外部知识检索和迭代推理增强了静态推理能力，但它们大多在孤立的、固定"一刀切"拓扑结构中运行，导致严重的计算不匹配——简单查询被迫通过高计算开销的管道处理。作者旨在解决这一效率瓶颈，实现按需自适应路由。

Method: 首先提出GenCanvas，将多样化的智能体管道标准化为一组通用的基础原语和可执行模板；在此基础上，GenRouter通过三个核心机制在统一空间上自适应地将异构提示路由到最优工作流：(i)需求画像（demand profiling）、(ii)经验匹配（experience matching）以及(iii)Pareto过滤（Pareto filtering）。系统还通过积累的经验持续自我进化。

Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，与重型静态管道相比，GenRouter实现了优越的视觉对齐，同时执行成本降低超过95%，延迟降低65%。此外，系统通过积累的经验持续自我进化，实现稳健的零样本泛化，进一步提升了性能并将计算开销减半。

Conclusion: GenRouter验证了在智能体图像生成中引入统一工作流路由的可行性，通过将提示匹配到最合适的工作流，能够有效缓解计算不匹配问题，实现效率与质量的双重优化，并且具备自我进化能力以适应动态需求。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

</details>


### [201] [Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16725)
*Chiara Tappermann,Steffen Renisch,Lars Ole Schwen,Hans Meine,Horst K. Hahn,Eike Petersen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于无监督异常检测（AD）和分布外（OOD）检测的自动化数据质量保证机制，用于多中心动态对比增强乳腺MRI。作者构建了包含17种真实QA相关异常类型、基于人类视觉感知的放射学图像异常分类体系的受控基准，评估了四种方法（投影法、3D重建法及两种混合OOD方法）。结果显示3D重建方法在检测性能与跨机构泛化间取得最佳平衡（AUROC: 0.936），投影法取得最高检测性能（AUROC: 0.954），并揭示混合方法存在关键失效模式，植入物和乳房切除术对所有方法仍是开放性挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗AI中损坏、不一致或异常的数据会悄然威胁安全性与可靠性。尽管监管日益重视高风险医疗AI的数据集质量保证（QA），但可扩展的自动化检测仍不成熟。本文旨在填补这一空白，为医学AI流水线提供可扩展的无监督QA机制。

Method: 构建包含17种来自六个公共数据集的现实QA相关异常类型的受控AD基准（协议违规、处理错误、错误解剖区域），基于人类视觉感知提出放射学图像异常分类学。基准包含近OOD、中远OOD、远OOD样本及分布内和外部正常数据。评估四种方法：带域特定特征提取器和新型位置编码的投影法、扩展到完整3D体积并增强训练目标的重建法，以及两种未经修改的混合OOD检测方法。

Result: 中远和远OOD样本被可靠检测，而近OOD样本和来自未知机构的正常数据暴露了方法特异的差异。3D重建方法在检测性能（AUROC: 0.936）与未知机构泛化间达到最佳平衡；带位置编码的投影法达到最高整体检测性能（AUROC: 0.954）；两种混合方法均表现出关键失效模式，确认在没有域特定适配的情况下方法无法跨模态或解剖部位泛化。植入物和乳房切除术对所有方法仍是开放挑战。

Conclusion: 本研究的成果为医学AI流水线中可扩展的无监督QA建立了基础和实用指导，表明域特定适配对OOD检测方法泛化的必要性，同时指出了仍需攻克的问题（如植入物和乳房切除术案例）。

Abstract: Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
  We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods.
  Medium-far- and far-OOD samples are detected reliably, whereas near-OOD samples and external normal data from unseen institutions expose method-specific differences. The 3D reconstruction-based approach best balances detection performance (AUROC: 0.936) and generalization to unseen institutions. The projection-based method with positional encoding achieves the highest overall detection performance (AUROC: 0.954). Both hybrid methods exhibit critical failure modes, confirming that methods validated for one modality or anatomy may not generalize without domain-specific adaptation. Implants and mastectomies remain an open challenge for all methods. Our results establish a foundation and practical guidance on scalable unsupervised QA in medical AI pipelines.

</details>


### [202] [VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16745)
*Yuji Wang,Teng Hu,Yuheng Chen,Ran Yi,Han Feng,Weijian Cao,Chengjie Wang,Lizhuang Ma,Jiangning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Visual In-context Editing 新范式，将视频编辑从纯文本指令升级为多模态视觉引导（单图、图像对、视频对）。作者构建了首个大规模数据集 VicEdit-400K（含10种任务类型），并开发统一框架 VicEdit，通过 Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation 提取模态特定语义令牌，再用 Dual-Context Injection 与文本指令协同注入，在 VicEditBench 上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于指令的视频编辑虽有进展，但纯文本指令本质上难以表达细粒度纹理和复杂动态信息，存在感知鸿沟（perceptual gap），因此需要引入视觉多模态引导来弥补文本表达的不足。

Method: 1) 提出视觉上下文编辑范式，支持单图像、图像对和视频对三种视觉参考形式；2) 构建自动化数据管线，生成 400K 高质量样本（10种任务类型），并通过多维过滤保证视觉保真度和语义一致性；3) 设计统一框架 VicEdit，其中 Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation 从异构视觉参考中自适应提取每种模态的语义令牌，Dual-Context Injection 将视觉令牌与文本指令协同融合注入生成过程。

Result: 在 VicEditBench 上，VicEdit 在基础指令编辑和视觉上下文编辑两类任务上均达到最先进的性能，验证了视觉上下文学习作为视频编辑的可控且强大范式的有效性。

Conclusion: 视觉上下文学习为视频编辑提供了一种更可控、更强大的新范式，能有效弥补文本指令在表达细粒度视觉细节方面的局限，多模态引导优于单一文本引导。

Abstract: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.

</details>


### [203] [Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16748)
*Hieu D. Pham,Dang P. M. Cao,Thanh Trung Huynh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TCSR-Monitor是一种后置式失败监控框架，结合置信度与可观测的形状、时序一致性和图像质量线索，在不依赖模型内部信息或ground truth的情况下监控手术分割网络的失败。在EndoVis 2017数据集上，该方法优于基于置信度的基线，但存在高达40%的误报率，且零样本迁移至SAM2时熵指标表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术分割网络在采集退化下可能静默失败——即使模型置信度很高，预测掩码仍可能是错误的。现有的部署时监控器主要依赖不确定性估计，无法捕捉这类"高置信度但错误"的失败案例，因此需要更可靠的监控方法。

Method: 提出TCSR-Monitor（Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor），一种后置式失败监控框架。该方法包装冻结的分割模型，无需访问模型内部结构，部署时不依赖ground truth。融合四类信号：置信度、可观测的形状、时序一致性和图像质量线索。采用Mondrian共形校准来平衡不同退化严重度下的漏检率，并引入验证协议评估警报在分布偏移下的可信度。

Result: 在EndoVis 2017上的留一损坏评估中，TCSR-Monitor能泛化到未见过的采集退化，显著优于基于置信度的基线。环形性控制确认其预测的是分割失败而非简单检测损坏图像。Mondrian共形校准能平衡各退化严重度下的漏检率，但单一全局阈值在中等损坏下对高达40%正确分割的帧产生误报。零样本迁移到SAM2证明了特征可移植性，但熵指标在两个评估阈值下均优于迁移后的监控器。

Conclusion: 在采集退化下可靠的监控受益于置信度之外的互补可观测信号，但该方法仍存在显著的误报率和迁移局限性，表明该领域仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.

</details>


### [204] [Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16756)
*Tianyu Zhu,Ying Fu,Hesong Li,Gengchen Zhang,Xin Yuan,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BinRVR，一个用于RAW视频修复的二值化框架，通过BIIM和DAB-Conv分别建模时空信息与减轻量化误差，在降低约96%计算量和参数量的同时仅损失约4%性能，并支持多比特量化以实现精度-效率的灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAW视频修复是高质量低层感知的基础，但现有二值神经网络（BNNs）在视频场景中难以有效建模时序连贯性和激活值分布，导致其在视频修复任务中效果不佳。如何在保持二值化带来的高效部署优势的同时，克服这些缺陷以应用于RAW视频修复是核心动机。

Method: 提出BinRVR框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM)，以高效且统一的方式联合建模空间和时间信息；(2) Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv)，利用全精度激活值的统计信息来减轻量化误差。此外，框架支持多比特量化，可针对不同硬件约束实现精度-效率的灵活权衡。

Result: 实验表明，BinRVR在低光增强、去噪、去模糊和超分辨率等RAW视频修复任务上与最先进的二值化方法相比取得了竞争性表现，且降低了约96%的计算量和参数量，性能仅下降约4%。该方法还进一步探索了下游视频应用（目标检测和单目深度估计）的潜力。

Conclusion: BinRVR展示了二值化神经网络在RAW视频修复任务中的可行性，在极致的计算效率与可接受的性能损失之间取得了良好平衡，为边缘设备上的视频低层感知任务提供了有效的轻量化解决方案。

Abstract: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [205] [TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16765)
*Haoran Wang,Chaofan Ma,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 作者提出TRACE-Bench基准测试，从能力导向视角将多参考图像生成任务形式化为四种原子操作（Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose），构建包含约1600个评测样本的基准，并通过操作对齐的评测协议识别出模型的主要瓶颈在于解耦和属性绑定而非场景级组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多参考图像生成基准仍围绕预定义任务类型（如"主体组合"）组织，不适合组合性设置，导致覆盖零散、复杂度不可控、诊断价值低。作者希望采用能力导向视角，将多样的多参考任务统一抽象为共享的原子操作集合。

Method: 形式化四种原子操作：Anchor (f)、Disentangle (g)、Apply (⊕)、Compose (C)。任何多参考提示可表示为这些操作上的组合公式，结构复杂度由操作槽数量量化。基于此构建TRACE-Bench，含约1600个评测用例（槽数1-8）、631个公式模板和约4000张参考图像。公式结构驱动操作对齐的评测协议（逐能力评分）和诊断树分析（递归失败定位）。

Result: 评估9个领先模型发现：主要瓶颈在于解耦(g)和属性绑定(⊕)而非场景级组合(C)；即使最佳模型在属性保真度上也仅得0.74分。

Conclusion: TRACE-Bench通过操作级原子分解，提供了比整体评分更具诊断价值的评测框架，揭示了现有模型在多参考生成中精细化属性处理能力上的不足，为后续模型改进提供了明确方向。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

</details>


### [206] [Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16785)
*Gaofeng Su,Keya Li,Raja Sengupta,Kara M. Kockelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种免标定的框架，利用36关键点车辆模板和逐帧更新的单应矩阵，从单目视频中估计车辆速度，无需依赖道路特征、相机标定或参考物体。在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上验证了超过400段视频，经10%裁剪后MAE分别降至11.7%和7.6%，85.3%和95.4%的估计误差在±20%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计方法通常依赖相机标定、道路特征或参考物体，这些条件在实际场景中难以满足。该工作旨在解决这些局限性，实现免标定的车速估计，从而支持利用行车记录仪和智能手机等便携设备进行低成本、高效的速度执法和公民参与式的交通安全监管。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于YOLO的关键点检测模块，在多样化数据集上训练以识别36关键点车辆模板；(2) 逐帧更新的单应矩阵将图像坐标系投影到度量空间；(3) 两种估计策略对比：纯关键点跟踪和基于扭曲光流的密集空间聚合方法。车速通过单应矩阵将位移投影到度量空间后计算得出。

Result: 在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上，扭曲光流方法实现MAE分别为15.0%和9.7%，±20%误差内的估计占比为77.9%和93.1%。应用10%裁剪去除边缘离群值后，MAE改善至11.7%和7.6%，±20%准确率提升至85.3%和95.4%。覆盖了30至100 mph的速度范围，超过400段路边和俯视视角视频得到验证。

Conclusion: 该免标定框架能够在多样化场景下可靠估计车速，克服了现有视觉方法对相机校准和道路特征的依赖。warped optical flow方法优于纯关键点跟踪，边缘裁剪进一步提升了精度。该工作为使用便携设备（如行车记录仪和智能手机）开展低成本、高效率的速度执法提供了可行的技术支撑。

Abstract: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

</details>


### [207] [Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16786)
*Artem Sergievskii,Artyom Turevich,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对八种基于Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG)概念的无训练推理时质量增强方法进行了系统重评估，在两个开权重流变压器模型和三个组合对齐基准上测试，发现没有任何方法在各项指标上持续优于CFG基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推理时质量增强方法大多是在较老的U-Net扩散模型上提出的，且验证时仅使用孤立评估图像质量的指标，未考虑生成图像与文本提示之间的组合对齐和语义对应。在新型rectified-flow transformer模型上，这些方法的有效性缺乏系统性验证。

Method: 作者在统一协议下，对八种无训练推理时增强方法进行重评估。实验设置包括：两个开放权重的rectified-flow transformer模型（SD3.5 Medium和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base），以及三个组合对齐基准。所有方法均在固定per-model协议下测试，并与CFG基线进行比较。

Result: 没有任何方法在测量标准下持续优于CFG。APG在名义上取得了一些最佳分数，但其增益大多落在估计的评估不确定性范围内。注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上提供了一些孤立增益，但在FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base上出现更频繁的性能退化。CFG仍是有竞争力的低成本基线。

Conclusion: 研究表明，针对U-Net模型开发的推理时增强方法在新型rectified-flow transformer上并不能稳定带来改进，研究者应重新审视这些技术在新架构上的适用范围，并以组合对齐和语义对应等更全面的标准进行评估。

Abstract: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

</details>


### [208] [Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16791)
*Ye Lu,Shen Wang,Zhaoyang Zhang,Yihan Yan,Li Liu,Runze Liu,Fanghui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种两阶段白盒模型逆向攻击方法。第一阶段预训练通用Flow Matching模型作为人脸先验，第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器（PGS）在采样过程中注入时间相关、目标特定的梯度信号，将生成轨迹从随机噪声引导至目标类别高密度区域。在CelebA数据集上针对ArcFace模型达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874，在多个目标模型上取得具有竞争力的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型逆向攻击方法依赖间接引导或高度随机的引导信号，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化至目标面部图像。作者旨在解决生成轨迹优化不稳定的问题，提出一种更可控的逆向攻击方法。

Method: SFMI包含两个阶段：第一步预训练通用无条件Flow Matching模型，编码人脸流形作为稳健先验；第二步使用渐进式引导调度器（PGS），在采样过程中通过目标模型反向传播获取中间生成状态的梯度，逐步注入时间相关的适应性引导信号到向量场中，将生成流从随机噪声引导至目标类别的概率高密度区域。

Result: 在身份不重叠的交叉评估设置下（CelebA数据集），SFMI在ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874。在多个目标模型上的广泛实验表明，SFMI在白盒协议下实现了具有竞争力的攻击成功率和视觉保真度SOTA性能。

Conclusion: SFMI通过将模型逆向攻击重构为轨迹引导任务，利用Flow Matching先验和渐进式梯度调度，有效提升了逆向攻击的稳定性和视觉质量，在白盒设置下取得了先进的攻击性能。

Abstract: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling.
