By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

</details>


### [209] [PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16793)
*Lingchen Sun,Rongyuan Wu,Xiangtao Kong,Jixin Zhao,Qiaosi Yi,Yujing Sun,Shuaizheng Liu,Zhengqiang Zhang,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixRestore是一种无VAE的像素空间扩散Transformer（DiT）统一图像复原（UIR）模型，直接在补丁化像素上进行流匹配，避免潜在T2I模型中VAE丢失细节和开放合成先验导致的内容不一致问题。模型通过LQ-HQ DINO特征相似性自适应融合层特征，并可用DINO对抗目标蒸馏为单步生成器，在约50M参数下单步推理即达到最优的综合保真度、感知质量和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UIR方法大多依赖于预训练的潜在文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型，但存在两个关键问题：一是潜在空间T2I模型中的VAE可能丢弃修复敏感的细节信息；二是开放式合成先验可能引入与内容不一致的伪影（即生成内容与真实输入不匹配）。因此需要一种避免上述缺陷的统一图像复原方法。

Method: 1) 提出PixRestore，一种无VAE的像素空间扩散Transformer（DiT），扩散主干完全从头训练，不依赖T2I预训练。2) 直接在补丁化像素上执行流匹配（flow matching），保留细粒度细节同时保持token序列可管理。3) 利用LQ-HQ DINO特征相似性预测各层特征的可靠性，可靠性高的层特征融合作为稠密条件，可靠性低的层施加更强HQ特征监督以促进退化去除。4) 在大规模多样场景和退化语料上训练，并进一步通过DINO对抗目标微调为单步生成器。

Result: 在公开基准和真实世界测试集上，PixRestore以仅约50M参数和单步推理，在保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性方面取得优于竞争UIR模型的总体最优性能，且效率远高于同类方法。更大的PixRestore变体可进一步提升性能，验证了像素空间设计的可扩展性。

Conclusion: PixRestore验证了不依赖T2I预训练的无VAE像素空间DiT设计在统一图像复原中的可行性和优越性，通过DINO特征相似性引导的自适应特征融合与蒸馏出的单步生成器，实现了高质量与高效率的兼顾，且具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

</details>


### [210] [Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16805)
*Yuanzhi Xu,Qian Gao,Jun Fan,Guohui Ding,Zhenyu Yang,Yuteng Xiao,Sixue Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了"密集同类属性错绑"（DSCAM）问题——大型视觉语言模型在拥挤场景中能识别物体和属性，却将属性错误赋予同类的另一个实例。作者提出InstaBind-Lite基准（524张图像、529组3-6个同类实体、1773个框选实例、9580个确定性评估问题），通过源实例标注将"不支持生成"和"识别失败"与"从其他可见实体复制属性"区分开，并提供绑定专用指标度量转移频率、邻接性、序数距离和干预效果。实验发现开源系统平均错绑率19.84%、API系统7.55%，其中约80%的错绑来自相邻实例；局部化和实例优先干预对部分模型有效但非普适方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型评估存在盲区：通用VQA准确率将属性错绑标记为错误，而物体幻觉指标可能同时认为物体和属性都受图像支持，两者都无法揭示"属性被错误转移到同类的另一个实例"这一现象。作者旨在形式化这一盲区并提供可直接测量的基准。

Method: 构建InstaBind-Lite可控基准：包含524张图像中529组精心组织的3-6个同类实体、1773个框选实例、有序邻居、可区分的颜色类属性，以及四个互补的问题层级，生成9580个确定性评估问题。与现有协议不同，源实例标注用于区分不支持生成和识别失败与从另一可见实体复制的属性；设计绑定专用指标来量化转移频率、邻接性、序数距离和干预效果。

Result: 在五个开源和两个商业/API模型上，开源系统平均错绑率19.84%，API系统7.55%，这些错误被总体准确率所掩盖。在可识别的转移中，分别有80.70%和81.51%来自相邻实例。局部化和实例优先干预对部分模型有帮助，但不是通用解决方案。

Conclusion: InstaBind-Lite将此前无法区分的错误答案转化为可识别来源的失败类别，并测试了传统基准无法确定的一个可靠性维度：模型不仅要知道什么可见，还要知道每个属性属于哪个实例。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

</details>


### [211] [Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16810)
*Ziwen Liu,Martin Weigert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于粗到细路由金字塔的无监督细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，通过将图像像素与空间稀疏的潜变量源关联来实现实例掩码生成，同时潜变量编码细胞形态学特征，在多种细胞形态和成像模态下展现出竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的细胞/细胞核实例分割与表型分类通常依赖监督学习，需要大量人工标注，且将实例分割与细胞表示分为独立阶段处理，缺乏无监督的端到端方案。

Method: 提出一种无监督方法，利用粗到细的路由金字塔（routing pyramid）重建每张图像，将像素与空间稀疏的潜变量源（latent sources）关联。该像素-潜变量关联即生成实例掩码，而潜变量本身编码细胞形态特征。

Result: 在多种细胞形态和成像模态下，实例分割性能具有竞争力；同时能够在扰动条件下对细胞表型进行生成式建模。

Conclusion: 该方法证明了无需标注即可同时完成细胞实例分割与表型表征的统一无监督框架，并已开源代码与预训练模型。

Abstract: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

</details>


### [212] [Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16812)
*Long Cui,Xiaoqian Liu,Qi Qin,Yi Xin,Tao Lin,Jianguo Li,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套面向图像编辑的完整解决方案，包括含1000+细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系、1200万高质量编辑对数据集ConceptEdit-12M、密集监督训练策略以及用于细粒度评估的ConceptEdit-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑框架沿用文生图扩散模型的训练范式，但直接扩展该范式到图像编辑任务存在两个固有缺陷：(1)对编辑概念粒度的关注不足；(2)稀疏监督信号导致训练效率低下。

Method: (1)建立包含1000多个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系；(2)通过改进的合成框架构建包含1200万对高质量编辑数据的ConceptEdit-12M数据集，采用库驱动方法修复生成数据的分布坍缩并保证数据保真度；(3)提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单一图像对中，提供更丰富的学习信号；(4)构建ConceptEdit-Bench细粒度评估基准用于诊断模型在真实场景中的能力。

Result: 训练结果验证了所提出的策略，显著优于先前的方法。

Conclusion: 通过细粒度概念分类、大规模高质量数据构建以及密集监督训练策略，有效解决了图像编辑中概念粒度不足和训练效率低下的问题，并在多项指标上超越已有工作。

Abstract: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [213] [Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16855)
*Anna Mrukwa,Marek Socha,Aleksandra Suwalska,Agata Durawa,Malgorzata Jelitto,Katarzyna Dziadziuszko,Edyta Szurowska,Pawel Bozek,Michal Marczyk,Witold Rzyman,Rafal Dziadziuszko,Joanna Polanska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为RONALD的支气管血管束分割流程，用于低剂量CT图像中分割肺实质内的血管和支气管，以提高早期肺癌筛查中肺结节的检出率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球致死率最高的癌症，常因诊断过晚而预后不佳。早期筛查是有效治疗的关键，但放射科医生数量有限导致诊断等待时间延长。此外，极早期肺癌结节常与邻近血管和气道壁相连，降低了结节的可见性，因此需要任务特异性的支气管血管束分析来实现高效结节检测。

Method: RONALD流水线包含预处理阶段（肺、肺叶和纵隔分割），随后分别进行血管树和支气管树的分割，最终在CT图像上输出肺实质内血管和支气管的二元掩膜。方法在两个公开LDCT数据集（DLCS和Pomeranian数据集）上进行评估。

Result: 与其他分割方法相比，RONALD在保持结节保留率方面表现更优：DLCS数据集上从93.98%和90.36%提升至100%，Pomeranian数据集上从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%。

Conclusion: RONALD的支气管血管束分割能够提高极早期肺癌肺结节检测的效能，有望改善肺癌筛查的临床应用。

Abstract: Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

</details>


### [214] [HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16859)
*Weiliang Chen,Haowen Sun,Jun Gao,Jiawei Chi,Hanyang Wang,Qiyu Dai,Yihao Li,Hao Li,Jingnan Gao,Yi-Hsin Hung,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Fengrui Tian,Weihua Du,Ziqi Huang,Shenyuan Gao,Siqiao Huang,Mingyu Liu,Yifei Li,Shizun Wang,Xi Wang,Tianqi Zhang,Xue Luo,Xiyin Ren,Jinshan Ren,Xiaoyang Shen,Xiaobo Hu,Zhiyang Dou,Mingyu Ding,Yichao Yan,Xinchao Wang,Yizhou Wang,Shilong Liu,Wenzhao Zheng,Yueqi Duan,Yuan Gong,Ziwei Liu,Ming-Yu Liu,Jialong Wu,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HarnessEval-W，一个智能体化的世界模型评估流水线，将LLM领域的harness范式引入世界模型基准测试，通过分层子代理生成可验证的推理链证据树来替代暴力计算的标量分数，在18个世界模型、330个评估案例上与人偏好高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型基准测试仅输出标量分数，缺乏可解释的推理过程来证明评分合理性。由于判断世界模型rollout的正确性需要理解物理、因果和世界状态演变的正确性，而人类能自然察觉这些违规行为，但现有基准无法自动化这一能力——指标是暴力计算得出的，无法留下可供检查和验证的推理链。

Method: HarnessEval-W将harness范式从LLM生态系统移植到世界模型基准测试中。具体方法包括：(1) 解释每个评估案例的上下文；(2) 将评估问题分解为可测量的子问题；(3) 生成专门的子代理，每个子代理配备定制上下文和诊断工具来推理各自的子问题；(4) 父代理验证收集的证据并将结果总结为最终裁决。这种分层工作流将每次评估转化为透明的证据树，其完整推理链支撑结果。

Result: 将HarnessEval-W应用于18个代表性世界模型、330个评估案例。其判断与人类偏好高度一致，同时为每个生成的rollout提供可验证的细粒度诊断。完整流水线已开源作为实时基准。

Conclusion: HarnessEval-W实现了从"仅标量分数"到"可验证推理链驱动评估"的范式转变。通过透明证据树和细粒度诊断，使世界模型评估更加可信。随着世界模型的演化，该项目邀请社区参与扩展新的技能和评估案例，使其成为可持续进化的实时基准。

Abstract: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

</details>


### [215] [SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16863)
*Yejun Zhang,Zihan Wang,Xu Ji,Yihao Wang,Yuxin Hou,Junyuan Fang,Juho-Matti Kilpeläinen,Arno Solin,Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli,Esa Rahtu,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatGuide提出了一种利用单一3DGS重建场景的三种互补信号（像素渲染、逐高斯可见性投票图、重建token特征）来生成无姿态照片级真实感新视图的方法，在多个基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的方法在结合前馈3DGS重建与多视图扩散时，仅从重建中提取一种信号（要么像素渲染，要么学习特征），未利用逐高斯可见性进行遮挡感知的参考选择，导致可渲染几何、可见性线索和学习特征未被充分利用，形成"信息断连"。

Method: SplatGuide将单个3DGS场景复用于三种互补角色：(1) 渲染图像提供像素级几何条件；(2) 逐高斯的源视图索引被渲染为目标视图投票图，用于遮挡感知的参考选择；(3) 重建token通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。三种信号均来自同一次重建前向传播。

Result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples和Mip-NeRF 360基准上均达到最先进的无姿态新视图合成性能。在RealEstate10K上，使用中等数量的输入视图时超越了使用真实姿态的基线方法。

Conclusion: SplatGuide证明了通过复用单个3DGS重建中的多种信号（渲染、可见性、特征），可以弥合信息断连，显著提升无姿态新视图合成的质量，甚至超越需要真实姿态的基线。

Abstract: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

</details>


### [216] [An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16887)
*Dengyang Jiang,Ruoyi Du,Zhennan Chen,Dongyang Liu,Zanyi Wang,Mingzhe Zheng,Xiangpeng Yang,Huanqia Cai,Aiming Hao,Yuming Jiang,Peng Gao,Harry Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对像素空间扩散模型在大规模训练场景下收敛缓慢的问题，提出一种"隐空间预训练+像素空间后训练"的策略，并系统研究了从隐空间过渡到像素空间的关键设计选择（权重初始化、数据组合、预测目标、解码器架构、噪声调度），最终使像素空间模型在匹配或超越隐空间基线性能的同时，实现了3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素空间扩散模型研究大多局限于小规模或类别条件设定，缺乏能够在实际规模上媲美甚至超越隐空间对应模型的实用训练方案。作者旨在填补这一空白，为像素空间生成提供可操作的实践指南。

Method: 首先通过大规模实证研究发现像素空间直接预训练收敛速度显著慢于隐空间，由此提出"隐到像素（latent-to-pixel）"策略：先在隐空间高效获取生成先验，再在后训练阶段过渡到像素空间。随后系统探究并优化了该过渡过程中的五类关键设计选择：权重初始化方式、训练数据构成、预测目标设定、解码器架构选择以及噪声调度方案，最终整理出一套实用的训练配方。

Result: 采用所提出的配方后，像素空间模型在性能上达到或超过隐空间对应模型，同时实现了3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理速度提升。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了像素空间生成领域的重要实证见解和实用指导，证明通过合理的预训练策略和过渡设计，像素空间扩散模型可以兼顾性能与推理效率，为该方向未来的研究奠定了实践基础。

Abstract: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [217] [FLOPs vs Real Work: The Importance of Replication in AI Efficiency Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14550)
*Enrique Barba Roque,Luís Cruz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文复现了α-FLOPs估算公式的原始实验，验证了原始研究中"FLOPs不能直接衡量执行时间"的结论，但发现α-FLOPs公式在新硬件上存在不足，无法准确预测执行时间，并强调了可复现性包完整性的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着模型规模、能耗和环境成本的急剧增加，AI效率成为学术界和工业界关注的焦点。虽然FLOPs是传统的计算成本评估指标，但FLOPs与执行时间的关系并不直接（因为某些操作更容易并行化）。作者旨在复现提出α-FLOPs估算公式的原始研究，验证其结果在更新的更强硬件上是否仍然适用。

Method: 作者复现了原始研究中提出的α-FLOPs估算公式实验，在更新的硬件上进行了细粒度测量。在复现过程中，他们发现了原始研究在复现材料方面的局限（缺乏具体依赖项细节和回归数据透明度），并提供了完整的复现包供后续研究使用。

Result: 实验结果验证了原始论文的基本论点，即原始FLOPs并非合适的执行时间指标，空间维度比核维度更容易并行化。但细粒度测量揭示关系远比之前所示复杂，新硬件在执行时间上出现不稳定和不连续（包括跳跃和振荡），α-FLOPs公式通常会低估这些现象。原始研究的实证发现得到验证，但α-FLOPs估算的应用结果为负面。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了原始研究的经验性发现，但否定了α-FLOPs在新硬件上的实际应用效果。同时强调硬件依赖型效率评估研究需要完整准确的复现包，并提供了自己的完整复现包以促进进一步研究。

Abstract: AI efficiency has recently taken the spotlight in both academy and industry due to massive model scales, high energy demands, and environmental costs. While reporting Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) is a traditional approach for assessing computational costs, the relationship between FLOPs and execution time is not straightforward, as layers with the same number of FLOPs may not have the same execution time because some operations are more easily parallelized than others. This paper sets out to replicate the original experiments from a study that proposed the $α-FLOPs$ estimation formula to verify whether the results remain applicable on newer, more powerful hardware.
  During the replication process, we identify limitations in the replication materials provided by the original study, including a lack of specific dependency details and transparency regarding regression data. Our results validate the thesis that raw FLOPs alone are not an appropriate metric for execution time, as spatial dimensions remain more easily parallelized than kernel dimensions. However, fine-grained measurements reveal that the relationship is much less straightforward than previously shown, with newer hardware exhibiting instabilities and discontinuities in execution time, including jumps and oscillations, that the $α-FLOPs$ formula generally underestimates. Ultimately, this work validates the empirical findings from the original study but shows negative results when applying the $α-FLOPs$ estimation. We also highlight the critical need for complete and accurate replication packages for research on hardware-dependent efficiency assessment and provide a complete replication package for our implementation to facilitate further study.

</details>


### [218] [Large Language Models Show Metacognitive Sensitivity in Medical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14552)
*Ahmad Nazzal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个基于心理物理学的受控临床基准测试，用于评估医学大语言模型（LLM）的诊断准确性及其置信度是否追踪证据质量与不确定性。在gpt-4.1-nano上进行试点测试：诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2为0.876。研究发现模型表现出部分元认知敏感性（置信度随证据距离、缺失信息及正确/错误试验而合理变化），但在中度、冲突的AT-NCD病例中存在局部校准失败——模型转向DRCI但仍过度自信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学LLM的临床应用不仅依赖回答准确性，还取决于置信度能否真实反映证据质量和不确定性。现有评估往往只关注准确率，忽视了置信度校准（calibration）和元认知效能（metacognitive sensitivity）的测量，缺乏受控条件下系统评估置信度行为的方法框架。

Method: 构建了心理物理学启发的受控临床基准测试，聚焦于可能阿尔茨海默型神经认知障碍（AT-NCD）与抑郁相关认知障碍（DRCI）的鉴别诊断。生成45个合成临床小插曲（vignettes），系统操纵证据强度、冲突证据和缺失信息三个维度；每个插曲以三种提示变体呈现，共135个试验。采用强制二选一诊断任务，测量准确率、置信度及AUROC2（置信度区分正确/错误的能力），并通过调整证据强度和提示格式进行统计建模。

Result: 试点测试中gpt-4.1-nano所有135个试验均产生有效结构化输出。强制选择诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2=0.876。置信度随与诊断边界的证据距离增加而上升，信息缺失时下降，在校正证据强度和提示格式后，正确试验的置信度仍高于错误试验。错误集中在中度、冲突的AT-NCD病例中，模型倾向于转向DRCI且置信度超过经验准确性所证实的合理水平。

Conclusion: 该研究证明医学LLM表现出部分元认知敏感性而非完全无信息的置信度，但在特定临床亚型（中度冲突的AT-NCD）中存在局部校准失败。置信度质量应直接测量而非从基准准确率或模型能力推断。该框架为医学LLM的证据敏感性、元认知敏感性和局部校准失败提供了可复现的评估方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated and used in medicine, but clinical usefulness depends on answer accuracy and whether confidence tracks evidence quality and uncertainty. We developed a controlled, psychophysics-inspired clinical benchmark to test diagnostic choice and confidence behavior in a medical LLM. The benchmark focused on probable Alzheimer-type neurocognitive disorder (AT-NCD) versus depression-related cognitive impairment (DRCI). We generated 45 synthetic vignettes varying evidence strength, conflicting evidence, and missing information. Each vignette was presented under three prompt variants, yielding 135 trials. In a pilot run with gpt-4.1-nano, all trials produced valid structured outputs. Across forced-choice trials, diagnostic accuracy was 93.5%, mean confidence was 78.4%, and AUROC2 was 0.876. Confidence increased with evidence distance from the diagnostic boundary, decreased when information was missing, and remained higher on correct than incorrect trials after adjustment for evidence strength and prompt format. These findings indicate partial metacognitive sensitivity rather than globally uninformative confidence. However, errors clustered in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases, where the model shifted toward DRCI and retained more confidence than empirical accuracy justified. Model comparison suggested that confidence quality should be measured directly rather than inferred from benchmark accuracy or model capability alone. This study establishes a reproducible framework for evaluating evidence sensitivity, metacognitive sensitivity, and localized calibration failure in medical LLMs.

</details>


### [219] [The Unwritten Benchmark: A New Challenge for Multimodal Machine Learning in Abstract Perceptual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14558)
*Garima Arya Yadav,Nilay Yilmaz,Yezhou Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了"未书写基准"（The Unwritten Benchmark），这是一个新的多模态推理挑战任务——声学-运动学词汇推断。任务要求模型仅通过笔划声和手部运动视频（无可见墨迹）推断书写的单词。实验结果揭示了人类与机器之间的巨大鸿沟：人类有序字母准确率超过80%，而GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5-Pro等领先多模态模型均低于10%。研究还发现了一个"融合悖论"：提供双模态信息反而降低模型性能，表明模型在跨模态因果推理和微运动学理解上存在根本性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态模型虽能很好地识别静态视觉和听觉内容，但其抽象感知推理能力——即从动态生成过程中推断未见的隐藏信息——仍是尚未充分探索的关键前沿。作者旨在填补这一空白，探究模型能否像人类一样，仅凭书写过程中的间接线索（声音和运动）推理出正在书写的单词。

Method: 作者构建了"未书写基准"（The Unwritten Benchmark），定义了声学-运动学词汇推断任务：模型需在无可见墨迹的条件下，仅从笔划声和手部运动视频中解码单词，涵盖3种不同的书写风格。通过对比人类参与者与多模态大模型（GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5-Pro）在该任务上的表现，评估模型的抽象感知推理能力。

Result: 人类参与者的有序字母准确率超过80%，而GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5-Pro等领先多模态模型的准确率均未超过10%。此外，研究中发现了一个"融合悖论"：当同时提供音频和视频两种模态时，模型性能不升反降，表明模型无法有效融合互补的感知线索。

Conclusion: 该研究表明当前多模态模型在跨模态因果推理和微运动学理解方面存在根本性局限，这种抽象的感知认知能力是现有模型尚未攻克的关键短板。这一发现为未来多模态模型在认知推理能力的提升指明了方向。

Abstract: Current multimodal models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in recognizing static visual and auditory content. However, their capacity for abstract perceptual reasoning, inferring unseen information from dynamic, generative processes, remains a critical and underexplored frontier. In this paper, we introduce The Unwritten Benchmark, a new challenge designed to probe this abstract perceptual and cognitive ability. We define the core task as acousto-kinematic word inference: models must decipher words, across 3 different writing styles, being written solely from the audio of pen scratches and the video of hand movements, without any visible ink trace. Our evaluation results reveal a profound gap between human and machine performance: while human participants achieve high ordered letter accuracy (over 80%), leading Multimodal Machine Learning Models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5-Pro, struggle significantly, failing to surpass 10%. Furthermore, we identify a paradoxical fusion effect in the models, where providing both modalities often degrades performance rather than improving it. This finding indicates a fundamental breakdown in their ability to synthesize complementary perceptual cues for this cognitive task. These findings highlight significant limitations in both cross-modal causal reasoning and the understanding of the micro-kinematics essential for such cognitive and intuitive perceptual reasoning.

</details>


### [220] [When to Communicate: Belief Distributions and KL Divergence for Principled Gating in Multi-Agent RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14559)
*Teoman Kaman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于KL散度的多智能体通信门控机制：只有当智能体对潜在世界状态的信念分布分歧超过固定阈值时才进行通信，替代高方差的REINFORCE二值门控。在Predator-Prey和MPE基准上验证，在较大环境中优于IC3Net，并发现信念头的表示学习收益与门控机制本身是两种正交的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MARL通信方法要么每个时间步都通信（浪费带宽），要么用REINFORCE学习二值门控，但REINFORCE梯度方差高，导致门控行为不稳定且不可解释。需要一个更原则化、更可解释的通信时机决策机制。

Method: 每个智能体维护一个对潜在世界状态的信念分布（LSTM隐藏状态的softmax），仅当智能体间信念分布的KL散度超过固定阈值ε时才进行通信。在Predator-Prey（10×10和20×20）与MPE simple_spread上，对ε∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0}做阈值消融，与IC3Net、CommNet和独立控制器对比。

Result: PP 10×10上IC3Net优于KL-belief所有阈值；PP 20×20上ε=0.5时KL-belief达到73.84平均步数和42%成功率，超过IC3Net（75.31步，31%），差距1.47步和11个百分点且种子方差更小。MPE上信念头即使在门控未激活时也提升平均奖励12点并将方差降低26倍。

Conclusion: KL散度门控在信念可收敛时是REINFORCE的有效原则性替代方案；同时信念头本身带来的潜在表征改进是独立于门控的收益来源，两者正交贡献。

Abstract: Effective communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning requires agents to decide not only \textit{what} to communicate, but when? Existing approaches either communicate at every timestep or learn a binary gate through REINFORCE policy gradients \cite{singh2019}, a high-variance signal that produces unstable and uninterpretable gating behavior. I propose a principled alternative: agents communicate only when the KL divergence between their learned belief distributions exceeds a fixed threshold. Each agent maintains a belief distribution over a latent world state computed as a softmax over its LSTM hidden state, and communicates only when belief disagreement is large enough to justify information exchange. I evaluate this approach on the Predator-Prey benchmark from IC3Net \cite{singh2019} across two environment sizes with 5 seeds each, and on MPE simple\_spread \cite{lowe2017}, comparing against IC3Net, CommNet, and an independent controller. On PP 10$\times$10, IC3Net outperforms KL-belief at all thresholds. On the harder PP 20$\times$20, a threshold ablation over $\varepsilon \in \{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0\}$ reveals an inverted U-shape: $\varepsilon=0.5$ achieves 73.84 average steps and 42\% success rate versus IC3Net's 75.31 steps and 31\%, a gap of 1.47 steps and 11 percentage points with tighter seed variance. On MPE, the belief head improves mean reward by 12 points and reduces variance by 26$\times$ even when gating is inactive, suggesting two orthogonal contributions: principled gating when beliefs can converge, and improved latent representations that benefit coordination regardless.

</details>


### [221] [Global AI Regulations for FAIR and Ethics in High-Risk Use Cases: A Comparative Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14562)
*Aasish Kumar Sharma,Dimitar Koysev,Christopher Anich,Roshni Kumari Ojha,Julian Kunkel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了欧盟、美国、中国三地AI治理的比较矩阵，从风险分类触发条件、约束性义务、执法与问责机制、FAIR原则实践程度四个维度进行映射，并在脑电图引导康复机器人、CBDC生态下的AI债务催收、AI工厂中GPU资源分配三个高影响场景进行压力测试。研究发现三大治理缺口：互操作性要求薄弱、跨制度义务落地困难（AI+行业监管+数据保护）、关键数字基础设施治理规定不充分。为弥合实施差距，提出基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可检查合规工件模式"Knowledge Blocks"，实现跨制度的可审计合规设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI治理正从自愿性伦理转向可执行的基于风险的监管，但不同司法管辖区的监管框架差异导致高风险AI运营者面临合规不确定性。现有研究缺乏系统的跨辖区对比分析，也缺少可操作的合规实施工具。

Method: 采用比较矩阵方法对EU、US、China三种制度进行四维映射分析；对三个高影响领域进行压力测试；基于主要法律文本和实施证据识别治理缺口；提出采用语义网技术栈（RDF/OWL、SHACL、PROV-O）的机器可检查合规工件模式。

Result: 识别出三个反复出现的治理缺口：弱互操作性任务要求、跨制度义务（AI+行业监管+数据保护）难以操作化、关键数字基础设施用例治理规定不足。提出Knowledge Blocks这一审计就绪的合规设计模式作为弥合实施差距的方案。

Conclusion: 跨辖区AI治理的实施缺口需要从描述性合规转向机器可执行的合规工件支撑，Knowledge Blocks模式可在多司法管辖区实现审计就绪的合规设计，为高风险AI运营者提供可操作的跨制度合规路径。

Abstract: AI governance is shifting from voluntary ethics to enforceable, risk-based regulation, yet cross-jurisdictional divergence creates compliance uncertainty for operators of high-stakes AI. We present a comparative matrix for the EU, US, and China that maps (i) risk classification triggers, (ii) binding obligations, (iii) enforcement and accountability mechanisms, and (iv) the degree to which FAIR principles are operationalised in practice. We stress-test the matrix on three high-impact domains: Electroencephalography (EEG)-guided rehabilitation robotics, AI-enabled debt collection in prospective Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ecosystems, and AI-driven allocation of scarce Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources in emerging AI Factory infrastructures. Using primary legal texts and implementation evidence, we identify three recurring gaps: weak interoperability mandates, difficult operationalisation of cross-regime obligations (AI + sector regulation + data protection), and under-specified governance for critical digital infrastructure use cases. To bridge the implementation gap, we outline Knowledge Blocks, a machine-checkable compliance artefact pattern based on Resource Description Framework/Web Ontology Language (RDF/OWL), Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL), and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O), enabling audit-ready compliance-by-design across multiple regimes.

</details>


### [222] [Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14565)
*Jaeho Kim,Seokhyun Lee,Jieun Lee,Changhee Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI锁死"（AI Lock-In）概念，指过度依赖AI系统导致的人类技能退化、独立功能能力下降及系统性脆弱性。论文认为这是AI安全研究中被忽视的第三个维度（前两个为技术对齐和社会影响监管），并呼吁在个体、社会和国家三个层面提前应对这一新兴的系统性威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI安全研究仅聚焦于技术对齐（确保AI输出符合人类意图）和生成式AI的社会影响监管（如失业与劳动力市场冲击），却忽视了AI依赖本身带来的固有风险。这种"AI锁死"现象已在个体、社会和国家层面显现，且可能因AI服务中断或地缘政治冲突而被急剧放大，然而却缺乏系统的研究与应对框架。

Method: 本文采用立场论文（position paper）的形式，通过构建详细的情景案例，从多个层面（个体技能萎缩到国家基础设施故障）系统分析AI Lock-In的产生与升级机制，并针对每个层面提出相应的缓解和准备策略。

Result: 识别出AI Lock-In作为系统性威胁已在个体、社会和国家三个层面显现，阐明了其从个体技能退化到国家基础设施崩溃的升级路径，并为不同层面提供了针对性的风险缓解指南。

Conclusion: 在AI依赖变得根深蒂固甚至不可逆转之前，主动应对AI Lock-In对于维护个体自主性和国家安全至关重要。论文强调应将其纳入AI安全研究的核心议程。

Abstract: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity for independent functioning, and creates systemic vulnerabilities when AI systems become unavailable or compromised. We highlight that AI Lock-In is a systemic threat that is already emerging at individual, societal, and national levels, one that could be dramatically amplified by AI service disruptions or geopolitical conflicts. Drawing on detailed scenarios, we investigate how AI Lock-In emerges and escalates across multiple levels, ranging from individual skill atrophy to national-scale infrastructure failures. To address this, we provide guidance on how such risks can be mitigated and prepared for at each level. We contend that proactively addressing AI Lock-In before such dependencies become entrenched, or even irreversible, is essential for preserving individual autonomy and national security.

</details>


### [223] [Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14566)
*Aidan Kierans,Ritam Dutt,Kaley Rittichier,Shiri Dori-Hacohen,Avijit Ghosh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出当前LLM道德评估研究过度聚焦于"道德价值问题"（模型输出是否与人类道德价值观一致），而忽视了"道德规范问题"（模型能否识别并正确应用情境敏感的规范），并提出了一个研究议程以推进对LLM规范性推理的系统研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM道德能力评估主要依赖描述性伦理学框架（如道德基础理论和科尔伯格道德发展阶段理论），这些框架强调价值表征而非规范应用，导致学界对道德规范问题的研究严重不足，形成价值问题与规范问题之间的失衡。

Method: 作者首先区分"道德价值问题"与"道德规范问题"两个概念，然后系统综述现有基准与评估方法，展示其集中于价值问题；接着识别出三个关键研究空白：(i)缺乏规范的优质ground-truth数据、(ii)对中间推理过程评估不足、(iii)对情境中道德相关特征识别关注有限；最后提出研究议程，包括开发规范理论的形式化表示、构建专家标注的规范应用数据集，以及设计区分价值层级和规范层级能力的评估协议。

Result: 本文通过综述证明现有基准和评估方法高度聚集于道德价值问题，规范性伦理讨论在LLM评估领域代表性严重不足，并明确指出了三大研究空白。

Conclusion: 作者呼吁推动LLM规范性推理的更系统化研究，通过填补数据、推理过程评估和情境特征识别等空白，建立一套区分价值层面与规范层面能力的评估框架。

Abstract: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.

</details>


### [224] [From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14567)
*Yuri Almeida,Arthur Casals*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对计算信念变更（computational belief change）进行定向叙事综述，以Doyle和London 1980年的奠基性分类法为起点，追溯信念修订从计算起源、经AGM框架的理论转型直至当代方法的发展脉络，为后续计算蓝图与工程化信念变更研究提供理论与历史基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信念变更领域的计算实现缺乏系统的历史与理论基础梳理，当代实现挑战需要理解前AGM时期的计算实用主义与AGM理论构造之间的延续与转型关系，以为工程导向的信念变更研究提供历史先例与理论根基。

Method: 采用定向叙事综述方法，以Doyle和London 1980年分类法为种子，逐类分析各分类范畴在AGM成立后的演变，对比前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构造，识别连续性（continuities）与转型（transformations）。

Result: 揭示了此前未被系统阐释的从前AGM计算源头到AGM框架再到当代方法的演进脉络，展示了每个分类学范畴在后AGM时代的演变方式，确认了当代信念变更实现挑战在历史上的理论依据与先例。

Conclusion: 该综述奠定了后续研究的基础，使后续工作得以将历史洞见与形式化保证相结合，构建稳健的计算蓝图，为系统的实现分析与工程导向的信念变更研究提供了基线。

Abstract: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.

</details>


### [225] [Position: AI Governance Needs ISO-like Interoperability Protocols, Not Just Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14568)
*Azmine Toushik Wasi,Mst Rafia Islam,Mahfuz Ahmed Anik,Taki Hasan Rafi,Md Manjurul Ahsan,Dong-Kyu Chae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AI治理不应仅依赖法律，而应建立类似ISO的可互操作协议，实现跨边境标准化的机器可读风险通信，主张开发统一的AI"营养标签"（包含偏见、能耗、数据来源等指标）以促进跨境合规并降低中小企业负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI治理由各司法辖区的法律、政策和自愿框架主导（如欧盟AI法案、中国算法治理、美国NIST框架），造成碎片化的监管格局，缺乏统一的、可互操作的标准来支撑跨境AI部署和合规。

Method: 以GDPR通过ISO 27001和Privacy by Design实现可操作化为先例，提出开发标准化的AI营养标签（nutrition labels），包含偏见、能耗和数据来源的统一度量指标；并倡导模块化、版本化的协议设计，使其与技术进步同步演进。

Result: 该方案可降低中小企业合规门槛、减少冗余监管努力、建立公众信任，同时回应了标准可能抑制创新的担忧。

Conclusion: 主张AI治理应从孤立的合法合规转向可互操作的技术一致性验证，建立负责任的AI部署共享全球语言。

Abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems become deeply integrated into critical global infrastructure, the urgency for robust governance frameworks has intensified. However, current approaches, led by jurisdiction-specific laws, policies, and voluntary frameworks such as the EU AI Act, China's algorithm governance, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework in the U.S., create a fragmented regulatory landscape. In this position paper, we argue that \textbf{\textit{AI governance must be built not on laws alone, but on ISO-like interoperability protocols that enable standardized, machine-readable risk communication across borders}}. Drawing on the success of the GDPR, which was operationalized through standards like ISO 27001 and Privacy by Design, we propose the development of standardized AI \textit{nutrition labels} containing unified metrics for bias, energy usage, and data provenance to facilitate cross-jurisdictional compliance. These manifests would lower barriers for small and medium enterprises (SMEs), reduce redundant regulatory efforts, and build public trust. The paper addresses concerns that standards may stifle innovation by advocating for modular, versioned protocols designed to evolve in tandem with technological change. Overall, we call for a shift from siloed legal compliance toward interoperable technical conformance, enabling a shared global language for responsible AI deployment.

</details>


### [226] [Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14569)
*Shufeng Kong,Xiaochuan Zhang,Caihua Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个立场观点：当问题存在硬约束且验证成本较低时，神经约束推理必须优先考虑符号集成而非纯学习方法。以数独为代表性问题（验证O(n²) vs 求解指数级），通过综述各类求解方法论证神经方法缺乏实例级认证，并提出双向集成的多智能体认证推理框架，兼顾计算效率与可证明正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经求解器在约束满足问题上取得了显著的分布内精度，但在分布偏移下即使模型报告高置信度，仍会出现持续的约束违反——这是一个根本性局限。当硬约束存在且验证成本相对较低时，纯学习方法无法提供可证明的正确性保障，因此需要重新审视神经推理的定位。

Method: 本文采用立场论述加框架设计的方法：首先以数独（NP完全问题，具有验证易/求解难的鲜明不对称性）作为代表性测试平台；其次系统综述确定性算法、元启发式优化、学习方法和语言条件推理等各类求解方法；最后提出一种多智能体认证推理框架，实现神经方法与符号方法的双向集成——神经方法为符号求解器学习启发式并将感知转换为符号，符号方法验证神经输出以确保可靠性。

Result: 通过全面综述论证了：没有实例级认证的纯神经方法无法达到符号和神经符号方法所具备的可证明正确性；提出的多智能体认证推理框架展示了双向集成如何同时实现计算效率和可证明正确性。

Conclusion: 本文倡导在存在硬约束且验证成本相对较低的场景下，神经约束推理应优先选择神经-符号双向集成路线，而非纯学习路线，以同时兼顾计算效率与可证明的正确性保障。

Abstract: Neural solvers for constraint satisfaction problems have achieved remarkable in-distribution accuracy, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation persistent constraint violations occur under distribution shifts even when the model reports high confidence. This position paper argues that when hard constraints exist and the cost of verification is relatively low, neural constraint reasoning must prioritize symbolic integration over pure learning. We justify our focus on Sudoku as a representative NP-complete testbed because it exhibits a sharp asymmetry between easy verification and hard solving: checking a candidate solution requires only polynomial time $O(n^{2})$, while finding a solution may require exponential search. Through a comprehensive survey of solving methods spanning deterministic algorithms, metaheuristic optimization, learning-based approaches, and language-conditioned reasoning, we demonstrate that neural-only methods without instance-level certification fail to achieve the provable correctness that symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches provide. We advocate for a bidirectional integration in which neural methods enhance symbolic solvers by learning heuristics and converting percepts into symbols, while symbolic methods verify neural outputs to ensure their reliability. To operationalize this position, we propose a multi-agent certified reasoning framework that demonstrates how this integration can achieve both computational efficiency and provable correctness.

</details>


### [227] [Position: Want Better ML Reviews? Stop Asking Nicely and Start Incentivizing with a Credit System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14571)
*Shaochen Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，针对机器学习社区审稿体验普遍不佳且缺乏公开讨论空间的现状，提出两大核心问题：如何合理限制投稿量以及如何激励好审稿、抑制差审稿。作者评估了现有会议机制的优缺点，提出四种观点和两种替代设计方案，主张通过可执行的细粒度程序保障配合货币式积分信用体系（如"OpenReview Points"）来实现有意义改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习领域投稿量激增、互审政策趋严、OpenReview等平台广泛普及，但缺乏出版费用的对冲压力，导致审稿体验普遍糟糕，且几乎没有公共空间来严肃讨论或辩论审稿系统的有效性及改进方式。

Method: 作为立场论文，作者首先评估现有尝试（如会议机制）在限制投稿量和激励审稿质量方面的优缺点，针对流行的会议机制提出四种观点，并在此基础上提出两种替代设计，核心方案为结合可执行的细粒度程序保障与"OpenReview Points"形式的货币式积分信用系统——通过良好审稿实践赚取积分，可跨多个主要会议消费以兑换注册费减免或申请额外审稿资源等"福利"。

Result: 作者提出两种替代设计以改进ML同行评审，核心是"OpenReview Points"信用系统：审稿人通过良好审稿实践赚取积分，并可在多个会议间跨域消费，兑换注册费、额外审稿资源等福利。

Conclusion: 有意义的ML同行评审改进不能仅依赖征稿启事或审稿指南中的礼貌性最佳实践建议，而需要强制执行且粒度精细的程序性保障，配合货币式积分信用系统才能产生实质改变。

Abstract: With soaring submission counts, stricter reciprocal review policies, widespread adoption of platforms like OpenReview, and without the offsetting pressure of publication fees, the machine learning (ML) community has one of the largest scholarly presences among all scientific fields. And yet, \textbf{almost \textit{everyone} has \textit{many} unpleasant things to share about their review experience.} Worse, there is little public space to seriously discuss, let alone debate, what makes a review system effective or how it might be improved.\quad In this position paper, we expand our discussion from two core problems: \textit{How can we reasonably limit submission volume?} and \textit{How can we incentivize good and discourage bad reviewing?} We first assess the strengths and shortcomings of existing attempts to address such problems. Specifically, we present four takes on some popular conference mechanisms and propose two alternative designs for improvement.\quad Our general position is that meaningful improvement in ML peer review won't come from polite best-practice suggestions tucked into Calls for Papers or Reviewer Guidelines: it requires \textbf{enforceable yet fine-grained procedural safeguards} paired with \textbf{a currency-like credit system (e.g., our proposed \textit{OpenReview Points})}. ML practitioners can ``earn'' such points by contributing good review practices, and ``spend'' them across one or multiple major conferences to redeem different kinds of ``perks,'' such as complimentary registration or the right to request additional review resources.

</details>


### [228] [Longitudinal and Graph-Augmented Prediction of Adolescent Substance Use Onset in the ABCD Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14578)
*Yixuan He,Jinni Su,Yun Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文利用ABCD研究中约11,860名参与者的数据，比较了横截面、纵向和时间图卷积网络（T-GCN）三类方法在预测青少年酒精尝试、酒精使用、大麻使用及酒精/大麻使用方面的表现。纵向模型显著优于基线模型，时间XGBoost为最强单一模型，而将时间XGBoost与T-GCN预测通过分数级堆叠融合后取得了最佳性能（AUC-ROC均高于0.79）。图衍生的风险评分提供了互补信息，关键预测因子包括同伴偏差、年龄、外化症状、父母监控、文化规范和邻里背景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期识别青少年物质使用风险是预防领域的重要挑战，然而基线特征、纵向轨迹和关系情境在预测中的相对价值尚不明确，作者旨在系统比较这三类信息源在预测任务中的效用。

Method: 使用ABCD研究中约11,860名参与者的数据，构建跨截面、纵向和基于图的三类预测框架。具体模型包括：决策树类模型（如temporal XGBoost）、循环神经网络（RNN）以及基于家庭、学校和特征相似性图构造的时间图卷积网络（T-GCN）。通过分数级堆叠融合temporal XGBoost与T-GCN的预测结果进行集成。

Result: 纵向模型一致优于基线模型，temporal XGBoost在单一模型中表现最佳。T-GCN单独表现通常不超越temporal XGBoost，但其图衍生的风险评分提供了互补信息。将两者通过分数级堆叠融合后，在所有预测结果上均取得最佳性能，AUC-ROC高于0.79。特征分析表明同伴偏差、年龄、外化症状、父母监控、文化规范和邻里背景是重要的预测因子。

Conclusion: 研究表明纵向建模在预测青少年物质使用方面具有显著价值，图表示方法可作为有效的辅助风险信号来源。最佳策略为将时序树模型与图神经网络的预测进行集成，而非单一依赖某类模型。

Abstract: Early identification of adolescent substance-use risk is an important prevention challenge, yet the relative value of baseline characteristics, longitudinal trajectories, and relational context remains unclear. Using data from approximately 11,860 participants in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study, we compare cross-sectional, longitudinal, and graph-based approaches for predicting alcohol sipping, alcohol use, marijuana use, and alcohol/marijuana use. We evaluate tree-based models, recurrent neural networks, and Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (T-GCNs) constructed from family, school, and feature-similarity graphs. Longitudinal models consistently outperform baseline models, with temporal XGBoost achieving the strongest standalone performance. Although T-GCNs generally do not surpass temporal XGBoost, graph-derived risk scores provide complementary information. Combining temporal XGBoost and T-GCN predictions through score-level stacking yields the best performance across all outcomes, achieving AUC-ROC values above 0.79. Feature analyses identify peer deviance, age, externalizing symptoms, parental monitoring, cultural norms, and neighborhood context as important predictors of substance use onset. These findings demonstrate the value of longitudinal modeling for substance-use prediction and suggest that graph-based representations can provide effective auxiliary risk signals.

</details>


### [229] [SKILL: Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent for Logic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14579)
*Rui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SKILL是一个自修正的知识引导式迭代大语言模型（LLM）智能体，它统一了多智能体LLM推理与基于强化学习（RL）的环境交互，用于自动化逻辑综合优化。通过协调三个专业LLM（GPT-4o负责策略规划、Claude Sonnet 4负责详细推理、Gemini 2.5 Pro负责高效分析）以及一个基于PPO的RL智能体，在IWLS、OpenCores和EPFL基准测试上实现了比专家流程高12.4%的PDA改进和86.3%的成功率（可达50万门规模的逻辑系统）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逻辑综合优化面临两大挑战：专家设计的流程缺乏适应性，无法应对指数级增长的搜索空间和多样化的逻辑结构；而现有强化学习方法则存在样本效率低和可解释性差的问题。因此需要一种既能适应多样化逻辑结构又具备高样本效率和可解释性的自动化优化方法。

Method: SKILL采用统一架构，融合了多智能体LLM推理与基于RL的环境交互。具体包括：(1) 三个专业化LLM协同工作——GPT-4o用于战略规划、Claude Sonnet 4用于详细推理、Gemini 2.5 Pro用于高效分析；(2) 一个PPO-based RL智能体通过与综合工具直接交互来学习可执行的策略；(3) 一个新颖的自修正模块，通过监控环境反馈的PDA指标来检测次优行为，并调用LLM引导的恢复策略进行修正。

Result: 在IWLS、OpenCores和EPFL三大基准测试上，SKILL相比专家流程实现了12.4%的PDA（指标）改进，并在规模高达50万门的逻辑系统上取得了86.3%的成功率。

Conclusion: SKILL通过将多智能体LLM推理与RL环境交互相结合，并引入自修正机制，有效解决了逻辑综合优化中搜索空间巨大、奖励信号稀疏和结构多样化等挑战，在优化效果和成功率上均显著超越了传统专家流程。

Abstract: Logic synthesis optimization poses significant challenges due to exponentially growing search spaces, sparse reward signals, and diverse logic structures. Traditional expert-designed flows lack adaptability, while reinforcement learning (RL) methods often suffer from low sample efficiency and limited interpretability. We introduce SKILL, a Self-correcting Knowledge-guided Iterative Large Language Model Agent that unifies multi-agent LLM reasoning and RL-based environment interaction for automated synthesis optimization. SKILL coordinates three specialized LLMs: GPT-4o for strategic planning, Claude Sonnet 4 for detailed reasoning, and Gemini 2.5 Pro for efficient analysis with a PPO-based RL agent that learns actionable policies through direct interaction with synthesis tools. A novel self-correcting module monitors environment feedback (PDA metrics), detects suboptimal behaviors, and invokes LLM-guided recovery strategies. Evaluations on IWLS, OpenCores, and EPFL benchmarks show SKILL achieves a 12.4 % PDA improvement over expert flows and 86.3% success rate on logic systems up to 500K gates.

</details>


### [230] [OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14580)
*Francisco Javier Arceo,Sébastien Han,Matthew Farrellee,Charlie Doern,Yuan Tang,Derek Higgins,Varsha Prasad Narsing,Gordon Sim,Sumanth Kamenani,Ben Browning,Raghotham Murthy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OGX是一个开源的AI应用服务器和Python库，实现了各大前沿实验室（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）的API接口，通过可插拔的后端提供商支持超过20种推理引擎、13种向量存储后端，并配备Kubernetes Operator用于生产部署。该项目拥有超过8,400个GitHub星标、242位贡献者和4,000次提交。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者构建智能体AI应用（如RAG流水线、多轮智能体、工具调用工作流）时面临API碎片化问题，需要开发人员针对不同API表面编写不同代码；同时需要将推断引擎、向量数据库和安全后端的部署决策与SDK选择解耦。

Method: OGX提供了一个单一API表面（重点实现Open Responses规范下的Responses API，同时支持Anthropic Messages API和Google GenAI Interactions API），通过可插拔后端提供商的架构实现模型无关，并通过Companion Kubernetes Operator支持生产环境的自托管部署。

Result: OGX已支持超过20个推理提供商、13个向量存储后端，并作为Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode和OpenHands等AI驱动的开发者工具的自托管、模型无关后端。项目在近两年的公开开发中积累了8,400+ GitHub星标、242位贡献者和4,000次提交。

Conclusion: OGX作为一个自托管、模型无关的AI后端服务器，有效解决了开发者需要在不同API提供商之间切换的问题，实现了开发与部署的完全解耦，并已在开发者工具生态中获得广泛采用。

Abstract: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) is an open-source AI application server and Python library that implements the APIs of major frontier labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with pluggable backend providers. Developers building agentic AI applications--such as retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, multi-turn agents, and tool-calling workflows--can develop against a single API surface and deploy with any combination of inference engine, vector database, and safety backend, without changing application code. OGX's primary focus is the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration, conforming to the Open Responses specification. The server also supports the Anthropic Messages API and Google GenAI Interactions API, decoupling SDK choice from model and deployment decisions. With over 20 inference providers, 13 vector store backends, and a companion Kubernetes Operator for production deployment, OGX serves as the self-hosted, model-agnostic backend for AI-powered developer tools including Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and OpenHands. The project has over 8,400 GitHub stars, 242 contributors, and 4,000 commits across nearly two years of public development.

</details>


### [231] [Euclid-Omni : A Unified Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Plane Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14585)
*Zhaoyu Li,Hangrui Bi,Youyuan Zhang,Wenjie Ma,Zenan Li,Zhaolei Zhang,Xujie Si,Kaiyu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Euclid-Omni，一个统一的神经符号框架，将形式几何系统（Euclidea）与LLM和VLM相结合，解决从计算到证明、正式语言到自然语言的奥林匹克级欧几里得几何问题。通过数据生成管道合成大规模多样化的训练数据，在计算任务和证明任务上均取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧几里得几何是AI推理的理想测试平台，因为它要求直觉图理解、公理演绎和代数计算的结合。然而现有方法通常只处理这些能力的子集，或难以应对竞赛级别的难题，缺乏一个统一框架来同时涵盖计算和证明等多种推理形式。

Method: 构建Euclidea符号几何求解器，通过演绎推理和代数计算自动生成推理步骤。在此基础上开发数据生成管道，综合符号问题和解答、渲染图形并将其转化为自然语言，生成大规模多样化的训练数据集。使用这些数据训练LLMs和VLMs，并将LLM与Euclidea符号求解器耦合形成神经符号框架。

Result: 实验表明，在合成数据上训练的VLM在计算任务上表现优异；LLM与Euclidea结合后在奥林匹克级证明问题上与最先进系统竞争力相当，但使用的计算资源和训练数据量少几个数量级。

Conclusion: Euclid-Omni证明了神经符号框架能有效统一处理欧几里得几何中的多种推理需求，以极低的计算成本达到与最先进系统相当的性能，代码已公开。

Abstract: Euclidean geometry is a compelling testbed for AI reasoning, as it demands the combination of intuitive diagram understanding, axiomatic deduction, and algebraic computation. Yet, existing approaches typically address only a subset of these abilities or struggle with competition-level problems. We introduce \textit{Euclid-Omni}, a unified neuro-symbolic framework that couples a formal geometry system with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to tackle both calculation- and proving-style problems, in formal and natural languages, up to Olympiad-level difficulty. At its core, we develop \textit{Euclidea}, a versatile symbolic geometry solver that automatically generates reasoning steps through deductive inference and algebraic computation. Building on this, we develop a data-generation pipeline that synthesizes symbolic problems and solutions, renders diagrams, and translates them into natural language, producing large-scale, diverse datasets for training LLMs and VLMs across a wide range of reasoning settings. Experiments show that VLMs trained on our synthetic data achieve superior performance on calculation tasks, and that LLMs combined with \textit{Euclidea} are competitive with state-of-the-art systems on Olympiad-level proving problems, despite using orders of magnitude less compute and training data. Code and scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/20171130/Euclid-Omni

</details>


### [232] [An Agentic Framework Using Rules and LLMs for Embedding and Annotating Descriptive Document Layouts: A Plant Science Use Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14587)
*Nicolas Turenne,Youcef Sklab,Eric Chenin,Jean-Daniel Zucker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的、基于智能体的流水线框架，用于植物性状提取。该框架结合OCR、文本分割与索引、基于规则的解析器以及大语言模型集成，从大规模植物学语料中提取结构化性状注释。在三个区域性植物数据集上，系统提取了4,961个物种的55,737条性状注释，平均每个物种9.1条性状，并通过LLM富集使总注释量提升59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统信息检索技术虽在稠密/稀疏表示、LLM和专门检索模型方面取得进展，但在植物性状提取这一特定领域，需要一种能够处理大规模PDF文献、实现可扩展注释和可解释集成的新方法，以克服物种识别困难和大型植物语料库的解析挑战。

Method: 提出模块化智能体流水线：(1) OCR将PDF转换为机器可读文本；(2) 按属和种进行分割与索引；(3) 基于规则的解析器提取结构化植物性状；(4) 大语言模型集成扩展性状词汇并消解歧义。该系统强调可解释性、准确物种识别和可扩展注释。

Result: 在三个区域性植物数据集上，系统提取了55,737条性状注释，覆盖4,961个物种，平均每物种9.1条性状。LLM富集使75%的性状覆盖率提高，总注释量增长59%。OCR引擎选择对物种识别影响较小，注释数量保持稳定，证明流水线的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该模块化智能体流水线在大型植物性状提取任务中展现出鲁棒性、可扩展性和可靠性，验证了OCR、规则解析与LLM集成相结合的有效性，为植物学数据提取提供了可解释且规模化的解决方案。

Abstract: Background: Recent advances in information retrieval (IR) leverage both dense and sparse representations, large language models (LLMs), and specialized retrieval models to improve ranking accuracy, relevance, and cross-lingual performance. Complementary techniques such as passage indexing, document layout analysis, and semantic knowledge representation further enhance retrieval effectiveness by capturing fine-grained contextual and structural information. Emerging agentic LLM frameworks extend these capabilities by enabling planning, iterative reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration, thereby broadening applications across diverse domains. These frameworks also emphasize rigorous evaluation, ethical considerations, and trustworthiness, ensuring responsible deployment in real-world settings. We propose a modular, agent-based pipeline for botanical trait extraction. Optical character recognition (OCR) converts PDFs into machine-readable text, while segmentation and indexing organize content by genus and species. Rule-based parsers extract structured botanical traits, and ensembles of large language models (LLMs) expand trait vocabularies and resolve ambiguities. This approach ensures accurate species recognition, scalable annotation, and explainable integration of textual botanical descriptions, enabling robust and interpretable data extraction across large botanical corpora. Results: Using three regional botanical datasets, our system extracted 55,737 trait annotations across 4,961 species, averaging 9.1 traits per species. Integration of LLM-based enrichment improved coverage for 75% of traits, increasing total annotations by 59%. While the choice of OCR engine had a minor effect on species recognition, overall annotation counts remained stable, demonstrating the robustness, scalability, and reliability of the pipeline for large-scale botanical trait extraction.

</details>


### [233] [The Hallucination Snowball: Modeling Error Propagation as State Transitions in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14588)
*Prabhjot Singh,Bhushan Pawar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了顺序多智能体LLM流水线中幻觉的传播与放大问题，提出"幻觉雪球效应"（Hallucination Snowball Effect）形式化框架，将幻觉从原始事实到不可检测状态的演变建模为一阶马尔可夫过程。实验表明验证时机比验证本身更重要：在边界处验证可将幻觉存活率从58.4%降至16.2%，而仅在末端验证仅比不验证好2.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体LLM流水线在节点交接处缺乏验证机制，存在结构性缺陷。幻觉在流水线中不仅持续存在，还会通过从数值事实到派生态、再到叙述文本、最终到编辑批准结论的多次变换中不断"演化"，每次变换都使检测变得几乎不可逆地困难。这一问题此前未被形式化地研究和量化。

Method: 将幻觉雪球效应形式化为四状态的一阶马尔可夫过程（Raw Fact → Derived → Narrative → Invisible），在FinanceBench上的4智能体金融分析流水线中自动注入346个幻觉，使用gpt-4o和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B等模型进行检测，测量各边界处的逃逸概率，并对比边界验证与末端验证的有效性（使用Cohen's h效应量）。

Result: 边界间逃逸概率分别为24.6%、48.3%和89.3%；gpt-4o检测率从72.0%（阶段1）降至50.9%（阶段4），23.7%的幻觉在最终输出中完全未被检测到；最强模型（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）在阶段1达87.0%，但阶段4预测仅约60-65%。边界门控验证将幻觉存活率从58.4%降至16.2%（h=-0.911, p<0.000001），而末端检查仅提升2.3个百分点。

Conclusion: "何时验证比是否验证更重要"。最优验证策略应将资源优先分配在S1→S2边界（75.4%的幻觉仍可被捕获），而非S3→S4边界（89.3%的幻觉已逃逸）。研究为n智能体线性流水线的幻觉存活率提供了预测模型，并给出了最佳验证资源分配方案。

Abstract: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines chain specialized agents without verification at handoffs, creating a structural flaw with measurable and severe consequences. We show that hallucinations injected at Stage 1 do not merely persist; they transform: raw numerical facts become derived computations, then narrative prose, then editorially approved conclusions. At each transformation, detectability degrades near-irreversibly. We formalize this as the hallucination snowball effect, a first-order Markov process over four states (Raw Fact $\to$ Derived $\to$ Narrative $\to$ Invisible) with empirically measured per-boundary escape probabilities of 24.6%, 48.3%, and 89.3%. Across 346 automatically injected hallucinations in a 4-agent financial analysis pipeline on FinanceBench, gpt-4o detection drops from 72.0% at Stage 1 to 50.9% at Stage 4, and 23.7% of hallucinations survive completely undetected in the final output. Even the strongest model tested (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 87.0% at Stage 1) faces a structural ceiling; projected Stage 4 detection is only ${\sim}$60--65%. Critically, boundary gates using identical RAG verification tools reduce hallucination survival from 58.4% to 16.2% versus end-of-pipeline checking (Cohen's $h = -0.911$, $p < 0.000001$), while end-checking alone achieves merely 2.3 pp improvement over no verification. When you verify matters more than whether you verify. Our model predicts survival for $n$-agent linear pipelines and prescribes optimal verification resource allocation: invest at $S_1{\to}S_2$ first, where 75.4% of hallucinations are still catchable, not at $S_3{\to}S_4$ where 89.3% have already escaped.

</details>


### [234] [Toward Safe LLM Agents: A Survey of Specification, Verification, and Enforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14590)
*Pierre Dantas,Lucas Cordeiro,Ehsan Nowroozi,Tihanyi Norbert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对2022年至2026年间38项关于LLM智能体计划安全性的研究进行了PRISMA 2020系统综述，揭示了规范瓶颈、运行时监控成熟度、验证者税等关键发现，并提出三层分类法、比较分析、验证者税证据综合及十项研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益执行不可逆的真实世界操作（如数据库更新、API调用、文件操作），但现有系统缺乏正式、任务级的安全保障。研究在规范、验证和强制执行方面碎片化，限制了人们对现有方法优缺点的理解，亟需系统性的综述来填补这一空白。

Method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统综述方法论，从六个学术数据库中检索并筛选了2022至2026年间发表的38项研究。通过分析这些研究，提出了三层分类法（specification、verification、enforcement），并进行比较分析和证据综合。

Result: 四项关键发现：（1）规范瓶颈是首要挑战，自然语言到形式化翻译的语义正确率仅为24%-35%；（2）运行时监控是最成熟的强制策略，在受控环境中可将不安全行为减少40%-65%，但无法提供完全安全保障；（3）验证者税现象表明，即使阻止94%的不安全行为，安全任务完成率仍可能低于5%，因为智能体会利用替代的不安全路径；（4）现有方法无法同时实现完备性、可扩展性、语义正确性和任务级安全保持。

Conclusion: 现有研究没有任何方案能在单一框架中同时满足健全性、可扩展性、语义正确性和任务级安全保持。作者贡献了三层分类法、技术比较分析、验证者税的证据综合，以及面向可信智能体AI的十项研究议程，为该领域的未来研究方向提供了系统化指引。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly perform irreversible real-world actions, including database updates, API calls, file operations, and autonomous use of tools. However, no existing system provides formally grounded, task-level safety guarantees for the plans these agents generate. Research remains fragmented across specification, verification, and enforcement, limiting understanding of the strengths and limitations of existing approaches. To address this gap, we conducted a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of 38 studies published between 2022 and 2026 and retrieved from six academic databases. Our analysis reveals four key findings. First, the specification bottleneck remains the primary challenge: natural-language-to-formal translation achieves only 24% to 35% semantic correctness, undermining downstream verification. Second, runtime monitoring is the most mature enforcement strategy, reducing unsafe actions by 40% to 65% in controlled settings, but it does not provide complete safety guarantees. Third, the verifier tax shows that blocking 94% of unsafe actions can still result in less than 5% safe task completion because agents exploit alternative unsafe paths. Finally, no existing approach simultaneously achieves soundness, scalability, semantic correctness, and task-level safety preservation. We contribute a three-level taxonomy, a comparative analysis of existing techniques, a synthesis of evidence on the verifier tax, and a ten-problem research agenda for trustworthy agentic AI.

</details>


### [235] [Position: Medical AI Neglects Real Treatment Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14598)
*Shiva Kaul,Anjum Khurshid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是立场论文，指出医疗AI在诊断和预后任务上表现优异，但对治疗本身的理解训练与评估不足——目前依赖人类意见和文献合成（如生物医学出版物和临床指南），而非实际治疗结果数据。作者主张应将真实治疗结果（来自观察性数据库和随机实验）大量融入医疗AI的训练与评估，并重新强调改善治疗结果应作为所有医疗AI的最终目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗AI在诊断和预后任务上进步显著，但对治疗本身的理解长期被忽视，仅以人类意见和文本综述（文献、指南）作为训练和评估依据，未使用实际治疗结果数据，这种忽视严重限制了医疗AI的潜力。

Method: 作为立场论文（position paper），通过论证当前前沿模型和主要基准测试中存在的缺陷来支持其主张，提出应将真实治疗结果数据（来自观察性数据库和随机实验）实质性地纳入训练和评估，并重新强调改善治疗结果作为所有医疗AI的下游目标。

Result: 论证指出当前对治疗理解的忽视已导致前沿模型和主要基准测试出现不足，提出以真实治疗结果数据补充训练和评估的建议。

Conclusion: 应大幅纳入真实治疗结果数据（观察性数据库和随机实验来源）以改进医疗AI的训练与评估，并将改善治疗结果重新确立为所有医疗AI的最终下游目标。

Abstract: Medical AI has rapidly improved its ability to perform diagnostic and prognostic tasks that lead to treatment decisions. But understanding of treatment itself is still inadequately trained and evaluated, using human opinions and syntheses (especially texts such as biomedical publications and clinical practice guidelines) rather than actual underlying data on treatment outcomes. This neglect seriously limits the potential of medical AI, and is already causing deficiencies in both frontier models and major benchmarks, as argued in this position paper. Real treatment outcomes, drawn from sources such as observational databases and randomized experiments, should be substantially incorporated into both training and evaluation. Improving these outcomes should be reemphasized as the downstream goal of all medical AI.

</details>


### [236] [When Do LLMs Apply the Wrong Law? Diagnosing LLM Failures in Temporal Legal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14610)
*Yiqian Huang,Shuyuan Zheng,Qianying Liu,Shaowen Peng,Yuntao Kong,Kotaro Funakoshi,Chuan Xiao,Manabu Okumura,Yang Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个时间适用法律判定基准，系统研究了LLM在时间性法律推理中的失败原因，发现LLM存在强烈倾向适用最新法律而不考虑事实发生时间的偏差，并揭示这种偏差与强化学习塑造的显式推理有关，导致推理能力越强的模型在时间性法律推理上反而表现越差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律推理任务（如法律判决预测）需要识别案件所适用的时间上正确的法律版本，即"时间适用法律判定"能力。然而LLM是否能可靠执行该任务尚未被探索。

Method: 构建一个基准测试集来评估LLM在时间适用法律判定上的表现，并通过系统性实验探究其失败原因，包括检验模型对法律时间范围的理解能力、历史法规知识掌握程度，以及通过行为学证据分析强化学习对推理路径多样性的影响。

Result: 实验揭示四个关键发现：(1) LLM强烈偏向适用最近颁布的法律，忽略法律事实发生时间；(2) 该偏差并非源于不理解法律有时间范围或缺乏历史法规知识；(3) 强化学习塑造的显式推理是关键机制——在提升一般推理能力的同时降低推理路径多样性，导致模型收敛于适用当前法律；(4) 产生反直觉的反比关系：一般推理能力越强的模型在时间性法律推理上表现越差。

Conclusion: 研究为未来改进LLM在时间性法律推理上的表现提供了具体指导方向。

Abstract: Legal reasoning tasks such as legal judgment prediction (LJP) require identifying the temporally correct version of the law governing a case -- a capability we term temporal applicable-law determination. However, whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform this task remains unexplored. In this paper, we construct a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on temporal applicable-law determination, and systematically investigate why they fail at temporal legal reasoning. Our experiments reveal four key findings. First, LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward applying the most recently enacted law, regardless of when the legally relevant facts occurred. Second, this bias does not stem from an inability to understand that laws have temporal scope, nor from a lack of knowledge about historical statutes. Third, we provide behavioral evidence that reinforcement-learning-shaped explicit reasoning may be a key mechanism: while improving general reasoning ability, it reduces the diversity of reasoning paths, causing models to converge on applying the current law. Fourth, this produces a counterintuitive inverse relationship: models with stronger general reasoning ability tend to perform worse on temporal legal reasoning. Our findings offer concrete guidance for future work on improving LLM performance in temporally grounded legal reasoning.

</details>


### [237] [Do LLM Agents Negotiate Rationally? A Mechanism-Design Framework for Verifiable Multi-Agent Interaction over A2A/MCP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14613)
*Wael Albayaydh,Rui Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，将经典谈判机制（如交替报价谈判、VCG拍卖）编码为A2A协议约束，并添加轻量级运行时验证与修复层，以评估LLM智能体在协议交互中的战略正确性。实验表明结构化协议加验证能提升成功率和降低方差，但机制层面的激励兼容性不会自动迁移到LLM智能体行为中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体框架通过MCP和A2A等协议实现互操作，但这些协议只规定传输和发现机制，不保证战略正确性（战略性、个体理性或防策略行为）。随着LLM智能体被用于谈判和资源分配等任务，需要一种机制来验证交互是否符合博弈论预期。

Method: 框架包含三部分：(i) 将交替报价谈判和VCG拍卖等经典机制编码为A2A消息模式上的约束；(ii) 提供轻量级运行时验证与修复层，检查消息是否违反协议不变量；(iii) 构建带已知最优解的谈判与分配任务基准。实验对比多种LLM骨干在非结构化对话、结构化协议、以及结构化协议加验证三种条件下的表现。

Result: 谈判任务中（每条件N=30），验证层降低了结果方差，结构化协议实现100%成功率；修正解析伪影后，非结构化基线约为97%和93.3%。拍卖实验中（每模型N=30），两个模型均实现100%效率分配，但在诚实出价上差异显著：一个模型每次试验都按真实估值出价，另一个仅在3.3%试验中如此。三方公平分配任务仅产生4.2%可用结果，作为负结果报告并附诊断。

Conclusion: 机制层面的激励兼容性不会自动转移到LLM智能体行为中，因此需要在协议层进行可验证交互设计。这项工作弥合了经典多智能体系统理论与现代LLM智能体基础设施之间的鸿沟，在A2A协议层定义了可验证交互。

Abstract: Modern LLM-agent frameworks increasingly interoperate through standards such as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-tool access and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for agent delegation and negotiation. However, these protocols specify transport and discovery rather than strategic correctness and do not guarantee efficient, individually rational, or strategy-proof outcomes.
  We introduce a framework that (i) encodes classical negotiation mechanisms, including alternating-offers bargaining and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves-style auctions, as constraints over A2A message schemas; (ii) provides a lightweight runtime verification and repair layer that checks messages against protocol invariants; and (iii) offers a benchmark of negotiation and allocation tasks with known optimal solutions for measuring deviations from game-theoretic predictions.
  We evaluate multiple LLM backbones using unstructured dialogue, structured protocols, and structured protocols with verification. Across negotiation trials (N=30 per condition), verification reduces outcome variance, while structured protocols achieve 100 percent success for both models. After correcting parser artifacts, audited unstructured baselines achieve approximately 97 percent and 93.3 percent success.
  In auction experiments (N=30 per model), both models achieve 100 percent efficient allocation but differ sharply in truthful bidding: one bids its exact valuation in every trial, whereas the other does so in only 3.3 percent of trials. Thus, mechanism-level incentive compatibility does not automatically transfer to LLM-agent behavior. A three-party fair-allocation task produced only 4.2 percent usable outcomes; we report this negative result with a diagnosis. This work bridges classical multi-agent systems theory and modern LLM-agent infrastructure and defines verifiable interaction at the A2A protocol layer.

</details>


### [238] [Large Language Models and their Awareness of Mechanics and Spatial Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14615)
*Johannes Gerstmayr,Sebastian Weyrer,Tobias Möltner,Peter Manzl,Michael Pieber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MecEng基准，一个全自动评估LLM机械工程意识（力学与空间几何能力）的基准，包含84个多体仿真建模任务，涵盖刚性体、柔性多体系统（需3D几何生成、四面体有限元网格划分和模型降阶）。评估了32个开源和2个专有LLM，通过系统图同构、数值解和部件度量进行验证，结果显示最强开源模型在刚体任务上成功率86.0%，最优专有模型为91.4%，柔性任务更难，总体表明LLM机械工程意识虽快速提升但仍易出错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估集中于代码生成和数学推理基准，但LLM在力学和空间几何（即机械工程意识）方面的能力尚未被系统性量化，缺乏一个标准化基准来衡量LLM从参数化文本描述创建多体仿真模型的能力。

Method: 构建MecEng基准，包含84个分三个难度等级的通用任务（从带关节和接触的刚体系统到需要精确3D几何生成、四面体有限元网格划分及Hurty-Craig-Bampton模型降阶的柔性多体系统）。使用LLM专用流水线通过Netgen从文本生成可仿真的几何体，并为Exudyn代码构建多体系统模型，然后从系统图同构（含节点标注）、数值解、部件特定度量（质量、几何、固有频率）多层面与专家标准解进行验证。共评估32个开源和2个专有LLM，并研究采样温度、推理、提示设计、模型大小和发布日期的影响。

Result: 刚体任务上最强开源模型总体成功率达86.0%，最强专有模型为91.4%；柔性多体任务显著更难。额外的消融研究量化了采样温度、推理、提示设计、模型大小和LLM发布日期对性能的影响。

Conclusion: 当前LLM的机械工程意识在快速改进但仍易出错，MecEng提供了一个可复现的系统化基准来跟踪这一能力的发展，并揭示了从刚体到柔性多体系统的渐进难度阶梯。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on established code-generation and mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, but their capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry, here denoted as mechanical engineering awareness, has not been quantified systematically. We present MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that evaluates LLMs on the creation of multibody simulation models from parameterized textual descriptions. The benchmark comprises 84 generic tasks on three difficulty levels, ranging from rigid-body systems with joints and contact to flexible multibody systems that require exact 3D geometry generation, tetrahedral finite-element meshing, and Hurty-Craig-Bampton model order reduction of machine parts. A dedicated pipeline with LLMs generates simulation-ready geometry from text using Netgen, and builds multibody system models for the code Exudyn, which are then verified against expert ground truth on several levels: system-graph isomorphism including graph node annotations, numerical solutions, and part-specific measures such as mass, geometry, and eigenfrequencies. In total, 32 open-weight and two proprietary LLMs are evaluated. On rigid-body tasks, the best open-weight model obtains an overall success rate of 86.0%, compared to 91.4% for the strongest proprietary model, while flexible multibody tasks remain considerably harder. Additional studies quantify the influence of sampling temperature, reasoning, prompt design, model size, and LLM-release date. The results indicate rapidly improving, but still error-prone, mechanical engineering awareness of current LLMs.

</details>


### [239] [A Human-Centred Approach to Benchmarking LLMs for Parenting Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14622)
*Yunke Zhao,Isobel Voysey,Alastair van Heerden,Rob Hughes,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估了15个大语言模型在100个育儿场景（英中双语）中的建议质量，采用育儿专家构建的多维评价指标和LLM-as-a-judge方法，发现聚合分数会掩盖特定指标弱点、模型隐式鼓励不同育儿风格且语言影响回答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们越来越多地使用LLM获取育儿建议，但育儿是一个关键且社会敏感的领域。现有的聚合信息质量基准不足以评估育儿建议，需要考虑回答中的关系和行为元素，因此需要一个多维度的评估框架。

Method: 由育儿专家构建多维评价指标（rubric），对15个LLM在100个育儿场景（英语和中文两种语言）中生成的建议进行评估，采用LLM-as-a-judge方法进行自动化评价。

Result: 研究发现：1）聚合分数会掩盖rubric中特定指标上的薄弱点；2）模型隐式地鼓励不同的育儿风格；3）语言（英语vs中文）会影响模型回答。这些发现强调了评估输出可审计性的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究为选择适合直接用户交互的LLM以及开发面向用户的育儿建议应用提供了重要见解，同时揭示了在育儿这类领域评估LLM生成建议所面临的挑战。

Abstract: People are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to seek advice, including for parenting. Parenting is a critical and socially sensitive domain. Thus, evaluating advice provided by LLMs requires indicators beyond aggregated information quality benchmarks to consider relational and behavioural elements of the responses. With a multi-dimensional rubric created by parenting experts, this paper evaluates 15 LLMs across 100 parenting scenarios in 2 languages (English and Chinese), using an LLM-as-a-judge method. Results show that aggregate scores can hide rubric item-specific weaknesses, models implicitly encourage different parenting styles, and language influences responses. We highlight the importance of evaluation output auditability and challenges involved in evaluating LLM-generated advice in domains like parenting. Our findings provide important insights for selecting LLMs for direct user engagement and the development of user-facing parenting advice applications.

</details>


### [240] [Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14624)
*Rui Zhang,Chaeeun Kim,Shaoting Feng,Kuntai Du,Yuhan Liu,Yi Zhong,Cheng-Wei Ching,Junchen Jiang,Liting Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CacheScout 是一个面向多智能体 LLM 服务的智能体感知 KV-cache 运行时层，通过学习智能体执行转换语义来指导缓存驱逐和主动预取，相比现有基于前缀缓存和最近最少使用的被动策略，显著提升 KV-cache 命中率（10-18个百分点）、降低 TTFT（18-45%）和每轮延迟（29-38%），并提升峰值吞吐量（最高57%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中每个请求被分解为一系列专业化智能体执行，每个智能体反复执行固定上下文（系统提示、工具定义、少样本示例），产生了大量 KV-cache 重用机会。然而现有 LLM 服务系统采用被动的前缀缓存和基于最近使用（recency）的替换策略，导致可重用的智能体上下文在下一次调用前被驱逐，被迫重复计算，造成显著的性能浪费。

Method: CacheScout 的核心洞察是未来的 KV-cache 重用由智能体执行语义而非单纯的缓存最近性决定。它通过在线学习智能体执行转换（execution transitions）来捕获这些语义，无需预定义工作流图或离线训练。学习到的执行模型用于指导缓存驱逐决策和主动预取（proactive prefetching），同时保持服务关键路径不变。实现基于 vLLM 构建。

Result: 在代表性真实多智能体工作负载上，CacheScout 将 KV-cache 命中率提升 10-18 个百分点，平均 TTFT 降低 18-45%，每轮平均延迟降低 29-38%，峰值吞吐量提升最高 57%。在更大模型上也具有泛化性，TTFT 减少最高 54%，同时维持 37% 更高的吞吐量。

Conclusion: CacheScout 证明了将智能体执行语义纳入 KV-cache 管理可以显著超越传统的基于最近性的被动缓存策略。通过在线学习执行转换实现语义感知的缓存驱逐与预取，在无需修改服务关键路径的前提下大幅提升多智能体 LLM 服务的整体性能，且能泛化到更大规模的模型。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable agent contexts to be evicted before their next invocation and forcing repeated recomputation. We present CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer for multi-agent LLM serving. The key insight is that future KV-cache reuse is governed by agent execution semantics rather than cache recency alone. CacheScout captures these semantics by learning agent execution transitions online, without requiring predefined workflow graphs or offline training, and uses the learned execution model to guide both cache eviction and proactive prefetching while leaving the serving critical path unchanged. We implement CacheScout on top of vLLM. Across representative real-world multi-agent workloads, CacheScout improves KV-cache hit rate by 10-18 percentage points, reduces mean TTFT by 18-45%, lowers mean per-turn latency by 29-38%, and increases peak throughput by up to 57%. These benefits also generalize to larger models, reducing TTFT by up to 54% while sustaining 37% higher throughput.

</details>


### [241] [Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14631)
*Amelia Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究对14种大型语言模型（LLM）在化妆品化学领域的知识准确度进行了基准测试。在禁用网络搜索的条件下，模型整体表现不佳，尤其在定量推理和结构识别任务上缺陷最为明显。研究发现，AI输出中听起来权威但包含技术错误的内容比明确表达不确定性的回答更不容易引起用户的怀疑，构成潜在风险。作者认为通用LLM目前不可靠，需要微调验证过的化学和皮肤病学数据集以及改进算法推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着消费者日益依赖AI聊天机器人获取护肤建议，LLM在化妆品化学领域的技术准确性尚未得到充分评估。鉴于错误的美容化学信息可能对消费者决策产生负面影响，有必要系统性地评估这些模型在该专业领域的内化知识水平。

Method: 对14个LLM进行基准测试，测试内容涵盖化妆品化学的结构化主题集，包括特定化妆品成分的化学属性以及消费者可能关心的常见化妆品场景。全程禁用网络搜索，以评估每个模型的内化知识而非互联网检索能力。

Result: 整体表现较差，最显著的缺陷集中在定量推理和结构识别任务。模型虽能合理处理一般性护肤问题，但回答普遍缺乏支撑消费者知情决策所需的技术深度。此外，AI对话存在风险：听起来权威但包含技术错误的输出比明确承认不确定性的回答更不容易引发怀疑。

Conclusion: 通用型LLM（主要基于未经核实的公共数据训练）目前不能作为化妆品化学信息的可靠来源。需要在两个方向取得进展——微调经过验证的化学和皮肤病学数据集，以及大幅改进算法推理能力——这些工具才可能被考虑作为公众可用的资源。

Abstract: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate skepticism compared to responses that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. These findings suggest that general-purpose LLMs, trained predominantly on unverified public data, are currently not reliable sources of cosmetic chemistry information. Progress on two fronts, fine-tuning verified chemical and dermatological datasets, and substantial improvements to algorithmic reasoning, will likely be needed before these tools can be considered as resources for public use.

</details>
