Result: 研究发现个体和群体动态可归纳为三种特征状态：漠不关心、两极分化和共识。在客观问题上交流提升集体准确性，而在主观问题上意见常向政治光谱右端偏移。所提出的统计力学模型预测个体轨迹的表现超越所有标准基线，并能泛化到未见社区图，复现观测到的群体原型分布。拟合参数揭示：社区运行在临界社会温度之下（解释信念构建）、吸引性连接多于排斥性连接（促进共识）、持有正确答案的代理具有最强影响力（驱动求真）。

Conclusion: AI代理的集体行为，与其他复杂系统一样，遵循紧凑且可预测的动力学规律。该研究证明多代理系统的集体动态可以被统一建模和预测，为设计有效且对齐的多代理系统提供了理论基础。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange messages and revise their opinions across objective mathematics questions and subjective political statements. Despite substantial diversity in possible behavior, the individual and group dynamics can be represented by three characteristic regimes: indifference, polarization, and consensus. AI agents start indifferent and build conviction as they interact. On objective questions, communication improves collective accuracy, while on subjective questions it often drifts group opinions toward the right in the political spectrum. We explain these observations with a statistical-mechanics formalism in which agents stochastically favor lower social pressure. Given only initial opinions, our model predicts individual trajectories, outperforms all standard baselines, generalizes to unseen community graphs, and reproduces the observed group archetype distributions. Our fitted model parameters reveal the mechanics underlying our key observations: i) communities operate below the critical social temperature, which explains conviction buildup; ii) attractive ties outweigh repulsive ones, which favors consensus; and iii) agents holding the correct answer exert the strongest pull, which drives truth-seeking. Overall, our results demonstrate that collective behavior of AI agents, like that of other complex systems, follows compact and predictive dynamical laws.

</details>


### [402] [CACSurv: Concordance-Aligned Comparative Learning with Large Language Models for Cancer Survival Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16594)
*Tianqi Xiang,Qixiang Zhang,Xinpeng Ding,Yi Li,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CACSurv，一种基于LLM的报告中心癌症生存预测框架。CACSurv将生存建模重构为小队列比较推理，利用一致性对齐奖励在右删失下提供排序监督，并在推理时通过蒙特卡洛参考聚合生成队列级排名。在覆盖六个TCGA癌症队列的TCGA-SurvReport基准上，CACSurv在所有六个队列上均取得最高C-index，平均C-index为0.722，显著优于现有最强方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生存预测方法主要依赖结构化临床变量、全切片图像、基因组图谱或多模态输入，而患者报告（组织病理、临床和分子证据的组织化文本）未被充分探索。虽然LLM能够理解这类报告，但逐病例时间回归存在两个关键不匹配：(1) 公式不匹配——生存评估依赖可比患者的排序一致性，而独立时间预测不保证排名一致性；(2) 监督不匹配——删失患者的观测时间仅表示其存活超过该时间点，不能作为精确回归目标，但仍能隐含与更早死亡患者的顺序关系。

Method: CACSurv将生存建模重新定义为小队列比较推理：LLM预测患者的相对预后排序。引入一致性对齐奖励（concordance-aligned rewards），基于右删失下可比较的关系提供排序监督，使删失结果无需精确事件时间目标即可提供排序监督。推理阶段采用蒙特卡洛参考聚合（MCRA），将每个患者与采样参考进行比较并聚合位置形成队列级排名。同时构建了覆盖六个TCGA癌症队列的基准数据集TCGA-SurvReport。

Result: CACSurv在TCGA-SurvReport基准的六个癌症队列上均取得了最高的C-index，平均C-index达到0.722，比最强已发表生存模型高出6.5个百分点，比最强LLM时间回归基线高出4.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 报告中心的方法是生存预测中一个有前景的方向，而将生存建模重构为比较推理并引入一致性对齐奖励，可以有效解决时间回归在公式和监督上的双重不匹配，显著提升生存预测性能。

Abstract: Cancer survival prediction supports treatment planning, risk stratification, and follow-up management. Existing methods use structured clinical variables, whole-slide images, genomic profiles, or multimodal inputs, while patient reports remain underexplored. We study report-centric survival prediction using reports that organize pathological, clinical, and molecular evidence. Large language models (LLMs) can reason over such reports, but case-wise time regression introduces two mismatches. First, a formulation mismatch arises because survival evaluation depends on ordering comparable patients, whereas independent time predictions do not enforce ranking consistency. Second, a supervision mismatch arises because a censored patient's observed time indicates survival beyond that point and cannot serve as an exact regression target, although it still implies orderings relative to patients who died earlier. To address these mismatches, we propose CACSurv, a Concordance-Aligned Comparative framework for report-centric survival prediction. CACSurv reformulates survival modeling as mini-cohort comparative reasoning, where an LLM predicts relative prognostic orderings. We introduce concordance-aligned rewards derived from comparable relations under right censoring, enabling censored outcomes to provide ranking supervision without exact event-time targets. At inference, Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation compares each patient with sampled references and aggregates positions into a cohort-level ranking. We establish TCGA-SurvReport, a benchmark covering six TCGA cancer cohorts. CACSurv achieves the highest C-index on all six cohorts and an average C-index of 0.722, outperforming the strongest published survival model by 6.5 percentage points and the strongest LLM time-regression baseline by 4.2 percentage points. Our code, models, and dataset will be available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/CACSurv.

</details>


### [403] [Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16621)
*Yusuke Takahashi,Kyle Wild,Asako Uraki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将语料库的语义含义在摄入时一次性编译为紧凑、可查询的语义基质（semantic substrate），并通过增量低秩更新与正交Procrustes虚轴更新来维护，而非在每次查询时重新推导语义。实验表明维护成本与变化量成正比而非与语料库规模成正比：增量低秩更新比全量重SVD便宜33.7倍/次、累计便宜23.8倍，且精度达到浮点级（主角度漂移<1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）；Procrustes虚轴更新仅需重嵌入约10%的语料即可恢复0.95的均余弦相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前检索增强与智能体问答系统在每次查询时都需要重新推导语料库的语义含义，这类似"解释器"模式，效率低下。作者提出的替代方案是在文档到达时一次性编译语义（"编译器"模式），但核心反对意见在于维护成本：每次变更都重建截断SVD看似代价高昂，且更换嵌入模型似乎需要全量重嵌入。本文旨在反驳这一观点，证明维护成本与变化量成正比而非语料库规模。

Method: 1) 提出在摄入时将语料库编译为紧凑、可查询的语义基质（如低秩SVD子空间），并随语料演化持续维护；2) 采用增量低秩更新算法（incremental low-rank updates）替代全量重算SVD；3) 针对嵌入模型更换场景，提出正交Procrustes虚轴更新（orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update），仅需重嵌入约10%的语料即可对齐新旧嵌入空间；4) 通过受控合成实验（维度256、秩32、语料从3000增至9000文档、50次更新事件）验证方法。

Result: 合成实验结果显示：1) 增量低秩更新每次比全量重SVD便宜33.7倍，累计便宜23.8倍；2) 增量子空间与全量重计算在浮点精度内一致（最大主角度漂移低于1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）；3) 正交Procrustes虚轴更新仅需重嵌入约10%语料即可恢复0.95的平均余弦相似度。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持"维护而非反复重建"语义基质的策略：语义维护成本由变化量决定而非语料库规模，增量更新在计算效率与数值精度上均可行，为长期演化的检索增强问答系统提供了一种可持续的语义索引方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

</details>


### [404] [A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16626)
*Zhihui Chen,Yize Sun,Yuhao Dong,Zeyu Xiao,Ray Y. Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对配备RFID技术的智能工厂车间动态调度问题，提出一种基于深度强化学习的调度框架。通过对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计来量化操作与生产不确定性，并据此构建深度强化学习调度模型。基于真实案例数据的仿真表明，该框架在最小化完工时间方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFID技术已广泛应用于制造车间实时数据采集以支持动态调度，但操作和生产过程中的不确定性共同导致了制造的动态性，阻碍了调度系统实现最大效用。现有调度方法未能充分量化和处理此类不确定性，因此需要一种能够有效应对动态环境的不确定性、提高车间调度性能的方法。

Method: 本文提出一种基于RFID数据分析的深度强化学习动态生产调度框架。首先，对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计，以分别量化操作不确定性和生产不确定性；然后基于该数据分析结果构建深度强化学习模型，用于车间生产调度决策。

Result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真实验验证了所提出框架的可行性和实用性。结果表明，所提出的调度框架在最小化操作完工时间方面优于传统的先入先出（FIFO）、后入先出（LIFO）以及深度Q网络（DQN）等现有调度方法。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，通过RFID数据量化制造过程中的不确定性并利用深度强化学习进行调度决策，能够有效提升智能工厂车间调度的动态响应能力和效率，为实际制造场景中的动态生产调度提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).

</details>


### [405] [Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16628)
*Shenao Chen,Yidan Xu,Xiangmin Han,Rundong Xue,Duanpo Wu,Yuhan Gao,Chenggang Yan,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，通过高阶超图表示学习重新定义多模态文档检索，使用超边作为统一语义容器捕获文本、图像、表格间的N元关联，并引入锚点驱动的增量精炼机制以低成本弥合跨页知识鸿沟，在检索精度和生成连贯性上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多模态检索增强生成（M-RAG）系统受限于简单图的二元连接范式，无法捕获异构实体间的高阶N元关联（如图表、散落文本描述与底层数值数据间的关系）；同时现有精炼策略依赖全页面重建来对齐跨模态信息，导致计算冗余和长文档处理中的上下文噪声。

Method: 1) 将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，以超边作为统一语义容器封装跨文本、图像和表格的多向关联，超越点对点建模；2) 提出锚点驱动的增量精炼机制（Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement），不进行全局扫描，而是识别跨页边界锚节点，利用一跳邻域上下文重构其局部超拓扑，以最小计算代价弥合跨页知识缺口。

Result: 在多模态基准数据集上的广泛评估显示，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两个维度均显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: Hyper-M2RAG通过高阶超图表示学习与锚点驱动的增量精炼机制，有效解决了M-RAG系统中高阶关联建模缺失和全页重建计算冗余两大核心问题，为多模态文档检索提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

</details>


### [406] [PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16637)
*Veit Laule,Jiangtao Shuai,Manfred Hauswirth,Sonja Schimmler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PDDLCoder，一个用于从自然语言生成PDDL规划规范的智能体框架，能够迭代地生成、分析和细化规划规范；同时引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含23个领域的711个规划问题及可执行gym环境。在106个问题的测试集上，PDDLCoder生成可应用规划的成功率达89.6%，远超现有PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在长时域规划中不可靠，常生成逻辑不一致或不可应用的规划。混合方法将自然语言翻译为PDDL以利用符号规划器，但现有方法依赖僵化的生成流程、不完整的PDDL定义或人工反馈，且缺乏标准化基准和自动验证手段来评估其性能。

Method: 提出PDDLCoder智能体框架，采用迭代式的"生成-分析-精炼"循环来自动构建PDDL规划规范；同时构建NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含711个规划问题和23个领域，配备可执行的gym环境以支持规划可应用性的自动验证。

Result: 在包含106个问题、跨4个留出域的NL-pddlgym测试集上，PDDLCoder实现了89.6%的可应用规划生成成功率，显著优于先前PDDL生成方法的适配版本（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。

Conclusion: 实验证明智能体式PDDL生成在规划任务上的有效性，并为LLM辅助符号规划的未来研究建立了可复现的基准。

Abstract: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

</details>


### [407] [Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16645)
*Shaolong Chen,Yanlin Fei,Nazhou Liu,Xinmiao Yu,Lei Li,Rahul Thapa,Madalina Ciobanu,Qingqing Mao,Ritankar Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Reconstruction，一个盲想法恢复基准，仅凭论文发表前的参考文献让模型恢复已发表论文的真实研究想法。在六个科学领域643篇论文上，前沿模型匹配率仅3-15%；而结合跨模型评审与瑞士锦标赛的多智能体流水线可将匹配率提升至23-42%，约为最佳单模型基线的2.4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测无法验证模型能否仅从研究前的上下文（即参考文献）中重构出论文的核心研究想法，且缺乏防泄漏的严格设计。作者希望探究语言模型在无种子论文及时期后续文献的情况下，能否基于引文关系推断研究思路。

Method: 构建Reconstruction基准：(1) 扣留种子论文及所有同期/未来文献，仅提供发表前参考文献；(2) 采用严格防泄漏协议——时间引用截断、匿名引用ID、冻结每篇论文的书目，防止提示时泄漏；(3) 由独立LLM裁判将模型提出的假设与隐藏的真实想法进行匹配评分；(4) 提出参考仅多智能体流水线（top-4）：结合跨模型评审与基于对齐假设槽的瑞士锦标赛选择，不依赖外部网络搜索。

Result: 在六个科学领域、643篇论文上，七个前沿模型的匹配率仅约3-15%；跨模型评审加锦标赛选择将匹配率提升至约23-42%，相对最佳单模型基线达到约2.4倍提升。

Conclusion: 仅凭参考文献恢复论文研究想法是极具挑战的任务，现有单模型表现有限；但通过多智能体协作（跨模型评审+结构化锦标赛选择）可显著提升恢复能力，该协议与防泄漏设计以arXiv时间戳形式作为初稿发布。

Abstract: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.

</details>


### [408] [Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16666)
*Amrapali Pednekar,Alvaro Garrido-Perez,Yara Khaluf,Pieter Simoens*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Chronocooked，一个基于强化学习的基准测试套件，用于研究RL代理中的隐式间隔计时能力。受Overcooked启发，该套件涉及需要时间决策的烹饪场景，奖励函数设计使得时间信息不可观测但对最优性能至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL代理缺乏时间感知能力，而这在人类-机器人交互和依赖时间的人类社会中至关重要。作者旨在通过设计一个简单可控的基准环境来系统地暴露和评估RL代理在隐式间隔计时方面的局限性，从而强调将时间感知纳入人工智能代理的必要性。

Method: 设计了一个基于Overcooked的RL基准测试套件Chronocooked，包含需要时间决策的烹饪场景。时间信息在环境中被有意隐藏但影响最优策略。环境保持简单以支持可控实验和生物合理模型。评估指标专门设计用于暴露RL代理计时能力的不足，并报告了非循环、循环和生物合理三种模型的基线结果。

Result: 报告了使用非循环模型、循环模型和生物合理模型的基线实验结果，评估指标成功暴露了这些RL代理在隐式间隔计时能力上的局限性。

Conclusion: 该工作凸显了在人工智能代理（特别是面向人机交互和部署在依赖时间的人类社会中的代理）中融入时间感知和时序处理能力的必要性。

Abstract: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

</details>


### [409] [FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16697)
*Aniri,Chen Yilin,Jinhe Bi,Junfei Guo,Donglai Ran,Xu Bian,Zengjie Jin,Yujun Wang,Yijun Tian,Volker Tresp,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua,Yunpu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MAE（马克可夫注意力熵）框架，将VLA模型内部注意力信号转化为架构感知的可靠性评分，实现无需外部监督的自主行动生成可靠性评估，并引入LIBERO-Reflect基准验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型已在多个异构架构中整合视觉、语言和动作生成，但如何在无外部监督下让VLA自评其动作生成的可靠性仍是一大挑战。现有方法要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计量估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号。

Method: 观察到内部视觉模态熵在不同VLA架构的成功与失败任务间存在一致区分。将VLA的动作生成抽象为条件生成马尔可夫链，基于此提出MAE框架，直接将内部注意力信号转化为架构感知的可靠性分数。同时构建LIBERO-Reflect基准（4000个回合，含2000标准+2000挑战样本，覆盖四个子集）。

Result: 在异构VLA架构和多样场景上的大量实验中，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上持续优于最先进基线。实例化FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择，MAE引导的多重采样在不显著增加运行开销的情况下提升了PI系列在LIBERO-Plus上的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: MAE通过对内部注意力信号的利用，超越了仅基于输出统计的不确定性估计方法，为VLA模型提供了有效的无需外部监督的自评估机制，并在测试时动作选择场景中验证了其实际价值。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

</details>


### [410] [LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16763)
*Ruoqi Shu,Xuhui Wang,Isaac Wang,Yanming Mai,Bo Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAVA是一个基于多模态大语言模型的模块化、骨干无关的流水线，用于金融文档验证。它采用四阶段设计：文档规则检索、保持布局的信息提取、辅助元数据增强和可审计的符号/算术验证，在保证高效token使用的同时提升了幻觉控制和边缘案例处理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融文档验证（如工资审计、税务合规、贷款承销）在生产环境中要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但现实中文档具有异构布局、语义丰富且上下文依赖的内容以及嵌入的业务规则，现有流水线难以可靠处理这些挑战。

Method: LAVA是一个模块化、骨干无关的流水线，基于多模态大语言模型，集成四阶段设计：(1) 文档-规则检索，实现稳健的规则基础； (2) 保持布局的信息提取； (3) 辅助元数据增强； (4) 可审计的符号/算术验证，支持细粒度错误归因和一致的、可追溯的端到端执行。

Result: 在包含多样化金融文档和数十条专家策划验证规则的大型真实世界基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘案例处理方面优于基线方法，同时保持高效token使用，证明其适用于高容量、时间关键的验证场景。

Conclusion: LAVA展示了在高风险金融文档验证部署中的实用性，通过多阶段模块化设计实现了规则接地、错误归因和可追溯执行，在准确性和效率之间取得了良好的平衡。

Abstract: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

</details>


### [411] [GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16776)
*Lirui Teng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GRIP框架，通过容量不对称（查询全维访问、检索证据经随机瓶颈）解决RAG中查询主导隐状态导致的证据失效问题（query dominance），在五个推理基准上超越强迭代基线，将查询-隐状态互信息削减约30倍，幻觉降低73%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，高容量编码器可能导致查询在隐状态中占据主导地位，使检索到的证据在功能上变得无关紧要。这种"查询主导"（query dominance）失效模式会导致模型忽略证据、产生幻觉，亟需一种机制确保证据通道真实有效。

Method: GRIP引入容量不对称设计：解码器对查询保持全维度访问，而检索到的证据必须通过一个严重的随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck）。这种强制机制迫使证据通道仅编码查询中不可用的残差信息，从而在架构层面保证证据的独立贡献。

Result: 在五个推理基准上，GRIP优于强迭代基线；查询-隐状态互信息诊断指标从14.8比特降至0.47比特（约30倍削减）；幻觉率降低73%；残差对齐分析表明瓶颈输出占据与查询对齐程度更低的子空间。

Conclusion: 容量不对称与信息瓶颈是缓解RAG中查询主导问题的有效手段，能够增强证据利用率、提升推理性能并显著降低幻觉。

Abstract: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

</details>


### [412] [Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16831)
*Minh-Ha Nguyen,Cathy Shyr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出政策迭代与人类反馈（PIHF）方法，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底，通过版本化的自然语言政策和工具集进行持续修订，在罕见病诊断基准上将Recall@1提升了31-33个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式预训练已建立了可重用的任务表示，但如何在固定模型中持续改进策略仍是一个挑战。作者希望将广义策略迭代的"评估-改进"循环结构与预训练语言模型相结合，使模型能够通过自然语言政策修订来持续提升性能，特别是在罕见病诊断这类专家知识密集的任务上。

Method: PIHF采用预训练语言模型作为执行基底，将持续的修订过程转移到版本化的自然语言政策和工具集中。具体而言，一个语言模型评论家和临床专家共同审查完整的推理路径和工具使用轨迹，定位反复出现的故障并形成候选修订方案。专家可以重新解释证据，并对修订的采纳和回滚拥有最终权威，而Recall@1和Recall@5在候选执行后进行结果验证。

Result: 在累积消融实验和超罕见疾病基准上，PIHF派生的政策在1个专有执行器和3个开源执行器（3至490亿活跃参数）上均提升了Recall@1。GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者相差1.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基底，配合专家引导的政策开发（PIHF），在罕见病诊断中是可行的，且在不同规模和闭/开源模型上均表现出显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

</details>


### [413] [What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16852)
*Saisab Sadhu,Aadit Sengupta,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现当前所有合规检测器（包括防护模型和激活探针）都存在"规则盲视"问题，即检测结果不依赖于所陈述的规则，删除/置换/替换规则都不改变检测输出。作者提出无训练的ICS检测器，但严格评估显示它未能超越简单基线，其价值仅在于成本低廉可规模化审计。文章发布跨规则基准和反事实协议供后续评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合规监控要真正有意义，检测器的判定必须取决于明文规则而非场景的表面特征。然而现有防护模型和激活探针普遍存在"规则盲视"（rule blindness）——检测结果与所依据的规则无关，导致合规监控失去其作为法律与审计控制的核心意义。需要一个能验证检测器是否真正遵循规则的协议和基准。

Method: 本文采用三类方法：(1) 反事实协议：删除、置换、替换合规规则文本，测试所有防护模型和激活探针检测准确率是否变化；(2) 交叉规则基准：设计2规则×2场景的交叉设计，使单一特征无法预测标签，排除先前基准的混淆因素；(3) 提出ICS（Internal Compliance Score）：无训练激活读数，用10个标注样本校准并单投影打分。同时采用预注册标准、朴素基线对照、自适应白盒攻击等严格评估措施。

Result: 所有测试的防护模型和激活探针均表现出规则盲视，即使策略条件化防护模型能正确引用法规条款，但将该条款置换为宽松对应条款时判定几乎不变。ICS未达到预注册的超越平凡基线标准，词袋模型与其泛化性能完全等同。但ICS因成本低可用于审计4个防护模型、8B零样本法官和13个基准，并能在排序候选回复时提高机械验证通过率，但自适应白盒攻击可消除这一增益。

Conclusion: 当前合规检测器类别普遍存在规则盲视，规模化合规审计必须依靠逐步推理而非任意快速检测器。ICS虽在严格标准下未超越基线，但作为廉价审计工具仍具实用价值。作者发布反事实协议和交叉规则基准，使规则盲视可在未来的探针和防护声明中被测试。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [414] [Incision trajectory tracing for electrosurgical navigation by CNN-based knife contacting frames extraction method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14749)
*Yu Chun Wang,Kaixu Chen,Naoto Ienaga,Yoshihiro Kuroda*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的热图像分类方法，用于区分电刀和超声刀与组织接触时的热特征，从而提取刀具接触帧并形成手术切口轨迹，解决了图像引导手术导航中无法动态更新术前三维模型的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像引导手术导航能够识别皮下靶点和关键结构，但需要在手术过程中动态更新术前三维模型，而现有方法（如卷积长短期记忆方法）存在轨迹缺失的问题，因此需要一种能够自动提取刀具接触帧并形成切口轨迹的新方法。

Method: 首先验证CNN能够分别对电刀和超声刀操作的热图像进行分类；然后利用CNN预测为"接触"的帧，提取其热强度质心，并连接这些质心形成切口轨迹；电刀和超声刀均作为验证工具。

Result: 电刀实验中CNN识别准确率高达97.2%，切口轨迹预测误差相比传统方法降低了2.5倍以上；超声刀实验也获得了高达93.7%的识别准确率。

Conclusion: 本研究证实了CNN在区分电动工具与组织接触状态方面的可行性，所提方法不仅克服了卷积长短期记忆方法中常见的轨迹缺失问题，还显著提升了轨迹预测精度且限制更少。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Image-guided surgical navigation has been actively studied because of its advantage of identifying subsurface targets and critical structures, whereas it requires incision trajectories to update the preoperative three-dimensional model dynamically during the surgery. The novelty of this study is the thermal feature distinguishment of whether the electric tools contacting the tissue by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the extraction of the knife contacting frames, to form incision trajectories which can meet with the requirement during the surgery. Methods: This study firstly verified that CNN can classify the thermal images of electric knife and ultrasonic cutter operations separately, and can raise the accuracy of the incision trajectories derived from the connection of the thermal intensity centroid of the frames predicted by CNN as contacting. Results: Our results obtained by employing the electric knife not only reveal a remarkably high accuracy 97.2 % in CNNs identification, but also can achieve an error reduction as high as more than 2.5 times of the incision trajectory prediction as compared to those proceeded in the conventional method. Besides electric knife, the results obtained by employing another electric tool, ultrasonic cutter, reveal a high accuracy up to 93.7 %. Conclusion: In this study, we ensured the possibility of CNN in distinguishing electric tools contacting with the tissue, and confirmed that the proposed method has not only overcome the problem of missing trajectories which usually occurs in the convolutional long-short term memory method but also achieved a remarkable improvement of the accuracy with less limitation.

</details>


### [415] [A Unified DINOv2-Based Framework for LVEF Estimation, GLS Dysfunction Classification, and Early Cardiotoxicity Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14750)
*Xiaotong Zhang,Mingyue Cui,Qing Cao,Jingming Xia*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于DINOv2基础模型的框架，同时解决心脏肿瘤学评估中的三个互补任务：LVEF估计、GLS功能不全分类和早期心脏毒性预测。框架采用冻结的基础编码器加LoRA适配和时序聚合，无需心动周期分割或ED/ES标注即可推理。在237例患者训练集和59例独立患者验证集上，三个任务分别达到MAE 5.03%、AUC-ROC 76.48%和70.26%的性能，而专用的ED/ES引导2D/3D多视角回归模型将LVEF估计进一步优化至MAE 4.64%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心脏肿瘤学评估需要LVEF（宏观心室容积变化）、GLS（亚临床心肌变形）和早期心脏毒性预测（基线预防干预）三种互补信息，但现有方法往往需要心动周期分割或ED/ES明确标注，推理复杂度高且依赖特定生理学知识。作者希望探索基础模型（foundation model）表征能否通过轻量适配同时覆盖这三个多样化的任务，并验证生理学引导建模能否进一步提升LVEF估计精度。

Method: 框架基于冻结的DINOv2基础编码器，采用参数高效的LoRA适配和时序聚合机制学习任务专用表征，推理阶段完全无需心跳周期检测和ED/ES标注，实现免周期分割、免相位标注的端到端处理。此外，针对Task 1专门设计了ED/ES引导的2D/3D混合多视角回归模型以优化LVEF估计。数据采用患者级划分：237例患者的1,203个训练视频和59例独立患者的300个验证视频。

Result: DINOv2基础框架在Task 1（LVEF估计）上取得MAE 5.03%，在Task 2（GLS功能障碍分类）上获得AUC-ROC 76.48%，在Task 3（早期心脏毒性预测）上获得AUC-ROC 70.26%。专用的ED/ES引导模型在Task 1上将MAE提升至4.64%。

Conclusion: 该工作证明基础模型表征能够有效泛化于多样化的心脏肿瘤学任务，无需复杂的心动周期分割或ED/ES标注即可获得良好的多任务性能；同时验证了引入生理学引导（ED/ES）的建模策略能进一步优化LVEF估计的精度，为心脏超声基础模型的应用提供了可参考的范式。

Abstract: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) estimation (Task 1), global longitu-dinal strain (GLS)-based dysfunction classification (Task 2), and early cardi-otoxicity prediction (Task 3) provide complementary information for cardio-oncology assessment. LVEF reflects macroscopic ventricular volume chang-es as the clinical standard, whereas GLS captures subtle myocardial defor-mation, indicating subclinical cardiotoxicity before overt LVEF decline. Fur-thermore, predicting cardiotoxicity from baseline echocardiography prior to treatment enables preventive interventions at an early stage. To address these three tasks, we employ a DINOv2-based framework with task-specific adap-tation and prediction heads. Built upon a frozen foundation encoder, the framework incorporates parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and temporal aggregation to learn task-specialized representations, ensuring robust generalization. Crucially, during inference, it operates in a fully cycle-detection-free and phase-free manner, requiring neither cardiac cycle seg-mentation nor explicit End-Diastolic/End-Systolic (ED/ES) annotations. Ad-ditionally, we introduce an ED/ES-guided 2D/3D hybrid multi-view regres-sion model specifically to optimize Task 1. On a patient-level split containing 1,203 training videos from 237 patients and 300 validation videos from 59 independent patients, the DINOv2-based framework achieved a mean abso-lute error (MAE) of 5.03% for Task 1, an AUC-ROC of 76.48% for Task 2, and an AUC-ROC of 70.26% for Task 3. For Task 1, the specialized ED/ES-guided model further improves performance, achieving an MAE of 4.64%. This framework demonstrates the effectiveness of foundation model repre-sentations across diverse cardio-oncology tasks and the additional benefit of physiology-guided modeling for accurate LVEF estimation.

</details>


### [416] [KHiM-Mamba: Injecting Pathology Knowledge into Mamba via Hidden-State Modulation for Whole Slide Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14757)
*Qixiang Zhang,Yi Li,Tianqi Xiang,Haonan Wang,Mengjiao Wei,Bo Xu,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出KHiM-Mamba架构，通过知识感知的隐状态调制机制，将显式知识先验引入Mamba的选择性状态空间模型中，引导全切片图像的编码动态向诊断相关证据积累，在11个公开基准的4项任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于SSM的MIL方法仅依赖视觉特征进行选择性动态建模，但在大规模WSI中，稀疏的病理决策区域被大量无关信息包围，纯视觉驱动的选择性状态更新会错误分配计算资源，导致SSM状态累积任务无关证据并稀释关键诊断线索。

Method: 1) 重新设计原始SSM层，在隐藏状态演化过程中执行知识调制操作，指导每个编码步骤中视觉证据的累积与检索；2) 引入局部自适应词汇检索模块，利用大语言模型为每个patch分配细粒度、组织特异性的语义描述，实现跨多样任务的精确调制。

Result: 在11个公开基准数据集、4项任务上的实验表明，KHiM-Mamba一致地达到最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 通过将显式知识先验注入选择性状态空间机制，有效引导幻灯片编码动态朝向诊断有意义的证据积累，克服了纯视觉驱动SSM在大型WSI中信息稀释的问题。

Abstract: Whole slide image analysis is commonly formulated as multiple instance learning (MIL), where instance features are contextually updated and aggregated into a slide representation, a process we term slide encoding dynamics. Recently, selective state-space models (SSM) have emerged as promising MIL architectures due to their long-sequence modeling capability and linear complexity. However, existing SSM-based MIL methods rely solely on visual features during MIL. Meanwhile, in large-scale WSIs, where sparse diagnostically decisive regions are surrounded by abundant irrelevant information, such purely vision-driven selective dynamics can misallocate state updates and readouts, causing the evolving SSM state to accumulate task-irrelevant evidence and dilute critical diagnostic cues over long scan trajectories. In this work, we propose the Knowledge-Aware Hidden-State Modulation architecture (KHiM-Mamba), which innovatively regulates Mamba's core selective state-space mechanism with explicit knowledge priors, steering slide encoding dynamics toward diagnostically meaningful evidence accumulation. Specifically, we redesign the original SSM layer to perform knowledge modulation operations during the evolution of hidden states, thereby guiding what visual evidence is accumulated and retrieved from the hidden state at each encoding step. Furthermore, we additionally introduce a local-adaptive vocabulary retrieval module that uses large language models to assign each patch fine-grained, tissue-specific semantic descriptions, enabling precise modulation across diverse tasks. Experiments on 11 public benchmarks across 4 tasks show that KHiM-Mamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [417] [Synthesizing Post-Acetazolamide Cerebral Blood Flow Maps from Baseline MRI in Moyamoya Using 3D Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14758)
*Julia Huang,Camila Gonzalez,Rydham Goyal,Aja Zou,Sasha Alexander,Michael Moseley,Moss Y. Zhao,Gary K. Steinberg*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出CAE3D，一种确定性3D条件自编码器，用于从ACZ注射前的ASL灌注MRI直接合成ACZ后的CBF图，从而在乙酰唑胺禁忌或规避时仍能完成血运重建手术所需的血流动力学评估。实验表明CAE3D在MAE、SSIM、PSNR等指标上优于十种基线方法，证明回顾性合成后ACZ CBF图的可行性，但推广到ACZ禁忌患者需外部和前瞻性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 烟雾病患者评估脑血管储备（CVR）通常需要ACZ注射前后的ASL灌注MRI配对扫描。但当ACZ禁忌或规避时，无法获取ACZ后的CBF图，导致CVR评估无法完成，进而影响是否推荐颅内外搭桥手术的决策。因此需要一种无需实际注射ACZ即可获得后ACZ CBF图的方法。

Method: 提出CAE3D，一个确定性3D条件自编码器，直接从ACZ前ASL输入合成ACZ后CBF图。评估中与十个基线方法对比，包括确定性3D基线、扩散式3D基线、2D上下文基线和冻结编码器基础模型适配器，使用MAE、SSIM、PSNR及全脑平均偏差等指标评估。

Result: CAE3D取得最低的留出集MAE（0.066），SSIM为0.80，PSNR为24.0 dB，且全脑平均偏差接近零。其MAE优势在八个从头训练的基线中除2D CAE_2D外均具有统计学显著性；SSIM和PSNR优势对所有八个基线均显著。区域delta-CBF预测在高响应区域压缩了动态范围。

Conclusion: 研究确立了在完成标准两次扫描协议的烟雾病患者中回顾性合成后ACZ CBF图的可行性。但要推广到未包含在本队列中的ACZ禁忌患者，需要外部和前瞻性验证。

Abstract: For patients with Moyamoya disease, impaired cerebrovascular reserve (CVR) is an important hemodynamic criterion for recommending extracranial-to-intracranial bypass surgery. Standard CVR assessment in this cohort uses paired arterial spin labeling (ASL) perfusion MRI acquired before and after acetazolamide (ACZ). When ACZ is contraindicated or avoided, the post-ACZ cerebral blood flow (CBF) map needed for hemodynamic assessment is unavailable. We propose CAE3D, a deterministic 3D conditional autoencoder that synthesizes post-ACZ CBF maps directly from pre-ACZ ASL input. We evaluated CAE3D against ten comparators, including deterministic and diffusion-style 3D baselines, a 2D contextual baseline, and frozen-encoder foundation-model adapters. CAE3D achieved the lowest held-out MAE (0.066), with SSIM 0.80 and PSNR 24.0 dB, and near-zero full-brain mean bias. Its MAE advantage was statistically significant over seven of eight trained-from-scratch baselines, excluding the 2D CAE_2D comparator; its SSIM and PSNR advantages were significant over all eight. Regional delta-CBF predictions compressed the dynamic range in high-response territories. These results establish the retrospective feasibility of post-ACZ CBF synthesis in patients who completed the standard two-scan protocol. Extension to ACZ-contraindicated patients, who were not represented in this cohort, requires external and prospective validation.

</details>


### [418] [Test-Time Instance Selection for Improved Whole Slide Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14759)
*Quoc Anh Nguyen,Sunhong Park,Jin Tae Kwak*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出TTIS（Test-Time Instance Selection），一个无需训练的即插即用框架，在推理阶段从全切片图像（WSI）中选择紧凑且具有代表性的补丁，并通过多视角集成策略增强鲁棒性，可无缝集成到现有MIL模型中，无需重训练或架构更改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MIL模型通常处理所有补丁，其中包含大量冗余或非信息性组织模式；虽然已有基于实例选择的方法，但选择模块仍需额外训练，不够灵活高效。

Method: 提出TTIS框架，在推理阶段以无需训练的方式选择紧凑且代表性的补丁；同时融入多视角集成策略，整合组织形态的不同方面以增强鲁棒性。该框架即插即用，可无缝集成到现有MIL模型中。

Result: 在多个基准上的广泛评估表明，TTIS在多种分类和亚型分型任务中能够提升或匹配基线MIL模型的性能。

Conclusion: TTIS作为一种训练免费、即插即用的测试时实例选择框架，能够在不改变架构或重训练的前提下提升或保持MIL模型性能，为WSI分析提供灵活高效的部署方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis has been widely studied for cancer diagnosis. Conventionally, a gigapixel WSI is divided into small patches and processed by Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) models. However, existing MIL models typically process all patches, many of which contain redundant or non-informative tissue patterns. Although recent approaches have focused on instance selection to identify discriminative patches and reduce redundancy, these selection modules still require additional training. In this work, we propose Test-Time Instance Selection (TTIS), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that selects compact yet representative patches during inference. TTIS further incorporates a multi-view ensemble strategy to integrate distinct facets of tissue morphology, enhancing robustness. Importantly, TTIS can be seamlessly integrated into existing MIL models without retraining or architectural changes, enabling flexible deployment. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach improves or matches baseline MIL performance across a range of classification and subtyping tasks. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/QuIIL/TTIS

</details>


### [419] [Cross-Modal Ultrasound-MRI Learning for Fetal Brain Ventricular Volumetry and Abnormality Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14763)
*Yuhao Huang,Yuanji Zhang,Yuhuan Lu,Dong Ni,P. Ellen Grant,Davood Karimi*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: VIFBA是一个基于超声视频的胎儿脑部评估框架，通过JEPA启发的管状潜在预测目标和跨模态对比对齐策略，从常规超声视频中预测MRI来源的侧脑室容积、分类脑室增大严重程度并识别潜在非脑室增大的胎儿脑部异常。在大规模数据集（857例、3,196段视频）上，该方法在容积回归、严重程度分类和多异常分类任务上均显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胎儿脑室增大的超声评估主要依赖标准平面上人工测量侧脑室宽度，具有操作者依赖性强且难以全面反映整体脑室扩大的局限性。胎儿脑部MRI虽能提供更可靠的容积信息，但成本高且不易普及。因此需要一种仅依赖常规超声即可获得MRI级容积评估的方法。

Method: VIFBA框架包含三大贡献：（1）提出JEPA启发的管状潜在预测目标，利用超声视频中的时空一致性增强表示学习；（2）开发对比跨模态对齐策略，在训练时将MRI的结构信息迁移到超声，推理时仅需超声输入；（3）引入无需训练的视觉语言模型和检索增强模块，用于验证不确定预测并识别潜在非脑室增大的胎儿脑部异常。

Result: 在包含857例（3,196段视频）配对的胎儿脑部超声与MRI数据集上，VIFBA在脑室容积回归任务上达到MAE 0.5909 mL和Pearson相关系数0.9907；VM严重程度分类准确率达0.9400；多异常分类F1分数为0.7764，显著优于单任务基线、视频强基线以及最先进的基础模型。

Conclusion: VIFBA通过仅使用常规超声即可实现MRI级别的容积评估，为准确且可负担的产前脑部筛查提供了一条实用且可广泛部署的路径，解决了超声评估主观性强与MRI成本高的双重困境。

Abstract: Assessment of ventriculomegaly (VM) on fetal brain ultrasound relies primarily on measuring lateral ventricular atrial width on standard planes, which is operator-dependent and may not fully reflect the overall ventricular enlargement. Fetal brain MRI provides more reliable volumetric information but is costly and less accessible for routine use. To address these limitations, we propose VIFBA, an ultrasound video-based framework for fetal brain assessment that predicts MRI-derived lateral ventricular volume, classifies VM severity, and identifies potential non-VM fetal brain abnormalities. Our contribution is three-fold. First, we introduce a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)-inspired tube latent prediction objective that leverages spatio-temporal coherence in ultrasound videos to enhance representation learning. Second, we develop a contrastive cross-modal alignment strategy that transfers structural information from MRI to ultrasound during training, while requiring ultrasound alone at inference. Third, we augment VIFBA with a training-free vision-language model and retrieval augmentation to verify uncertain predictions and identify potential non-VM fetal brain abnormalities. We validated VIFBA on a large dataset comprising 857 cases (3,196 videos) with paired fetal brain ultrasound and MRI examinations. On held-out test data, VIFBA achieved an MAE of 0.5909 mL and Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9907 for ventricular volume regression, 0.9400 accuracy for VM severity classification, and an F1 score of 0.7764 for multi-abnormality classification, substantially outperforming single-task baselines, video-based strong competitors, and state-of-the-art foundation models. By enabling MRI-informed volumetric assessment from routine ultrasound alone, VIFBA offers a practical and potentially broadly deployable pathway toward accurate and affordable prenatal brain screening.

</details>


### [420] [Modality-Invariant Coarse-to-Fine Retinal Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14829)
*Bo Wen,Nehal Nailesh Mehta,Melanie Tran,Dirk-Uwe Bartsch,William Freeman,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用、两阶段、模态不变性的视网膜图像配准框架，由基于通用视网膜血管分割的稀疏特征匹配模型实现跨模态粗配准，以及名为MI-RAFT的模态不变性光流估计网络实现密集局部精配准，在多种视网膜成像模态组合上优于现有依赖特定模态的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视网膜图像配准方法通常是模态相关的：要么为单一模态的单模态配准设计，要么为固定模态对的跨模态配准优化，缺乏对多种成像模态及其不同组合的泛化能力，限制了实际临床应用中的灵活性和适用性。

Method: 提出两阶段通用配准框架：(1) 稀疏特征匹配阶段，利用通用视网膜血管分割驱动的模型实现跨模态稳健的粗全局对齐；(2) 密集局部配准阶段，开发模态不变性光流估计网络MI-RAFT对粗配准结果进行精细化对齐。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法能够处理常用视网膜成像模态的多种组合，展现出强模态不变性，并在配准性能上超越现有的模态相关的先进方法。

Conclusion: 提出的通用两阶段模态不变性配准框架有效解决了现有方法对特定模态的依赖问题，为多样化的视网膜成像模态组合提供了稳健且准确的统一配准方案。

Abstract: Retinal image registration is essential for ophthalmic diagnosis, longitudinal disease monitoring, and multimodal retinal image analysis. Existing retinal registration methods are typically modality-dependent: they are designed or optimized either for a single imaging modality in mono-modal registration or for a fixed pair of modalities in cross-modal registration. This limits their flexibility and applicability in practical scenarios involving diverse retinal imaging modalities and different combinations of them. In this work, we propose a generalizable two-stage, modality-invariant framework for retinal image registration. First, we introduce a sparse feature-matching model driven by a universal retinal vessel segmentation to achieve robust coarse global alignment across modalities. Second, we develop a modality-invariant optical flow estimation network, termed MI-RAFT, to refine the alignment through dense local registration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method can handle diverse combinations of commonly used retinal imaging modalities, exhibiting strong modality invariance while outperforming state-of-the-art modality-dependent registration methods.

</details>


### [421] [Multi-Channel Feature Fusion and Monte Carlo Dropout for Uncertainty-Aware Diabetic Retinopathy Grading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15234)
*Saksham Kumar*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的五阶段糖尿病视网膜病变(DR)分级流水线，结合Ben-Graham绿通道CLAHE特征表示、EfficientNetV2-L序数回归器和MC Dropout不确定性驱动的转诊机制，在APTOS-2019测试集上达到91.31%的QWK，并在20%转诊率下保持90.40%的自动分级QWK，兼顾准确率、可解释性与临床部署安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化五阶段DR分级不仅需要高准确率，还需满足医学级部署要求，包括病变感知的预处理、序数预测、校准的不确定性以及可解释性，以支持可靠的诊断系统。现有方法往往只关注精度而忽视这些临床关键需求。

Method: 采用统一流水线：(1) Ben-Graham绿通道CLAHE特征表示进行病变感知的预处理；(2) EfficientNetV2-L作为序数回归器进行五阶段分级；(3) Monte Carlo dropout实现不确定性估计，用于驱动转诊决策；(4) Grad-CAM提供与临床相关病变对齐的可视化解释。

Result: 在APTOS-2019官方测试集上达到91.31%的QWK（属近完美一致性区间>80%）。在20%转诊率设置下，366张图像中293张被自动分级，QWK为90.40%，复杂病例被转诊给专科医生评估。

Conclusion: 该方法展示了分级质量、自动化程度与患者安全之间的实际权衡，为稳健、可靠且可直接部署的医学诊断系统提供了可行方案。通过不确定性驱动的转诊机制，确保复杂病例得到专家复核，兼顾自动化效率与临床安全性。

Abstract: Automated five-stage diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading requires more than high accuracy alone. Medical-grade deployment calls for lesion-aware preprocessing, ordinal predictions, calibrated uncertainty, and explainability to support reliable diagnostic systems. We present a unified pipeline that addresses these requirements using a Ben-Graham-green-channel CLAHE feature representation, an EfficientNetV2-L ordinal regressor, and Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty-driven referral. Grad-CAM provides visual explanations aligned with clinically relevant lesions.
  The proposed method achieves a QWK of 91.31% on the APTOS-2019 official test split, placing it within the near-perfect agreement band (>80%). At a 20% referral rate, 293 of 366 images are automatically graded with a QWK of 90.40%. More complex cases are referred for specialist assessment, demonstrating a practical trade-off among grading quality, automation, and patient safety in robust, reliable, and deployment-ready medical diagnostic systems.

</details>


### [422] [Dual-Branch State-Displacement Network for Sea Surface Temperature Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15423)
*Wankun Chen,Feng Gao,Yanhai Gan,Chuanzheng Gong,Xun Gong,Junyu Dong,Qian Du*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为DBSD-Net的双分支状态位移网络，用于海表温度（SST）图像超分辨率重建。该网络结合了小波频率分支（通过离散小波变换分离高低频分量）和VGGUNet语义分支（利用冻结的预训练VGG骨干提取多尺度特征），并引入结构状态空间模块、门控结构细化单元和位移门控模块来捕获长距离依赖、增强结构完整性并处理空间变化的退化。在多个公开SST数据集上超越了现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星获取的SST图像空间分辨率粗，难以捕捉海洋锋面等细尺度热结构，亟需有效的超分辨率方法以提升SST图像的空间分辨率，从而更好地支持全球气候变化研究。

Method: DBSD-Net采用双分支架构：(1) 小波频率分支，通过离散小波变换将图像分解为低频和高频分量进行针对性处理，其中引入结构状态空间模块（SSSM）和门控结构细化单元（GSR）捕获长距离依赖并增强结构完整性，同时设计位移门控模块（DGM）学习位移场实现几何感知的高频细节调制，以缓解空间变化的退化；(2) VGGUNet分支，利用冻结的预训练VGG骨干提取多尺度语义特征。

Result: 在多个公开SST数据集上的实验表明，DBSD-Net在超分辨率性能上优于现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: DBSD-Net通过双分支设计有效解决了SST超分辨率中的多尺度特征提取、长距离依赖建模和空间变化退化等问题，为海洋遥感图像超分辨率提供了一种新的有效方案。

Abstract: Sea surface temperature (SST) is a critical indicator of global climate change, yet satellite-derived SST imagery often suffers from coarse spatial resolution, limiting the ability to capture fine-scale thermal structures such as ocean fronts. To address this, we propose a Dual-Branch State-Displacement Network (DBSD-Net) for SST super-resolution. DBSD-Net adopts a dual-branch architecture: a wavelet frequency branch that explicitly separates low and high-frequency components via discrete wavelet transform for targeted processing, and a VGGUNet branch that extracts multi-scale semantic features from a frozen pre-trained VGG backbone. Within the wavelet branch, we introduce a Structural State Space Module (SSSM) with a Gated Structure Refinement (GSR) unit to efficiently capture long-range dependencies and enhance structural integrity, and a Displacement Gate Module (DGM) that learns a displacement field for geometry-aware modulation of high-frequency details, thereby mitigating spatially varying degradation. Experiments on multiple public SST datasets demonstrate that DBSD-Net outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [423] [Underwater Color Restoration with Vanishing Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15598)
*Grigory Solomatov,Derya Akkaynak*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文研究了水下颜色恢复的理论基础，指出当前方法几乎完全依赖经验验证，而该问题在数学上是不适定的。作者识别出能够保证不确定性有界且随相机空间分辨率增加收敛于零的理想化条件，从而弥合理论与实践之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下颜色恢复对水生科学至关重要，但现有方法仅依赖于经验验证，且该问题在完全数学概括下是严重不适定的（fatally ill-posed），需要额外约束才能将解限制在有限不确定区间内。理论上充分的约束与实际数据满足的约束之间的差距尚不清晰，导致无法确定现有方法是否在解决一个实际可解的问题。

Method: 本文从理论层面系统研究这一差距，通过数学推导识别出保证恢复结果不确定性有界（bounded uncertainty）的理想化条件，并进一步证明该不确定性上界会随着相机空间分辨率的提高而收敛到零。

Result: 识别出特定的理想化条件，在这些条件下水下颜色恢复的不确定性是有界的，且该界随相机空间分辨率提升而收敛至零，为水下颜色恢复的可解性提供了理论保证。

Conclusion: 通过揭示可控的理论条件下问题可解，本文为水下颜色恢复从纯经验驱动转向理论保障提供了基础，有助于理清现有方法是否在解决真正可解的问题。

Abstract: Underwater color restoration promises to unlock color as a reliable signal for aquatic sciences, but achieving this with scientific confidence remains out of reach. Current methods are validated almost exclusively on an empirical basis, which provides confidence only to the extent that the vast diversity of possible visibility conditions is covered with end-to-end testing using a known ground truth. This is exacerbated by color restoration being a fatally ill-posed problem when considered in full mathematical generality, requiring additional constraints to narrow the solution to a finite uncertainty interval. The gap between which constraints suffice in theory and which constraints are satisfied by real-world data is poorly understood, making it unclear whether existing methods are solving a problem that is actually solvable. In this article, we investigate the theoretical side of this gap, identifying idealized conditions which guarantee bounded uncertainty that converges to zero as the spatial resolution of the camera increases.

</details>


### [424] [Deep learning-based computed tomography (CT) derived body composition classifier for colorectal cancer patients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15712)
*Eve Harling,Chattarin Pumtako,Bernd Porr,Donald C McMillan,Ross D Dolan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究探索了基于深度学习的自动化回归方法，用于从CT扫描中预测癌症患者的身体成分指标（骨骼肌面积、骨骼肌密度、皮下脂肪面积和内脏脂肪面积）。系统比较了四种深度学习架构（AlexNet、UNet、GoogLeNet和ResNet34），其中GoogLeNet在SMA预测上表现最佳（平均误差4.96%），AlexNet在SMD预测上表现最佳（平均误差8.12%），并开发了临床可用的Web应用。该工具在80%的病例中能够正确分类身体成分指标，有望减少手动分割所需的时间和专业知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT身体成分分析方法（如骨骼肌面积和密度评估）依赖人工操作，耗时且需要专业知识，限制其在临床常规使用。本研究旨在作为可行性试点，探索深度学习自动回归方法是否能替代人工分析，实现快速、准确的身体成分评估。

Method: 研究比较了四种深度学习架构（AlexNet、UNet、GoogLeNet和ResNet34），对结直肠癌患者的CT扫描进行训练，以预测SMA、SMD、SFA和VFA四种身体成分指标。通过系统化的超参数优化筛选最优模型，并将最佳模型部署到Web应用程序中供临床使用。

Result: GoogLeNet在SMA预测中取得最佳性能（平均百分比误差4.96%），AlexNet在SMD预测中达到8.12%。独立测试显示80%的病例能够正确分类身体成分指标，Web应用能够提供快速且一致的输出结果。

Conclusion: 优化后的深度学习模型（特别是GoogLeNet和AlexNet）能够自动化完成CT图像身体成分分析，有望简化临床实践，减少手动分割所需的时间和专业知识。仍需在更大规模、更多样化的数据集上进行进一步验证。

Abstract: Background: Accurate body composition analysis using Computed Tomography (CT) scans is essential for assessing skeletal muscle area (SMA) and skeletal muscle density (SMD), key markers of nutritional status in cancer patients. Conventional manual methods are labour-intensive and require specialist expertise, limiting their routine clinical use. Therefore, this study serves as a feasibility and pilot investigation to explore the potential of deep learning-based automated regression for body composition analysis within a clinical workflow.
  Methods: Four deep learning architectures (AlexNet, UNet, GoogLeNet, and ResNet34) were trained to predict SMA, SMD, subcutaneous fat area (SFA), and visceral fat area (VFA) from CT scans of colorectal cancer patients. Systematic hyperparameter optimization identified the most accurate models, which were subsequently implemented in a web application for clinical use.
  Results: GoogLeNet achieved the best performance, with a mean percentage error (PE) of 4.96% for SMA prediction, while AlexNet reached 8.12% for SMD. Independent testing demonstrated robust accuracy, correctly classifying body composition metrics in 80% of cases. The web application delivered rapid and consistent outputs, supporting integration into clinical workflows.
  Conclusion: Optimized deep learning models, particularly GoogLeNet and AlexNet, can automate CT-derived body composition analysis with a Mean Percentage Error (PE) of 4.96% for SMA and 8.12% for SMD. These tools have the potential to streamline clinical practice by reducing the time and expertise required for manual segmentation. Further validation in larger, more diverse datasets is warranted.

</details>


### [425] [Decoupling Parcellation from Classification: Systematic Benchmark of Fast Brain Segmentation Methods for Alzheimer's Disease Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16039)
*Jiadao Zou,Hongyu Guo,Wei Xi*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究解耦脑区划分（parcellation）与AD分类两个环节，系统比较SynthSeg+、OpenMAP-T1等快速深度学习分割方法与传统FreeSurfer基线，通过因子设计评估三种分割方法×两种体积测量策略×四种分类范式，在OASIS-1数据集上使用BCa Bootstrap 95%置信区间量化下游AD分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑区划分和AD分类通常被孤立评估，但实际下游AD检测性能取决于二者的交互作用。现有研究缺乏对分割方法与下游分类任务之间关系的系统理解。

Method: 采用因子设计实验，包含三个因素：三种脑区分割方法（SynthSeg+、OpenMAP-T1、FreeSurfer临床基线FS-HV）、两种体积测量策略（硬分割vs软分割）、四种分类范式（临床阈值、监督前馈网络、集成方法、带零样本/少样本提示的基础模型），所有结果使用BCa Bootstrap 95%置信区间量化。

Result: 在OASIS-1数据集上系统量化了不同分割方法与分类器的组合对AD检测性能的影响，通过置信区间提供统计推断。

Conclusion: 脑区分割与AD分类之间存在交互效应，需综合评估而非孤立比较；分割方法选择和体积测量策略对下游分类性能有可量化的影响。

Abstract: Brain parcellation and classification are typically evaluated in isolation, yet downstream AD detection performance depends on their interaction. We decouple these components and systematically benchmark fast deep learning parcellation methods (SynthSeg+, OpenMAP-T1) against the FreeSurfer (FS-HV) clinical baseline through down- stream AD classification on OASIS-1. Our factorial design evaluates three parcellation methods, two volumetry strategies (hard vs. soft), and four classifier paradigms (clinical thresholds, supervised feedforward networks, ensemble methods, and foundation models with zero/few-shot prompting), with all results quantified using BCa Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

</details>


### [426] [BiCRVC: An Efficient Bidirectional Neural Video Compression Framework via Coupled Representation Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16175)
*Wei Jiang,Junru Li,Kai Zhang,Li Zhang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了BiCRVC，一种基于耦合表示编码的高效双向神经视频压缩框架，通过将运动表示和帧潜在表示统一为单一潜变量进行熵编码，解决现有BVC运动优先解码成本高和长程双向预测下运动估计困难的问题。实验表明其压缩性能优于最先进BVC，1080p解码速度提升约30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双向神经视频压缩（BVC）在实际随机访问编码中面临两个技术挑战：一是需要昂贵的运动优先解码（motion-first decoding），二是长程双向预测下可靠运动估计困难。这些限制了BVC在实用场景中的效率与性能。

Method: 1）提出耦合表示编码（coupled representation coding），将运动表示与当前帧潜在表示变换为统一潜变量进行单一熵编码，实现从同一比特流用统一编解码器解码运动与帧信息，同时仍可重构运动对齐上下文用于帧解码。2）提出多候选运动估计（MCME），结合多尺度运动估计与并行累积运动估计，更好处理多样且长程的运动。3）提出双向运动特征传播（BMFP），在编码器和解码器端复用先前解码的运动特征作为条件运动编码的时间先验，降低运动编码开销。4）采用耦合失真训练和随机GOP结构训练，促进运动-帧联合编码并增强对层次随机访问结构的适应性。

Result: 实验表明BiCRVC在压缩性能上优于最先进的双向神经视频压缩方法，同时1080p解码速度比近期BVC方法快约30倍。

Conclusion: 通过耦合表示编码统一运动与帧信息的编解码流程，配合多候选运动估计和双向运动特征传播，BiCRVC在保持甚至提升压缩性能的同时显著加速了解码过程，为实用化双向神经视频压缩提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Neural video compression (NVC) has achieved strong compression performance, but practical random-access coding still faces two technical challenges: existing bidirectional NVCs (BVCs) usually require costly motion-first decoding, and reliable motion estimation is difficult under long-range bidirectional prediction. To address these issues, we present BiCRVC, an efficient bidirectional neural video compression framework based on coupled representation coding. Instead of coding motion and frame information with two separate codecs, BiCRVC transforms the motion representation and the current-frame latent into a unified latent representation for entropy coding. This design enables motion and frame information to be decoded from the same bitstream with one unified codec, while still reconstructing motion-aligned contexts for frame decoding. To improve motion accuracy, we introduce multi-candidate motion estimation (MCME), which combines multi-scale motion estimation and parallel accumulated motion estimation to better handle diverse and long-range motions. To reduce motion coding overhead, we further propose bidirectional motion feature propagation (BMFP), which reuses previously decoded motion features at both the encoder and decoder as temporal priors for conditional motion coding. In addition, coupled distortion training and random GOP structure training are used to encourage joint motion-frame coding and improve adaptation to hierarchical random-access structures. Experiments show that BiCRVC achieves better compression performance than state-of-the-art BVCs while providing about 30 times faster 1080p decoding than recent BVCs.

</details>


### [427] [A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16233)
*Siyuan Ma,Liang He,Mengying Zhu,Yi Chai,Mengyao Lyu,Haowei Wang,Qizhen Lan,HaoBo Sun,Qixin Zhang,Jingli Chen,Xiaobing Wei,Jiaming Liu,Guiqin Liu,Qianwen Zhang,Yang Liu,Dacheng Tao,Guangyu Wu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出MSCNet，一种序列条件跨模态生成框架，用于前列腺多参数MRI中缺失或退化序列的补全与修复。在十项补全任务中，MSCNet在结构相似度上超越现有最优方法；1,000例盲法阅片研究验证了DWI、ADC和T2W补全的非劣效性；200例诊断评估中MSCNet生成图像的AUC接近真实图像；186例三院多中心队列支持其跨中心可移植性，表明质量受控的跨模态重建可作为获取式前列腺MRI的辅助手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺多参数MRI（mpMRI）常因图像缺失或质量退化而影响临床诊断，导致关键序列不可用。现有方法缺少针对此类缺丢失/退化场景的通用、序列条件化的重建框架，因此需要一种能够跨模态推断缺失对比度并修复退化采集的生成方法，以提升前列腺MRI的完整性和临床可用性。

Method: MSCNet采用序列条件化的跨模态生成框架。其核心创新在于：（1）通过条件嵌入对目标序列（DWI、ADC、T2W、T1W等）进行显式建模，使其可在不同模态间生成缺失的对比度或修复已退化的采集；（2）针对十个不同的补全任务分别训练任务专属模型，并与最强匹配的基线进行公平对比，包括匹配参数量的消融分析以评估病灶保真度与边界保留；（3）通过多中心（三所医院、186例锁定队列）评估验证模型的可移植性与泛化能力。

Result: 在10项补全任务中，任务专属MSCNet的平均结构相似度（SSIM）为0.818，优于最强匹配对照方法的0.798；匹配参数量分析中，MSCNet在病灶保真度和边界保留上的优势更明显。1,000例盲法阅片研究显示，DWI、ADC和T2W补全达到预设的非劣效标准，但T1W未达标。200例诊断评估中，临床显著前列腺癌检测的AUC分别为：获取图像0.860、MSCNet生成图像0.841、基线生成图像0.797。186例三医院锁定队列验证了多中心可移植性。

Conclusion: 这些回顾性结果表明，质量受控的跨模态重建可以作为获取式前列腺MRI的辅助工具，能够在序列缺失或退化时提供可靠的替代图像。但需注意T1W补全未达到非劣效标准，且仍需前瞻性临床验证以确认其在真实诊疗流程中的价值。

Abstract: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for DWI, ADC and T2W completion, but not T1W. In a separate 200-case diagnostic assessment, AUCs for clinically significant cancer were 0.860 with acquired images, 0.841 with MSCNet and 0.797 with baseline-generated images. A locked 186-case three-hospital cohort supported multicentre transportability. These retrospective results support quality-controlled cross-modal reconstruction as an adjunct to acquired prostate MRI.

</details>


### [428] [What Matters is the Prompt: Prompt Sensitivity and Prompt Generation in Foundation Models for Lung Nodule Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16832)
*Jorge F. Lazo,Xixi Liu,Andreas Hallqvist,Mikael Johansson,Åse Johnsson,Jonas S. Andersson,Jennifer Alvén,Ida Häggström*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文研究了提示（prompt）质量对基础模型（foundation models）在肺结节分割任务中性能的影响，并提出了一种合成提示生成模型来减少对手动提示的依赖，最终获得0.85的Dice系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于提示的基础模型在医学图像分割中表现出色，但其性能高度依赖于输入提示（如点或框）的质量和位置。为了设计可靠且鲁棒的医学图像分割方案，需要深入理解提示质量对模型性能的约束与限制。

Method: 通过扰动实验系统评估点提示与边界框提示对基础模型分割性能的影响；提出一种合成提示生成模型，自动生成高质量提示以替代人工标注的提示，从而减轻对提示质量的依赖并提升分割性能。

Result: 实验表明边界框提示通常优于点提示，最新专用医学影像模型优于通用模型。提出的合成提示生成方法达到0.85的Dice系数。

Conclusion: 合成提示生成是肺结节分割中利用基础模型的一种有前景策略，可有效缓解对手动提示质量的依赖。

Abstract: Lung nodule segmentation in computed tomography is essential for extracting clinically relevant information for lung cancer assessment and treatment planning. Foundation models have shown notable segmentation capabilities, but state-of-the-art approaches often depend on input prompts, such as points or boxes, making their performance sensitive to prompt quality and placement. Understanding the limitations and constraints of prompt-based foundation models is therefore essential for designing reliable medical image segmentation solutions. In this work, we investigate how prompt quality affects foundation models performance for lung nodule segmentation. We further propose a synthetic prompt-generation model to test if the dependence on manually provided prompts can be mitigated by generating synthetic prompts that can also improve segmentation performance. Perturbation experiments show that bounding box prompts generally outperform point prompts, while latest specialized medical imaging models achieve better performance than general purpose ones. The proposed approach obtains a Dice coefficient of 0.85, suggesting that synthetic prompt generation as a promising strategy for lung nodule segmentation with foundation models.

</details>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [429] [SpotlessGS: Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting under Dynamic Illumination for Robotic Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14713)
*Liang Hong,Jiaxin Wei,Simon Schaefer,Stefan Leutenegger,Jaehyung Jung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将Dark Gaussian Splatting（DarkGS）扩展为更精确且灵活的可重光照3D重建框架，通过联合优化光照参数、基于球谐的低频光照模型以及MLP-based BRDF模型，解决了低照度环境中机器人感知任务因不均匀照明导致的退化问题，并在合成和真实数据集上验证了方法有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在黑暗或光线不足环境中作业的机器人依赖机载光源，但往往产生不均匀照明，降低下游感知任务性能。已有基于2D图像增强的方法缺乏可靠监督，且无法保持多视图几何一致性。

Method: 1) 在Gaussian Splatting框架内联合优化光照参数，消除显式光参数标定的需求；2) 引入基于球谐（SH）的低频光照模型，捕捉空间变化的残余和环境光照效应；3) 引入MLP-based BRDF模型以建模非朗伯反射。

Result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效缓解了光照伪影，提升了渲染质量和定量性能，超越了先前的方案，并通过下游任务验证了对机器人感知的益处。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够在不依赖显式光参数标定的情况下实现高质量的可重光照3D重建，显著改善黑暗环境中的渲染质量，并实际有益于机器人的下游感知任务。

Abstract: Robots operating in dark or poorly lit environments rely on onboard lights, which often produce uneven illumination that degrades downstream perception tasks. Prior approaches based on 2D image enhancement lack reliable supervision and fail to preserve multi-view geometric consistency. To address these limitations, we extend Dark Gaussian Splatting (DarkGS) toward a more accurate and flexible relightable 3D reconstruction framework. First, we eliminate the need for explicit light parameter calibration by jointly optimizing lighting parameters within the Gaussian Splatting framework. Second, we introduce a low-frequency illumination model based on spherical harmonics (SH) to capture spatially varying residual and ambient lighting effects. Third, we incorporate an MLP-based Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF) to model non-Lambertian reflectance. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates illumination artifacts while improving rendering quality and quantitative performance over prior approaches. We further validate its benefits for robotic perception through a downstream task.

</details>


### [430] [MISTac: A Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Minimally Invasive Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14772)
*Robin Koch,Annabella Mascot,Rayan Younis,Martin Wagner,Stefanie Speidel,Mark Cutkosky,Ingo Sieber,Roberto Calandra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MISTac，一种专为微创手术（MIS）设计的高分辨率视觉触觉传感器。其直径8mm的可更换传感器尖端可穿过微创手术套管针，模块化3D打印外壳便于使用通用照明和成像硬件。传感器光学分辨率176.68微米，触觉分辨率250微米，可分辨低至24.3mN的力。体内研究验证了其可用性，训练机器学习模型在组织分类任务上达到约84%的聚合准确率（留一交叉验证）。传感器已在GitHub开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术和机器人辅助手术相比传统开放手术有诸多优势，但剥夺了外科医生的触觉反馈和手指触诊组织的能力。为了解决这一缺乏触觉反馈的问题，作者开发了MISTac触觉传感器。

Method: 设计了一个高分辨率视觉基触觉传感器：采用8mm可更换传感器尖端以适配MIS套管针；模块化3D打印外壳支持通用现成照明和成像硬件，便于更换和升级；通过体外和体内实验评估传感器性能，并结合留一交叉验证的机器学习模型进行组织分类。

Result: 传感器达到光学分辨率176.68微米、触觉分辨率250微米、最小可分辨力24.3mN；体内实验证实其在微创手术中的可用性；训练的组织分类模型在留一交叉验证中达到约84%的聚合准确率。

Conclusion: 触觉传感器有望在未来辅助外科医生在微创手术中执行组织分类或术中肿瘤定位等任务，MISTac是朝这一愿景迈出的一小步，且已开源以促进进一步研究与发展。

Abstract: Minimally invasive and robot-assisted surgery offer many advantages over traditional open surgery, but deprive surgeons of tactile feedback and the ability to palpate tissue with their fingers. To address this lack of tactile feedback, we introduce the MISTac, a high resolution vision-based tactile sensor specifically designed for palpation in MIS. The sensor has a replaceable sensor tip with a diameter of 8 mm which allows it to fit through the trocars used in minimally invasive surgery. Its modular 3D-printed case design allows the use of bulky off-the-shelf illumination and imaging hardware that can easily be exchanged and upgraded. The sensor has an optical resolution of 176.68 $μm$, a tactile resolution of 250 $μm$, and can resolve forces as little as 24.3 mN. An in vivo study with the sensor shows its usability in minimally invasive surgery. We trained a machine learning model with the tactile data collected in the trial on a tissue classification task achieving an aggregate accuracy of ~84% in a leave-one-out cross validation. Tactile sensors have the potential to one day aid surgeons during minimally invasive surgery with tasks such as tissue classification or intra-operative tumor localization; MISTac is a small step towards this vision. We open-source MISTac at https://github.com/lasr-lab/mistac

</details>


### [431] [Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14822)
*Yanyan Zhang,Disheng Liu,Kai Ye,Chaoda Song,Xinpeng Li,Mohsen Hariri,Vikash Singh,Yu Yin,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe)，一个无需训练的框架，在推理时通过想象策略从最近可行状态向当前目标的延续，并用合成观测替代物理执行来恢复冻结的VLA模型，无需失败数据、策略微调或外部纠正智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽然提升了机器人操作的灵活性和泛化性，但对在线干扰（如任务目标变化、场景配置变化或机器人状态变化）依然脆弱。现有恢复方法通常需要失败数据、策略重训练或外部纠正智能体，带来额外的数据需求和执行风险。

Method: CoRe采用训练无关（training-free）框架，在检测到偏差后，从最近的可行使状态出发，使用合成观测想象策略向当前目标的后续执行方式，然后对机器人和场景进行最小化重新对齐（realignment），使其重新接入这一想象中的延续，随后将控制权交还给策略。整个过程无需物理试错，保留已完成的任务进度，统一处理中期指令变化和物理扰动。

Result: 在多个模拟器、VLA骨干网络和真实世界场景中进行的大量实验表明，CoRe将成功率提升了最多85.0个百分点，达到接近正常水平，同时将物理恢复操作减少了42.2%，且无需策略微调或针对失败的恢复训练。

Conclusion: CoRe证明了在不依赖失败数据和额外训练的前提下，通过在推理时进行反事实想象与最小化重新对齐，可以显著提升VLA模型对在线干扰的鲁棒性，为VLA在真实世界中的可靠部署提供了新的途径。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have improved the flexibility and generality of robotic manipulation, yet they remain fragile to online disruptions, such as changes in task goal, scene configuration, or robot state. Existing recovery methods often require failure data, policy retraining, or external corrective agents, introducing additional data requirements and execution risks. We propose Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe), a training-free framework that recovers a frozen VLA at inference time without failure data. Upon detecting a deviation, CoRe imagines how the policy would continue toward the current goal from a recent viable state, using synthesized observations in place of physical execution, and then minimally realigns the robot and scene to rejoin this imagined continuation before returning control to the policy. Recovery is therefore planned without physical trial-and-error, preserves completed task progress, and handles both mid-episode instruction changes and physical perturbations in a unified manner. Extensive experiments across multiple simulators, VLA backbones, and real-world settings show that CoRe improves success rates by up to 85.0 percentage points to near-nominal levels while reducing physical restorations by 42.2%, without policy fine-tuning or failure-specific recovery training.

</details>


### [432] [Modeling and Control of an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot for Design Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14860)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于有限元方法(FEM)的鳗鲡式仿生软体机器人游泳仿真模型，该模型将弹性杆的材料模型与流体动力学模型耦合，用于软体机器人的设计优化和基于模型的估计、推理与控制系统开发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鳗鲡式(anguilliform)游泳是一种高效的游动模式，而软体机器人新材料的发展使得研制鳗鱼启发的软体机器人成为可能。需要一个仿真模型来辅助设计优化以及开发基于模型的估计、推理和控制系统。

Method: 采用有限元方法(FEM)对弹性杆进行建模以捕捉软体机器人的材料特性，该方法特别适合模拟材料属性随时间变化的情况；将材料模型与流体动力模型耦合，以模拟细长软体机器人在水中的行为。

Result: 模型成功演示了所提出的控制方法在实现期望游泳行为方面的有效性，并为设计决策提供了洞见，包括不同系统配置的鲁棒性以及材料退化和失效的影响。结果表明，略微不对称的设计更具优势，能够提供相当的游泳速度但具有更高的机动性。

Conclusion: 该模型可用于指导未来面向特定任务优化性能的软体机器人设计决策。

Abstract: Anguilliform locomotion is a highly efficient swimming mode; the advent of new materials for soft robots enables the development of an eel-inspired soft robot. This paper presents a simulation model of an eel-inspired soft robot designed for anguilliform swimming. This model can aid in design optimization and the development of model-based estimation, reasoning, and control systems. A Finite Element Method (FEM) model of an elastic rod is used to capture the soft materials of the robotic fish, which makes it particularly amenable to variation over time as the material properties change. The material model is coupled with a hydrodynamic force model to simulate the behavior of a soft, elongated robot in water. The model is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approaches in achieving desired swimming behaviors. It also provides insights into design decisions, including the robustness of different system configurations and the impact of material degradation and failure. The results show that slightly asymmetric designs are advantageous, offering comparable swimming velocities but greater maneuverability. This model can be used to guide future robotic design decisions aimed at optimizing performance for specific tasks.

</details>


### [433] [Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health (REACH) on an Eel-Inspired Soft Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14865)
*Zhangjingyi Jiang,Myungsun Park,Michael T. Tolley,Mark Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向软体游泳机器人的执行器健康估计算法REACH，该算法结合软体机器人模型、sigma点滤波器和统计假设检验，能够实时估计执行器功能退化情况，并在不同传感器配置和多种游泳步态下验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下机器人的工作环境严苛，且软体机器人材料和执行器易发生退化，因此准确估计执行器功能状态对于机器人完成任务以及在执行器退化或失效时安全返航至关重要。

Method: REACH架构由三部分组成：软体机器人模型用于刻画系统动力学，sigma点滤波器用于处理非线性状态估计，形式化统计假设检验用于检测执行器退化变化。通过比较GPS、IMU和弯曲传感器三种传感器类型，评估传感器的数量和布放位置，并针对三种游泳步态进行性能比较，最后采用滤波验证方法检验估计算法的统计一致性。

Result: 弯曲传感器和IMU均为合适的传感器选择；IMU需要两个传感器即可，而弯曲传感器需要三个。REACH在三种游泳步态（直线游动、大转弯、小转弯）下均能成功预测执行器健康状态，性能差异很小。滤波验证表明故障估计算法在统计上能够一致地找到正确的退化程度。在鱼形机器人的弯曲传感器数据实验中，REACH即使在噪声数据和制造差异存在的情况下也能成功估计执行器健康状态。

Conclusion: REACH算法能够实时、准确、统计一致地估计软体游泳机器人的执行器健康状态，对不同传感器类型、数量和位置以及多种游泳步态均具有良好的鲁棒性，并在真实鱼形机器人数据上得到验证。

Abstract: An actuator health estimation algorithm for a soft swimming robot that can perform anguilliform swimming is developed. Due to harsh operational environments of underwater robots, and the common degradation of soft robot materials and actuators, accurate estimation of actuator functionality is necessary for robots to perform their missions as well as return to base in the event of actuator degradation and failure. Termed REACH (Real-time Estimator of Actuator Control and Health), the architecture employs a soft robot model, sigma point filter, and a formal statistical hypothesis test to adequately capture the nonlinearities and changes over time. The performance of REACH using three sensor types (GPS, IMU, and Bend Sensor) with one sensor on each actuator is compared, demonstrating that both bend sensor and IMU are adequate choices. Sensor quantity and placement are evaluated for IMU and bend sensor, showing two sensors are sufficient for IMU, whereas three sensors are needed for bend sensor. Three swimming gaits (linear swimming, wide turning, tight turning) are compared, demonstrating that REACH can successfully predict actuator health for all three gaits, with minimal differences in performance. A filter validation method shows the fault estimation algorithm is statistically consistent in finding the correct degradation. The approach is experimentally evaluated using bend sensor data collected from a fish robot, demonstrating that REACH can successfully estimate actuator health with noisy data and variations in manufacturing.

</details>


### [434] [Geometry-Aware Online Mapping for 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14902)
*Thai Luu,Quan Tran,Hieu Phan,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对3DGS-SLAM系统中沿用离线重建的初始化与密度控制启发式方法在在线SLAM严格优化预算下表现脆弱的问题，提出了三种几何感知方法：透射保持的稠密化、基于深度和内参的相机感知尺度初始化、以及误差引导的稠密化，在低开销下显著提升渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS-SLAM系统需要在线增量扩展高斯地图，但大多数系统直接沿用离线3DGS重建中的初始化和密度控制启发式方法。这些方法在离线长优化调度下能均摊成本，但在在线SLAM的每关键帧严格优化预算和增量地图增长条件下变得脆弱，导致有限的计算和迭代被分配到不合理的位置。

Method: 在解耦的3DGS-SLAM框架中，作者在映射线程中提出三种几何感知方法：(1) 透射保持的稠密化（transmittance-preserving densification），关注几何遮挡关系；(2) 相机感知的尺度初始化，利用深度和内参信息进行高斯尺度初始化；(3) 误差引导的稠密化，将新图元（primitive）聚焦到高残差区域，使计算资源集中在最需要的地方。

Result: 实验结果表明，三种方法在渲染质量上取得了一致的提升，且计算开销可忽略不计。同时揭示了在线SLAM中光度残差与位姿不确定性之间的耦合关系。

Conclusion: 针对在线SLAM的特定约束条件重新设计初始化和密度控制启发式方法是必要且有效的，这为3DGS-SLAM系统的几何感知优化提供了新思路。作者将开源代码以促进社区验证和进一步研究。

Abstract: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient photorealistic view synthesis and is rapidly being adopted in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) systems for online mapping. In these systems, a Gaussian map must be expanded and refined incrementally while tracking runs in real time, so initialization and density control directly determine where limited computation and iterations are spent. This contrasts with offline 3DGS reconstruction, where such heuristics can be amortized over long optimization schedules. However, most 3DGS-SLAM pipelines inherit initialization and density-control heuristics from offline reconstruction, which can become brittle under the strict per-keyframe optimization budgets and incremental map growth of online SLAM. In this work, we revisit these heuristics in a decoupled 3DGS-SLAM setting and propose three geometry-aware methods that operate in the mapping thread: transmittance-preserving densification, camera-aware scale initialization from depth and intrinsics, and error-guided densification that focuses new primitives on high-residual regions. Our results show consistent improvements in rendering quality with negligible overhead, highlighting the coupling between photometric residuals and pose uncertainty in online SLAM. We will open-source our code to the community to foster growth and validate reproducibility.

</details>


### [435] [From Continuous Design to Delay-Aware Discrete Synthesis: Guaranteed High-Bandwidth Joint Control for PMSM Drives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14937)
*Edmundo Pozo Fortunić,Mehmet C. Yildirim,Sami Haddadin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务感知、延迟扩展的离散时间关节模型，用于直接合成离散PI电流控制器，可显式考虑通信与计算延迟，并解析确定最小采样频率、控制器增益和直流母线电压，以满足指定的关节性能要求。仿真与实验均验证了该方法相较传统连续时间设计可显著降低采样频率和直流母线电压要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器人关节的动态需求日益严苛，要求电流控制器在宽速度、加速度和扭矩范围内实现高带宽，而此时通信、计算和离散时间效应已不可忽略。传统PMSM电流控制器多在连续时间下设计后再离散化，采样频率和实现延迟的影响主要依靠启发式选择和迭代验证，缺乏系统性的设计依据。

Method: 提出一种考虑物理通信与计算延迟的离散时间关节模型（任务感知、延迟扩展），基于该模型直接合成具有指定带宽和延迟保证的离散PI电流控制器。框架解析求解最小所需采样频率、控制器增益及直流母线电压，以满足电机和关节的指定性能指标。

Result: 在多种动态需求场景下的仿真表明，相比传统基于连续时间的设计方法，所提方法能大幅降低所需采样频率和直流母线电压。此外，在自主研发的定制机器人关节上进行的实验在真实嵌入式实现条件下进一步验证了该框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种从任务需求出发、以解析方式确定控制器参数和系统级资源（采样频率、直流母线电压）的方法，克服了传统连续时间设计在离散实现下的不确定性，为高性能机器人关节电流控制设计提供了系统化且经过实验验证的解决方案。

Abstract: The increasing dynamic demands of modern robotic joints require current controllers to achieve high bandwidth over wide operating ranges of speed, acceleration, and torque, where communication, computation, and discrete-time effects can no longer be neglected. Conventional PMSM current controllers are typically designed in continuous time and subsequently discretized, leaving the sampling frequency and the impact of implementation delays largely to heuristic selection and iterative validation.
